restaurants.name: 1871 Restaurant at Anantara Stanley & Livingstone
addresses: Anantara Stanley & Livingstone, Old Ursula Road, Victoria FallsDaily
restaurants.description: 1871 at Anantara Stanley & Livingstone sits beside a watering hole, and dining while giraffes, impalas or elephants come to drink is what reviewers describe first. Global (July 2019) called the food, service and scenery “beyond the best in this town”, recommending dinner or lunch while watching the animals. Javier, writing in Spanish in August 2024, described watching giraffes and impalas from the table at sunset and praised the food and value.

restaurants.name: 3 Daughters
addresses: Parklands Shopping Centre, 18 Ludlow Hewitt Road, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: 3 Daughters in Bulawayo's Parklands Shopping Centre is known as the city's jazz spot, with live bands playing Friday to Sunday. Sharon (August 2025) called it “a quiet nice place playing jazz music during weekend”, and Sharon Wendy, in a longer November 2021 review, said “the jazz bands that play there are awesome, its so relaxing”.

restaurants.name: 36 Cork Corner
restaurants.description: 36 Cork Corner in Harare is a food court rather than a single kitchen, with outlets including Ocean Basket, Rocco Mama's, Pizza Inn and other Simbisa brands under one roof. Alfred (2024) described “mixed seating ,indoor, semi outdoor and balcony/rooftop seating” and praised the waffle dessert from Rocco Mama's. Tadiwa (July 2026) and Olivoak (April 2026) both thanked an Ocean Basket server, recorded as Lysa and Lisa, for cheerful service.

restaurants.name: 4th Garden Cafe
restaurants.description: 4th Garden Cafe in Murambi, Mutare, is built around a garden and pool view, and burgers are what reviewers order most. Gk (April 2022) loved the King Burger, calling it “Huge, Juicy and Delicious”, and Jonathan (March 2021) had a salmon burger “with the works” and “definitely recommend” it.

restaurants.name: 7 Rings
restaurants.description: 7 Rings in Harare serves donuts and coffee, and the donuts get the strongest praise. Rachel (2025) called them “delicious, soft, and flavorful”, though found the coffee arrived pre-sweetened and “far too sweet” for anyone hoping to control their own sugar. Andy (January 2026) had a similar complaint about the advertised cream, finding it “some sugar cream possibly made from uht” rather than the real thing. Staff members Ruvimbo, Trust and Memory are thanked by name by Paida (

restaurants.name: Aces Hideout
restaurants.description: Located in Gweru, Aces Hideout Gweru is a casual restaurant. It has 13 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Active Sushi
addresses: N1 Hotel, 738 Adam Stander Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Active Sushi operates out of the N1 Hotel compound in Victoria Falls, and it turns out to be more of a Chinese restaurant than a sushi bar. Brian (May 2026) put it well: “More of a Chinese restaurant that has sushi than a sushi restaurant with Chinese offerings”. The sushi itself keeps surprising people who came expecting only the Chinese menu; Jonathan (May 2024), after eating there three times, said it “smelled good and it tasted good”, and several other reviewers rated it

restaurants.name: Active Sushi (9th Ave)
restaurants.description: Active Sushi on 9th Avenue serves a broad grill and Chinese-style menu alongside sushi. Shamgar (December 2023) called it “Best sushi I've ever eaten!” in surroundings that were “spotless”, and Ntandoyenkosi (July 2023) said the food was “on point especially the sushi”. Simphiwe (August 2024) found the chow mein “wonderful”, though a “salmon crunch” promotion had little salmon in it.

restaurants.name: Active Sushi (Hillside)
restaurants.description: Active Sushi in Hillside serves sushi alongside Chinese dishes and grills, and reviewers agree the food is good even when service lags. Mmemezi (May 2026) found the food “fresh, tasty, and well prepared” in a simple, functional space. Slow service comes up repeatedly: Tanaka Mudzimiri (August 2026) said food “took ages to come”, and Tanaka Mpofu (November 2025) called service “a bit slow”, though the outdoor seating and an adjoining Lions Club bar make up for the wait.

restaurants.name: Adrienne’s Restuarant
addresses: Belgravia Shopping Centre, A1, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Adrienne’s is a friendly family restaurant specialising in good, well priced, cosmopolitan food including Zimbabwean dishes at extremely reasonable prices. restaurants.name: African Delies Restaurant
restaurants.description: African Delies Restaurant is a restaurant in Plumtree. It holds a 4.2/5 rating from 15 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: African Sun Amber Hotel
addresses: Cnr Aerodrome Road & Third Street, Mutare
restaurants.description: African Sun Amber Hotel in Mutare doubles as a restaurant with a pub attached, and reviewers describe solid food more than standout dishes. Terence (August 2017) called it “High quality restaurant dishes”, most ideal for family getaways, and Washington (February 2017) liked the “great bar (The foresters Irish Pub) great meals”. Aubrey (March 2018) found the food and service had improved noticeably since earlier visits, and staff come up often for being attentive and hospitabl

restaurants.name: Afropolitan Restaurant Bar & Grill
restaurants.description: Afropolitan is a busy bar and grill in Harare that runs late on weekends. Tariro (December 2025) found the “chicken wings were nice and succulent and tender,” while the kebabs were “delicious” too, though the waitress that day “seemed tired and overwhelmed.” Vuyokazi (2022) had a rougher visit, with “chicken was dry, chips over cooked,” and the kitchen out of cake and BBQ sauce. G (February 2026) called an afternoon meal “scrumptious absolutely” in “an inviting place with a w

restaurants.name: Afrotopia Café
addresses: Theatre in the Park, Harare Gardens (usually National Gallery, 20 Julius Nyerere Way), Harare
restaurants.description: Afrotopia Café sits inside Harare's National Gallery grounds, an art-filled cafe reviewers treat as one of the city's more creative spots. Nono (August 2023) called it “one of if not the best creative space and cafe in harare”. Breakfast is a regular order at around $5 a plate: Sympathy (February 2025) goes back “regularly for the 5usd breakfast” alongside a favourite chicken salad, and Ignatious (April 2025) enjoyed the plate but flagged “no substitution for bacon if you're

restaurants.description: We serve lunch, dinner, drinks and coffee. We do take outs catering, outdoor seating, we take reservations. restaurants.name: Alfresco
restaurants.description: Alfresco is an artisan bakery with branches in Harare and Bulawayo, selling fresh breads, pastries, sandwiches, homemade jams and coffee. The Bulawayo branch on Nairn Road in Hillside opens only Thursday to Saturday mornings.

restaurants.name: Alfresco
restaurants.description: Alfresco in Greendale draws people in for breakfast, coffee and the chicken mayo sandwich made with seeded bread. Debbie found it “beyond expectations” and called the carrot cake “to die for” in a 2025 review. Samantha, also in 2025, agreed the seeded bread made the sandwich better than usual, though the twine used to tie it up had embedded itself in the filling, and Samantha's chai latte was “a bit mid”. Grace (2024) compared the space to “the Starbucks of Zimbabwe” but wish

restaurants.name: Alo Alo
addresses: 10 Forest Road, behind Arundel Village, Harare
restaurants.description: Alo Alo in Mount Pleasant serves diners water and bread before the menu arrives, a touch Sarah (September 2025) said drew a return visit. The kitchen runs from breakfast through dinner across a wide menu; Talent (April 2022) called the chicken salad “also very unique to them, never had such a salad anywhere else”, and Nicole Natsai (January 2025) said the choices weren't “the boring menu items you typically find at most Harare restaurants”.

restaurants.name: Alpha Restaurant and Grill
restaurants.description: Alpha Restaurant and Grill on Birmingham Road is known locally for the kota, a stuffed bread favourite. Bion (March 2026) said the food “hits especially if you are into proper street style meals like kota done right”, in a spot with a “laid back outdoor feel”. Zembe (August 2025) ordered rice with grilled boerewors and found the portions “quite generous and good value for”.

restaurants.name: Amanzi
addresses: Amanzi Lodge, 1 Masasa Lane, Kambanji (off Drew Road), Harare
restaurants.description: Amanzi sits inside Amanzi Lodge in Kambanji, and reviewers treat it as a destination for birthdays and date nights as much as dinner. Liz (September 2025) “loved the pond and bull frogs out front”, and Anotida (June 2026) called a birthday stay there wonderful, from the room to the restaurant itself.

restaurants.name: Amaru Bar
restaurants.description: Amaru Bar in Mutare is a newer outdoor spot built around braai, beers and good company. Mamukeleni (January 2022) called it “Great for braai, beers and good company” and rated the service amazing, and Zvikomborero (January 2021) found “great potential” in a new outdoor spot with friendly staff and management.

restaurants.name: Amulonga Restaurant – A'Zambezi River Lodge
addresses: A'Zambezi River Lodge, 308 Parkway Drive, Victoria FallsBreakfast, lunch and dinner daily
restaurants.description: An open-air thatched restaurant at the front of A'Zambezi River Lodge with a wrap-around deck metres from the Zambezi. It offers buffet and à la carte menus including traditional African dishes, with live African music and dancing most nights; the lodge's smaller Sebastian's restaurant serves à la carte dinners.

restaurants.name: Anandas
restaurants.description: Anandas is a casual restaurant found in Harare. It has 14 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Annalie's Cafè/Restaurant
restaurants.description: Annalie's Cafe on Second Street in Mutare is built around a quiet garden reviewers call an escape from the city. Larry (April 2026) praised the curry and rice and called the place “A real treasure!”, while Alik (July 2026) found the masala chai “as good as any you'll get in India with a strong ginger kick”.

restaurants.name: Antelope Park
addresses: Antelope Park, off Bulawayo Road, Gweru
restaurants.description: Private game reserve 15 km from central Gweru with a thatched, open-sided dining room overlooking the dam, serving buffet-style breakfasts, lunches and dinners that mix Zimbabwean and international dishes. A separate coffee shop and café offers burgers, toasted sandwiches, pizzas, pastries, milkshakes and coffee on a shaded terrace, and day visitors are welcome.

restaurants.name: Army Shalets
restaurants.description: Army Shalets sits on the banks of the Zambezi outside Victoria Falls, and reviewers come mostly for the setting and the braai. Dani (June 2019) described a restaurant and bar with a “big terrace in front of the Zambezi River” and a grill that's “always fired”, whether guests order food or bring their own meat.

restaurants.name: Aroma Caffè
restaurants.description: Aroma Caffè in Chisipite is an Italian restaurant, and reviewers keep coming back for the ravioli. Ray (July 2024) wrote that the ravioli with tomato sauce was “so fresh and flavorful you won't find better even in Italy,” and Sanguita (December 2022) always orders it “with napolitana and sage and butter sauce.” Aldo (January 2022) called it “the only restaurant in Harare which truly serves Italian dishes cooked divinely.”

restaurants.name: ArtiSana Gallery Café
addresses: 20 Julius Nyerere Way, Avenues, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Vibrant coffee shop, foodie spot and wine bar nestled in the colourful and relaxed ambience of the National Gallery. restaurants.name: Asian basket
restaurants.description: Asian Basket in Mutare serves sushi and pan-Asian dishes from a modest storefront that several reviewers say is easy to miss. Cleo (February 2026) found the sushi portions “huge” and “definitley worth it”, with service that was “prompt and efficient”. Godwills (August 2025) agreed the food is nice but felt the restaurant “needs more marketing and exposure”, having barely known it existed.

restaurants.name: B24 Chicken
restaurants.description: B24 Chicken Kariba gets a small, mixed set of reviews that mostly track improvement over time. Blessing (2023) complained of “Poor customer care service and the chicken needs to improve”, but later visits reported change: Richard (June 2023) found the place had “improved their service and food as well”, and Audrey (2025) agreed that “Now the food is delicious”.

restaurants.name: B24 Chicken
restaurants.description: B24 Chicken Marondera is a restaurant in Marondera. It holds a 3.9/5 rating from 11 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: Backyard BBQ
restaurants.description: Cooking up authentic smoked meats and cooking up your fave comfort foods in our backyard. Available every weekend with limited stocks. Special orders available on request. restaurants.name: Baines Restaurant
restaurants.description: Baines sits right on the Zambezi in Victoria Falls, and the river view is the first thing most reviewers mention. Alanna (January 2026) wrote there is “nothing like sitting on their expansive deck under the African full moon,” and Mark (April 2026) watched “the full moon rise over a Zambezi river that was at record volume.” Leo (July 2026) added that the drive out includes a free game viewing that turned up “a hippo and a bush buck.”

restaurants.name: Bajayi Banzala
restaurants.description: Bajayi Banzala is a small, no-frills local eatery in Victoria Falls, run by three young women who do the cooking. Simona (August 2026) described “typical food lovely cooked by 3 young girls.” Stuart (September 2026) said the meal “rivalled the best of the fancy places,” though found the T-bone “quite thin” and “tough.”

restaurants.name: Balmain Supasanx
restaurants.description: Balmain Supasanx is a restaurant in Masvingo. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Banff Lodge
restaurants.description: Banff Lodge in Hillside functions as both hotel and restaurant, and staff get named often for going out of their way. Matt (June 2026) credited Lisa and Prince for good service, and Titus (August 2022) said “Lisa the manager looked after us” on a stay Titus plans to repeat.

restaurants.name: Baobab Duty Free Restaurant
restaurants.description: A restaurant within the Baobab Duty Free complex at Beitbridge Border Post, officially opened in May 2026. The facility combines duty-free retail with hospitality services for travellers crossing the border.

restaurants.name: Baobab Hotel
restaurants.description: A colonial-era hilltop hotel in Hwange town with a restaurant, a bar and a palm-shaded terrace looking over the town. The menu includes English-style dishes such as cheese cubes rolled in bacon and burgers with chips.

restaurants.name: Batonka Guest Lodge
restaurants.description: Batonka Guest Lodge in Victoria Falls runs a dinner menu that changes nightly, and reviewers mention it alongside the accommodation. Cheryl (June 2026) singled out the apple crumble as “a favorite” after praising the chefs “for their daily changed dinner menu”.

restaurants.name: Beach House
restaurants.description: Beach House sits at Borrowdale Racecourse, built around a sand-floor, beach-themed setting that reviewers mention as much as the food. Christoph (October 2025) called it a “beach feeling in the middle of the city” and recommends visiting for sunset. Sushi comes up again and again: Natasha (December 2023) wrote “their sushi is to die for”, and Rachel (February 2026) picked out “their pizza and Mexican sushi” from the menu.

restaurants.name: Bean There Restaurant
restaurants.description: Bean There Cafe is about being different trying new things and at the same time keeping it relaxed and a place where the whole family can come. restaurants.name: Beerbab Brewpub and Brewery
restaurants.description: Beerbab on Lawley Road is where Victoria Falls locals drink, a block off the main street and away from the tourist bars. Reviewers describe cold, cheap beer, a pool table and Zimbabwean rumba on the sound system. Warren (October 2022) called it the place “to hang with the locals and play some pool”, with “best prices for very cold beer”.

restaurants.name: Bekays
restaurants.description: Bekays on De Jager Avenue in central Marondera serves Zimbabwean dishes and everyday cafe fare, and reviewers describe simple food done well. Gladys (2022) had “Lovely food cooked to perfection” served with a “variety of condiments”, and Mike (2020) called it home to the “Best chips Zimbabwe” while passing through town.

restaurants.name: Bespoke by niche
addresses: 18 Northwood Rise, Mount Pleasant, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Upmarket events and Catering company with online blog. restaurants.name: Bevelinos Ristorante
restaurants.description: Bevelinos Ristorante in Harare pairs Italian dishes with a bar and TVs, drawing a mix of daters and regulars for platters and pasta. Michael (July 2024) called it “an awesome place for lunch or dates” with food that is “immaculate”, and Dennis (June 2019) said it sells “the cheapest and most exotic platter in town”.

restaurants.name: Bhello City Foods
restaurants.description: Bhello City Foods on Julius Nyerere Way is a CBD chips-and-chicken counter that reviewers treat as a Harare institution. Sikho (September 2023) described a short queue that “won't even last for a minute” before diners get “extra hot spicy tasty chips”, plus a seating area under shade and even a cloak room with showers and toilets. Ben (February 2021) called it value for money, saying a dollar buys chips in an “unbelievable” portion.

restaurants.name: Big Mundus Restaurant
restaurants.description: Big Mundus Restaurant in Masvingo's Clipsham Views is a new establishment, and several reviewers flag long waits for food. Rochelle (August 2026) said “food took 45 minutes to be served”, and Ruvimbo (August 2026) waited longer still, only to find “the steak and pork chops were burnt”. Jayy (July 2026) “waited a very long time for our food” with no appetisers or drinks offered in the meantime, though called the food itself worth it.

restaurants.name: Bistro 41
addresses: Trauma Centre Borrowdale, cnr Breach & Kingsmead Roads, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: Bistro 41 sits at Trauma Centre Borrowdale, and several reviewers mention the setting before the menu. Nicole (2025) loved the ambience, calling it “so picturesque”, and Chamaine (February 2026) rated the decorations as “very nice” alongside food Chamaine scored “a 10/10”. Girmay (June 2026) had a more mixed take, finding the wooden tables paired with cheap metal chairs and the space open to the elements, though the walk-in impression was “excellent”.

restaurants.name: Bistro Grill N Wash
restaurants.description: Bistro Grill n Wash on First Street in Mutare pairs a grill restaurant with a car wash, and reviewers treat it as a family spot for hot, freshly cooked food. Cybert (June 2026) liked the pork chop and the night view, recommending it for family, kids and even a partner, and Agnes (June 2026) singled out the prawns as “so delicious”.

restaurants.name: Bistro Veldemeers
addresses: Italian Club, 197 Enterprise Road, Chisipite, Harare
restaurants.description: Bistro Veldemeers sits in the grounds of the Italian Club in Chisipite, and reviewers keep coming back for the garden as much as the food. Grace (July 2024) said “the greenery does it for me”, and Renée (January 2024) called it a must when in town, naming avocado toast as a favourite breakfast order and adding that the pizza oven means “you can really taste the difference”.

restaurants.name: Bliss Restaurant
restaurants.description: Located in Masvingo, Bliss Restaurant is a restaurant. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Blu Marble Lodges and Resort
restaurants.description: An upmarket lodge in Morningside that opened in August 2025 in the renovated former home of Senator Nolan Makombe. Its facilities include a restaurant, a massage parlour and a swimming pool.

restaurants.name: Bolero
restaurants.description: Bolero on the A2 outside Harare combines a bar with sports viewing, and reviewers describe entertainment more than any standout dish. Henry (2019) liked the sports bar, billiards table and “grooving music”, calling drinks “a bit pricy” but the service worth it. Herbert (2019) called it a “Good Bar and friendly staff” but asked for a no-smoking section, since cigarette smoke affected the visit.

restaurants.name: Bolima Family Restaurant
addresses: 8 Aerodrome Road, cnr Umsasa Street, Mutare
restaurants.description: Bolima Family Restaurant in Mutare's Utopia suburb has built a following on its prawns and its atmosphere. Taurai (October 2025) called them “Tastiest prawns I ever ate”, and Rumbidzai (October 2025) agreed they were “Best prawns I have tested so far”, adding that pets are welcome. Ngonidzashe (June 2025) ordered grilled bream and fried rice and declared it “Mutare's best”, with credit going to the bar man's cocktails too.

restaurants.name: Bombai
restaurants.description: Bombai is a restaurant found in Victoria Falls. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Boss Cafe
addresses: 60 Bedford Road, King George Rd, Harare
restaurants.description: Boss Cafe on Bedford Road draws praise for its setting and staff, though service speed is a recurring complaint. Ephias (2023) called it “one of the better looking cafes I've been to” with piano music adding to a relaxed atmosphere, but noted the food “took quite a while to come.” Tadiwa (September 2026) agreed, having “Waited for too long considering there weren’t many people around” despite the food itself being great.

restaurants.name: BOYZCANCOOK
addresses: Stand No. 088, The Business Hub (Showgrounds, Harare
restaurants.description: BOYZCANCOOK, based at the Business Hub in the Harare Showgrounds, gets consistent praise for its kebabs and burgers. Tendai (2025) said “The beef chilli kebabs and the Burgers are out of this World”, and Lloyd (2025) found “The food was excellent, staff were very attentive” in a relaxed setting. Rosegold (2025) thanked “The host with the most Mr Nyandoro” for a well-run visit.

restaurants.name: Bradley Gardens Lodge
restaurants.description: Bradley Gardens Lodge in Gweru gets consistent praise for its garden setting and staff, with reviewers naming individual team members. Zadzisai (February 2026) called Lebohang's service “incredibly kind, helpful, and went above and beyond”, and Tendai (September 2024) reviewed the coffee menu on its own terms, describing Miriam's mochachino as “The perfect blend of rich, velvety chocolate and smooth espresso.”

restaurants.name: Brooks Cafe.
addresses: Shop 3, Zonkizizwe Shopping Centre, Hillside Road, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Brooks is a Bulawayo brasserie built around coffee, breakfast and homemade pies. Alan (January 2026) called it “Deservedly one of the best places for a light meal in Bulawayo”, noting the Hollandaise sauce and most of the menu is made on site, and Takudzwa (May 2026) has the pepper steak pie on repeat, saying it “had me in a chokehold for the past few months”.

restaurants.name: Brooks Cafe & Deli
addresses: Shop 11, Elephant's Walk Shopping & Artist Village, 273 Adam Stander Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Brooks Cafe & Deli sits in the gardens of Elephant's Walk, and breakfast is the reason most reviewers go. Johnny (August 2026) called it the “Best avocado toast I've had!” and thanked waiter Chris by name. Karel (November 2025), visiting with friends from four different countries, described “perfectly cooked eggs, fresh ingredients, generous portions, and a great variety of options”.

restaurants.name: Buffalo cafe
restaurants.description: Buffalo Café sits on the balcony of Victoria Falls Safari Lodge overlooking a waterhole, and reviewers come mainly for the view. Isa (April 2026) called it “one of the best sunsets I've ever seen” and noted the coffee “comes as a full pot—impossible to finish.” Russell (August 2024) had elephants show up during dinner and found the “Oxtail for dinner was excellent.”

restaurants.name: Buffalo Creek Spur (Sam Levy's Village)
addresses: Shops 1–3, Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale Road, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: Buffalo Creek Spur sits next to the cinemas at Sam Levy's Village and was the first Spur of the brand's Zimbabwe relaunch in 2021. The menu covers steaks, burgers, ribs, wings and breakfasts, and there is a supervised indoor play area and an outdoor deck.

restaurants.name: Buffalo Hills Spur Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Buffalo Hills Spur in Hillside is a family-friendly branch of the chain, and its reviews read almost like a staff roll call, with Snowy, Lindsay, Tyrese, Proud, Smilo and Tiatu each thanked by name for looking after a specific table. Thando (June 2026) was talked through the menu by waitress Tapiwa, who “suggested the tomahawk and I have since returned to consume it again.”

restaurants.name: Buffalo Ridge Spur (Highland Park)
addresses: Highland Park Mall (Phase 2, first floor), ED Mnangagwa Road, Lewisam, Harare
restaurants.description: Buffalo Ridge Spur at Highland Park Mall is the family-friendly steak chain outlet, and reviewers name their server almost every time. Tanyaradzwa (August 2026) had Melissa, who was “so friendly, attentive, and professional”, and Ignasio (June 2026) got “the warmest reception” from Kelvin.

restaurants.name: Bukhara Indian Restaurant
addresses: First Floor, Big B Mall, Bishop Gaul Avenue, Belvedere, Harare
restaurants.description: Bukhara in Belvedere's Big B Mall serves North Indian food, and reviewers rate the biryani and kebabs highly. Tatenda (2022) called it home to “the best Indian cuisine (and hyderabad biriyani) I've tasted in Zim,” and Ephias (2023) agreed it serves “the best Indian food” at prices “reasonably priced although their beverages are a tad pricey.” Victoria (2023), trying Indian food for the first time, ordered “the chicken 69, chicken biryani and the Gohst mutton dish” served in s

restaurants.name: Bumi Hills Safari Lodge
addresses: Bumi Hills, Lake Kariba (approx. 1.5 h flight from Harare; not in Kariba town)
restaurants.description: Bumi Hills Safari Lodge sits above Lake Kariba, reachable by light aircraft rather than road, and reviewers treat it as the highlight of a longer safari. Meals get specific praise: Priv 1st Class (March 2023) called it “banging meal after banging meal” and added that “Noone makes a carrot cake like Chef Sunshine!”.

restaurants.name: Bush Cusine Jetty
restaurants.description: Located in Victoria Falls, Bush Cusine Jetty is a restaurant. It has 5 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Bushman Rock Safaris
addresses: (Along Mutare Rd) Bushman Rock Safari, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Nestled in the granite outcrops above a bend in the Nyamasanga River, Valley View Lodge affords breathtaking views over Bushman Rock Estate. The beautifully manicured gardens and rolling lawns are encircled by a bubbling seasonal stream, a network of small lakes, and the vine-covered valley. Hidden amongst tall indigenous trees, the thatched lodges offer complete privacy and take the form of double, twin or family suites, all decorated in a subtle African theme. With their pr

restaurants.name: Bushtracks Express Dinner Train
addresses: Bushtracks Station, Victoria Falls (runs to the Victoria Falls Bridge)Departs Tue &
restaurants.description: A historic steam train dinner experience on the Zimbabwe side that travels to the Victoria Falls Bridge for sunset before serving a multi-course dinner on board. Select drinks and transfers from Victoria Falls accommodation are included; smart casual dress applies.

restaurants.name: Byten Restaurant
restaurants.description: Byten Restaurant is a restaurant found in Harare. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Café
addresses: 1008 Light Industry, Bulawayo–Victoria Falls Road, Hwange
restaurants.description: A roadside café on the Bulawayo–Victoria Falls road in Hwange, serving local and international dishes throughout the day.

restaurants.name: Cafe 1 Eleven

restaurants.name: Café Alana
restaurants.description: Cafe Alana in Mutare's Utopia suburb doubles as a daytime dining spot and a nighttime venue, with tables by the pool that Tafadzwa (September 2025) noted stay open even if the gate looks closed, as long as you hoot for attention. Ryan (March 2026) called the food fresh and delectable, arriving in under 45 minutes despite a large order, and praised a waiter who gave good advice on the menu.

restaurants.name: Café de Paris
addresses: 47 Churchill Avenue, Alex Park, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Cafe de Paris in Alexandra Park serves French pastries and breakfasts, and croissants are the recurring order. Ismail (June 2026) called them “marvellous”, and Richard (April 2026) thanked the owner directly, writing “Brovo Marc, you've built up a brilliant cafe!”. Brian (October 2025) had the chicken fricassee for lunch, calling it “nice/filling”, while sitting outside under the trees. Grace (2025) found service “very fast, almost a bit too fast” in a quiet, uncrowded settin

restaurants.name: Cafe Delights
addresses: Angwa (S.J. Khama) Street, between Nelson Mandela & Kwame Nkrumah Avenues, Harare
restaurants.description: Cafe Delights is the Chop Chop group's budget café on Angwa Street in the Harare CBD, in the space that was Chop Chop Angwa until late 2024. The group calls it its most affordable brand: $5 pizzas, a $6 signature burger, a quarter chicken and chips for $5 and fresh doughnuts at two for $1, alongside wraps, sandwiches, coffee, Frezzos and mocktails.

restaurants.name: Café Lux
restaurants.description: Café Lux on McChlery Avenue draws praise for its ribs, pizza and platters, and several reviewers describe it as a favourite spot in Harare. Beatrice (July 2023) called it the “best ribs in harare so far”, and Victor (August 2025) rated the pizza “The Best Pizza 🍕 piece in Town”. In a February 2023 review, Abigail named fried rice with grilled chicken breast in white sauce a favourite, and praised the delivery service for arriving on time with food “prepared to perfection”.

restaurants.name: Café Momo
addresses: Rhodesville Shopping Centre, 32 Rhodesville Ave, Harare
restaurants.description: Café Momo in Rhodesville does not actually serve the Nepali or Indian dumpling it's named for. Max (2024) noted “they don't serve actual momo here” but still found it “pretty cool” as a regular restaurant menu. Dorothea (March 2026) praised an “Excellent breakfast and coffee” that was “Fresh, tasty and excellent value”.

restaurants.name: cafe nush
addresses: Avondale Shopping Centre, King George Road, Harare
Shop 1, Highland Park, Arcturus Road, Harare
restaurants.description: Cafe Nush in Avondale Shopping Centre has kept a consistent standard for over a decade, reviewers say, whether they come for breakfast, a working lunch or coffee. Edward (May 2026) called it the “Best breakfast in harare”, and Aurora (September 2025) said the chicken wrap “is to die for”. Café Nush at Village Walk has a pleasant setting, though several recent reviewers flag rising prices and thin staffing. Rachel (2025) found it “often feels understaffed, which means service

restaurants.name: Cafe Pistachio
addresses: Shop 19 (by the clock tower), Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: Café Pistachio in Sam Levy's Village is known for pastries and cakes. Denice (2024) said the avocado, chicken and feta toastie “was delicious” and “just looked beautiful”, and Samantha (2025) tried the bao bun, finding the pulled pork filling “definitely a lot tastier than the ones I've been having lately” though the bun itself “massive”.

restaurants.name: Cafe Society
addresses: First Street & Jason Moyo Avenue, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Restaurant in Harare, Zimbabwe. restaurants.name: Cafe Sol
restaurants.description: Café Sol is a cafe in Kwekwe. It holds a 4.4/5 rating from 10 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: Café Sungano
restaurants.description: Café Sungano on Seventh Street in Gweru is a small neighbourhood spot that regulars have folded into their daily routine. Lovet (January 2026) wrote simply that “my day begins at cafe Sungano”, and Tinaye (January 2026) described a morning espresso there as having “that zing to it”. Kudakwashe (January 2026) called it “nice and cozy, perfect for a family outing, celebration or any other day”.

restaurants.name: Cafe10
restaurants.description: Cafe10 sits just off the Bulawayo Road on the edge of Chegutu, and Donald (April 2026), on a third visit, called it “exceptional,” praising a chef who shows “some of the best culinary talent Zimbabwe has to offer” in a setting Donald called “a hidden gem.” Clement (April 2026) agreed, calling it “probably the best chef in Mashonaland,” but flagged a practical snag: no “swipe machine or ecocash payment system,” with a premium charged on ecocash.

restaurants.name: CaféNion
restaurants.description: CaféNion at Arundel Village in Harare has a European corner-café feel, and reviewers name specific treats. Alexa (2024) said “i am obsessed with the sausage rolls,” and Ruvarashe (2022) found the carrot cake “absolutely divine,” though wished “they made the slices bigger.” Gurvinder (2024) was won over by baklava that was “delectable.” Andreas (August 2026) liked sitting outside “on a Saturday morning” with coffee, saying it “feels like im back in Greece.”

restaurants.name: Cake Fairy
restaurants.description: Cake Fairy Avondale earns mixed reviews, with the food generally rated fine and the service less so. Lucius (June 2026) admitted the meat platter was “actually great and well-cooked” and the atmosphere and music were excellent, but found flies at the table and no bug candles on offer. Anotida (March 2026) called the food “average but tasty” and praised a pleasant, helpful waiter.

restaurants.name: Cakesmith’s Confections
restaurants.description: Cakesmith's Confections in Mutare has long been known for its cupcakes and doughnuts. Nakai (2024) called it “The best confectionery in town”, and Cakes Kuda (2025) had a pie “pipping hot and delicious” alongside “the real redvelvet cake of all times”.

restaurants.name: Captain's Cove
restaurants.description: Captain's Cove overlooks the water on Buffalo Drive in Kariba, and value is the theme reviewers keep coming back to. K (March 2022) laid out the range, from “beef stew with sadaza and relish to U$10 for 350g of tender Zimbabwean T-bone, Rump or Sirloin, cooked to perfection.” Susmitha (August 2024) had grilled fish with chips and salad and found the “Chicken schitzel was tasty as well.”

restaurants.name: Caribbea Bay Hotel
restaurants.description: Caribbea Bay's restaurant and bar sit on the shore of Lake Kariba, and the dish reviewers name most is the kapenta. Nyasha (June 2023) tried the “fresh kapenta coated with eggs” and called it “the bomb”, and Wadzanai (October 2022) had a first taste of “batter kapenta” while praising the lake view from the restaurant. Breakfast gets similar attention: Mthulisi (April 2026) had “Fresh and nice breakfast”, and Fyodor (November 2022) enjoyed a “breakfast buffet” with a view of t

restaurants.name: Carne Casa
addresses: Cnr 11th Avenue & George Silundika Street, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Carne Casa is a Portuguese steak house on 11th Avenue in Bulawayo, and reviewers talk about the chalk artwork covering one wall almost as often as they talk about the espetada and steak of the day. Bhekinkosi (May 2024) recommends “their steak breakfast if you want to recover from a bad hangover,” and Kudzanai (November 2020) kept it short: “The steak is brilliant.” Talent (2022) had a beef steak that was “juicy and tender” and noted that the chef “came through to check on us

restaurants.name: Casa Mia
restaurants.description: Italian Cuisine at its best! Thin based wood fired pizza, fresh home made pasta, live music evenings. Family, fun and friendly. restaurants.name: Casa Mia Ristorante Pizzeria
addresses: 100 King George Road, cnr Aberdeen Road, Avondale, Harare
restaurants.description: Casa Mia in Avondale is an Italian restaurant built around a garden, and reviewers keep coming back for Sunday lunches with live music. Ska (December 2022) called the kalamari and tiramisu “to die for”, and Andrea (October 2023) found out the restaurant would “have live music on Sunday evenings”, a rarity when most other places are closed.

restaurants.name: Cavery Restaurant
addresses: Telephone Exchange, Simon Mazorodze Road, Mutare
restaurants.description: Cavery Restaurant, tucked next to the Telephone Exchange on Simon Mazorodze Road in Mutare, is known for braai and traditional Zimbabwean plates rather than atmosphere. Ann (February 2023) simply noted it has great braai chicken, and Bruce agreed in a 2022 review that the braaied pork and chicken are good. Justin (June 2021) recommended the traditional beef and sadza, and Tafadzwa (July 2021) added a reminder not to skip the fish.

restaurants.name: CC Prime
addresses: Shop 10, The Concourse Building, Nelson Mandela Road, KwekweMon Closed
restaurants.description: Restaurant and bar in The Concourse Building on Nelson Mandela Road with a broad menu of breakfasts, burgers, wraps, flame-grilled steaks and ribs, pasta, stir-fries and seafood such as bream and prawns. There are also platters, a kids' menu, cocktails and coffee.

restaurants.name: Chai Cafe
restaurants.description: Chai Cafe on Churchill Avenue is an airy, quiet spot reviewers use for brunch or for working over good wifi. Ruvarashe, in 2023, called it “really good and at surprising pricing” and singled out “the best chocolate milkshake I've had in a long time”. Cynthia (December 2025) agreed the milkshake was good and praised “very fast service”.

restaurants.name: Chang Thai
addresses: Arundel Village, 113 Norfolk Road, Mount Pleasant, Harare

restaurants.name: Chapungu Grill
restaurants.description: Chapungu Grill in Norton is known locally for its grilled chicken. Nate (2024) called it “the best grilled Chicken in the Nation” at the most affordable price, adding that the Chapungu Sauce is what keeps customers coming back. Victor (2024) found the food “affordable and well cooked”, the toilets always clean, and the grounds kid-friendly with swings and plenty of parking. Kay (March 2026) agreed, calling it “Really good food and great value, nice atmosphere”, and Wayne (Mar

restaurants.name: Chatters Restaurant & Bar (Cresta Lodge)
addresses: Cresta Lodge, cnr Samora Machel Avenue East & Mutare Road, Msasa, HarareBreakfast, lunch and dinner daily
restaurants.description: The restaurant and bar at Cresta Lodge beside Mukuvisi Woodland, serving a breakfast buffet and à la carte Zimbabwean and international dishes with a veranda over the gardens. Since May 2026 it has run a themed Chef's Table series of tapas-and-wine, curry-and-cocktail and pasta nights.

restaurants.name: Chelsea Bee's
restaurants.description: Chelsea Bee's on Fernleigh Road is a family restaurant built around a garden and play area. Precious (February 2026) had “a perfect family breakfast” thanks to server Brendon and the chef, and after trying the pizza for the first time said “they have the Best Pizza in Town.” Yolanda (December 2025) was told “the Friday fish special is incredible.”

restaurants.name: Chicken Hotspot
restaurants.description: Chicken Hotspot in Harare draws praise for its fried chicken and chicken burger. Dylan (June 2023) called it “the best chicken hotspot ever” and said the chicken “is surely hotspot the taste is great cooked well and served hot”. Onias (January 2023) went further, calling it “The best chicken burger ever on earth”, and Simbarashe (July 2022) also “Loved the chicken burger and chips”.

restaurants.name: Chicken Hotspot
restaurants.description: Chicken Hotspot Marondera on Main Street serves burgers, wraps and T-bone in a small sit-in space. Retzvad (2025) tried the “$7 wrap, double beef burger and the tbone and chips meal” and had “No complains”, while Filbert (May 2026) “Liked the food” despite a “kinda small space” in a busy area.

restaurants.name: Chicken Matty
restaurants.description: Chicken Matty in Bindura serves fast food chicken and chips in a style close to Chicken Inn. Tanaka (2023) found “good pieces of chicken” and plenty of chips, though noted “the huge step to reach the counter is too high up” for wheelchair users. Martin (2020) said “their services are good” after many visits, but warned that “finding change for your money isn't that good”.

restaurants.name: Chicken Shack
restaurants.description: Chicken Shack in Masvingo works as a stopover on long trips as much as a destination. Njabulo's July 2023 review called it “Good stop over joint when you on a long trip to Mutare” with clean toilets, and Owen (June 2024) described it as “Good refreshing place away from town” with traditional food and a variety of relishes.

restaurants.name: Chico Chicu's
addresses: Shop 12, The Qube Lifestyle Centre, 67 Selous Avenue, Harare
restaurants.description: New Mexican-inspired kitchen at The Qube on Selous Avenue, opened in September 2026. Burritos, tacos, quesadillas and nachos sit alongside grilled chicken in mex original, hot or lemon and herb, plus fried pollo pieces, T-bone steak and loaded fries. There is outside seating, and orders can be placed on WhatsApp.

restaurants.name: Chimanimani Hotel
restaurants.description: Chimanimani Hotel, a colonial-era building in the village centre, splits reviewers between the setting and its upkeep. Gm597 (2016) praised “the mountain ranges and the majestic vegetation” surrounding it, though the power went “on and off” overnight. KingMory (2022) said the place “looks dilapidated” but found staff “quite hospitable” and enjoyed “well cooked yummy pork chops” at pocket-friendly prices. More recent stays are harsher: TT (2025) found “Poorly kept grounds” and

restaurants.name: CHINA GARDEN ZW
restaurants.description: China Garden in Milton Park is known for private dining rooms, useful for family gatherings, business meetings and birthdays, and reviewers mention booking them well ahead. Tafadzwa (October 2024) called it the best place for private time with colleagues or family, and Tatenda's 2020 review advised booking early because the rooms are popular.

restaurants.name: 聚金楼饭店，China Town Restaurant
restaurants.description: 聚金楼饭店，China Town Restaurant brings Chinese to Gweru. It has 7 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Chinhoyi Caves Motel Restaurant
addresses: Chinhoyi Caves Recreational Park, Harare–Chirundu Road, Chinhoyi
restaurants.description: The ZimParks-run motel beside the Chinhoyi Caves, a common stop on the road between Harare and Kariba. It has a casual restaurant serving lunch and dinner daily.

restaurants.name: Chipala Cultural Experience
restaurants.description: Chipala Cultural Experience pairs dinner with a traditional performance in Victoria Falls. Stephen (September 2023) called it a “Great place to experience African cuisine in an African setting”, and Angela (December 2016) recalled watching the “traditional Makishi Dance” during dinner. Tapiwa (March 2026) rated the food and music highly, and Benedict (February 2017) described it as an authentic, traditional experience.

restaurants.name: Chop Chop
addresses: Cnr Alpes Road & Harare Drive, Pomona, Harare
Corner Herbert Chitepo and Fife Avenue, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Chop Chop in Avondale runs an all-day breakfast and grill menu, and reviewers keep naming the burgers. Daniel (February 2025) called it “The best burgers in Harare” after trying the double beef and double lamb, and Farai (September 2023) agreed the burgers “are just amazing”. LAH (November 2024) goes for the deboned beef ribs and rated the mushroom toast starter highly, while Lideo (May 2026) had “Best frued fish” served with egg fried rice, gravy and mushroom soup. Chop Chop

restaurants.name: Chop Chop Grill House
addresses: 256 Herbert Chitepo Avenue, cnr Fife Avenue, Harare
restaurants.description: Chop Chop Grill House on Herbert Chitepo Avenue has been a steak destination for years, and the T-bone comes up again and again. Marius (February 2020) ordered a 500g cut and found it “prepared to perfection”, and Edward (January 2021) called the steaks “tender and juicy and grilled to perfection”. Daniel (May 2025) put it simply: the burgers and steaks are “the best in town”.

restaurants.name: Ciao Bella
addresses: Kiosk 7, Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale Road, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: Ciao Bella Pizza caters events from Sam Levy's Village as well as running its own takeaway there. Clare (September 2026) had them cater a home gathering and thanked “Richard and his team for the wonderful service”, and Paula (May 2026) said the team catering the 40th birthday party was “very reliable” and arrived early to set up.

restaurants.name: CJ's Cafe & Takeaway
restaurants.description: CJ's Cafe & Takeaway in Marondera is a stop for coffee and burgers on the road through town. Allister (June 2026) called it “The coffee shop you absolutely should go to on your way through Marondera”, and Eaugen (February 2026) named “the best ginger lemonade in Marondera”. Tat (March 2026) found “Generous potions of delicious food”, while Tinevimbo (August 2026) warned against the ribs, describing a sauce that was “just soup”.

restaurants.name: Classic Desserts
restaurants.description: Classic Desserts on Churchill Avenue is known for its cakes, and specific items keep coming up. Tawonga (2025) ordered “a rich chocolate cake and a chicken mayo sandwich” that “blew our minds away,” and Tariro (2025) called the “salted caramel cheesecake” delicious despite a rough visit.

restaurants.name: Clevers Hotel
restaurants.description: Clevers Hotel in Chiredzi takes walk-in diners for a hot buffet breakfast, and reviewers are more consistent about the grounds than the kitchen. L Austin (2024) called the toasted cucumber sandwich “EXCELLENT!!” and suggested it be added to the regular menu, since it was only made off-menu on request.

restaurants.name: Clevers Lakeview Resort (formerly Norma Jeane's)
restaurants.description: A lakeside resort overlooking Lake Mutirikwi, built around the homestead of Murray MacDougal and about ten minutes' drive from Great Zimbabwe. The restaurant and verandah serve home-style full breakfasts, à la carte lunches and a set-menu dinner. Formerly known as Norma Jeane's Lakeview Resort and, before that, Inn on Great Zimbabwe.

restaurants.name: Cobblestone
addresses: 12 Normandy Road, StoneArch Shopping, Belgravia, Harare
restaurants.description: Cobblestone in Belgravia's StoneArch Shopping runs an upscale grill and seafood menu, but reviewers write almost entirely about the waiters, calling out staff by name in nearly every review. Melinda (April 2026) rated the food and service 10/10 after a birthday dinner that ran from tacos and prawn cocktail to blackened salmon, everything “cooked to perfection with real ingredients”. Douglas (July 2026) called the whole team “really good at they work” and the ambience “100/10”

restaurants.name: Coco Mia Restaurant
restaurants.description: Coco Mia at Sam Levy's is a pink, girly-themed cafe that reviewers say is worth a visit regardless of taste in decor. W (July 2026) called the food and coffee “excellent” and said “real men don't mind” the pink, and Priv (2025) said “The cheesecake has taken my heart captive”.

restaurants.name: CoCoNut Lounge
addresses: 359 Glen Helen Way, Glen Lorne, Harare
restaurants.description: CoCoNut Lounge in Glen Lorne opened in March 2026 as a restaurant, bar and coffee spot with a private VVIP section. Nichola (September 2026) found a “friendly atmosphere, great menu and well priced”, with staff member Kuda making the visit welcoming. B (May 2026) called it a “Cool restaurant with a solid shisha program”, where “drinks are extremely reasonably priced” and the resident DJ is “an old school mix master”.

restaurants.name: Coffee Hub
restaurants.description: Coffee Hub on Coventry Road draws a loyal following in Gweru for its relaxed, chilled setting. Nectar (April 2025) said simply “Their burgers are so nice”, and Vusumuzi (June 2023) had “a fabulous breakfast” alongside great service.

restaurants.name: Coffee.Juice Café
addresses: Shop 30, Ascot Shopping Mall, Milnerton Drive, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Coffee.Juice Café is a small café in Ascot Shopping Mall serving coffee, fresh juices and light bites to shoppers.

restaurants.name: Coffee Republik
restaurants.description: Coffee Republik Bulawayo is a cafe in Makokoba, Bulawayo. It holds a 3.4/5 rating from 14 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: Coffee Republik
restaurants.description: Coffee Republik on Bedford Road in Avondale is Avondale's frappe and milkshake stop. Nkanye (2020) called it “the go to coffee spot in Harare” after a Salted Caramel Frappuccino, and Farai (2021) enjoyed the frappes on a hot day. Garikayi (2021) liked the customer service but found the milkshake machines “extremely loud”. A more recent visit was less smooth: Tafara (January 2026) was told twice, two days running, that frappes were unavailable, though still rated the milkshake

restaurants.name: Coffee Republik
restaurants.description: Kwekwe branch of the Zimbabwean Coffee Republik chain on Amaveni Road, serving espresso drinks, frappes, milkshakes, smoothies and bubble tea. Coffee Republik outlets also sell Airlink flight tickets.

restaurants.name: Coimbra Restaurant
restaurants.description: Coimbra has been serving Portuguese chicken on Selous Avenue for decades, and reviewers keep coming back to the same order: half a chicken, chips and the sauces. Before the menu arrives, the table gets complimentary bread with garlic and peri-peri sauce, and that starter wins people over. Stefan (February 2026) wrote that if “the welcoming bread and sauce doesn't make you fall in love instantly,” the main course will. Mai Juju (November 2025) was blunter about the garlic: “Th

restaurants.name: Comfort Pub and Grill
addresses: Opposite National Railways of Zimbabwe, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Comfort Pub and Grill, opposite the railway station in Victoria Falls, is a locals' spot rather than a tourist one. Marc-Andre (February 2025) called it the “Best local spot out there”, adding it draws “No tourists”. 张世吉 (March 2025) described two bars, a dance floor and a pool table, calling it “A friendly spot where locals gather”.

restaurants.name: Cookhouse Restaurant
restaurants.description: Cookhouse in Bulawayo is a relaxed, homely spot for a quick meal. Khululekani (January 2023) found “Relaxed atmosphere, friendly staff and homely food”, and Audrey (November 2021) enjoyed “fresh food served with smiles”. Stephen (May 2026) agrees it's a good place to grab a quick meal in a relaxed atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Cork Road
restaurants.description: The restaurant is surrounded by shady trees & Plants in the gardens. This is a beautiful outdoor restaurant. The ambiance is lovely, prices are just right and the atmosphere is very relaxed. An ideal place to meet for hot & cold beverages, light meals, tasty lunches, Ice cream & Yoghurts. restaurants.name: Cornilia
restaurants.description: Cornilia on Eighth Street in Gweru is known locally by a different name entirely: Tatenda (October 2018) corrected the listing in the same review, writing “that's not the name of the place. It's clonsilla. Very busy but good”. Tinashe (September 2018) described Fridays there as the night “noone goes back home”, and Boboh (March 2018) recommended it as a “good place for relaxing if you are a pool lover and a non-smoker”. Cornilia is open daily from 6am to 10pm.

restaurants.name: Cosmopolitan VIP Club
restaurants.description: Cosmopolitan VIP Club on Twelfth Avenue runs as a nightclub from 19:00 to 05:00, and reviewers talk about the music, décor and drinks rather than a kitchen. Candy (January 2023) praised “Sexy decor, great music and full range of drinks” and singled out “the comfiest bar stools I've ever sat on.” Stephen (October 2024) liked the interior and noted “they have secure parking so you can enjoy without worrying about your car being broken into.”

restaurants.name: CottonKraal
addresses: Zonkizizwe Shopping Complex, Hillside Road, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: CottonKraal in Bradfield splits into three connected spaces rather than one dining room. Ruvimbo (April 2025) described the kings kraal as “a really cool , romantic place for dinner”, the kraals bar as the spot to catch up with friends, and Cotton as the side of the venue built around music. Blessing (September 2026) had “Amazing Service from Elizabeth” and rated the steak “Juicy steak too.”

restaurants.name: Credo's Fast Food Restaurant
restaurants.description: Credo's Fast Food Restaurant in Mutare serves quick meals with a strong emphasis on customer care and presentation. Bhekinkosi (April 2026) called out “Great customer services” and “Pure aesthetics”, and Mahart, visiting in September 2026, found good service from staff who speak Portuguese, Shona and English.

restaurants.name: Cresta Churchill
addresses: 146 Matopos Road, cnr Moffat Avenue, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Cresta Churchill's food talk centres on its Sunday buffet and breakfast spread. Audrey (July 2026) enjoyed a “Sunday Buffet” that was “fresh, delicious, and beautifully prepared, with a great variety to choose from”, crediting Mr. Tapiwa Makarutse and the team for the service. Leesa (November 2025) had a similar Sunday lunch where “the food was served so orderly and there were plenty choices to choose from such that even my health conscious mom was catered for”, naming the ch

restaurants.name: Croc Foods
restaurants.description: Croc Foods in Beitbridge gets reliable marks for its kitchen. Collins (2024) said simply, “When it comes to food rely on this one ,they can cook and serve”, and Patsimo (2022) called it “The best in town”, noting staff serve customers in Shona, Venda, Ndebele or English as needed.

restaurants.name: Crocodile Motel & Conference Centre
restaurants.description: Crocodile Motel & Conference Centre serves travellers on the Harare–Mutare highway, but recent reviews describe a property in decline. Shadreck (February 2026) called the rooms “terrible” and received a refund after raising concerns the next morning. Allen (December 2025) suggested paving the parking lot and redoing the dining room ceilings.

restaurants.name: Crystal
restaurants.description: Crystal in Bulawayo runs as a nightspot more than a sit-down restaurant, with reviewers talking about the dancefloor, sound system and weekly Varsity Nights rather than any dish. Ngobris (February 2015) called it “the best Night club in skies so far”, loving the environment and sound system, and Vuyisile mentioned looking forward to the Friday Varsity Nights.

restaurants.name: Cultures Resort
addresses: Cnr Chiremba & Southey Roads, Hillside, HarareDaily about 10:00–22:00
restaurants.description: Cultures Resort on Chiremba Road grills and stews traditional African dishes, and reviewers keep returning to the goat. Munyaradzi (July 2022) said simply “Try goat ribs or whole leg” and called the food “just delicious,” while Riri (March 2024) recommended the “goat ribs or the rabbit” and found the portions “abundante.” Ruvarashe (November 2025) noted the braaied meat “comes in a sizzling hot board.”

restaurants.name: CultureXsipcity
restaurants.description: CultureXsipcity is a casual restaurant found in Gweru. It has 5 reviews on Google Maps so far. Priced budget-friendly.

restaurants.name: Curry Leaf Restaurant
restaurants.description: Curry Leaf, tucked into a Harare backyard, specialises in South Indian and Sri Lankan cooking. Ratheesh (April 2026) said chef Mr. Jacob's cooking brings out “genuine South Indian flavors”, and Ratheesh (April 2026) called it “the only place in Harare where you can consistently find such authentic South Indian dishes”.

restaurants.name: Cut Hotel
restaurants.description: The main hotel of the Chinhoyi University of Technology's CUT Hotels group on the Harare–Chirundu highway, with an à la carte restaurant, a contemporary bar and garden function venues. It runs dining promotions such as a $30 Mama's Platter sharing meal.

restaurants.name: CUT Kariba Guest House – The Bistro
restaurants.description: A lakeshore guest house run by CUT Hotels (Chinhoyi University of Technology), close to the dam wall and the Mahombekombe craft markets. Its Bistro serves a full English/Irish breakfast, and there is a pool overlooking the lake.

restaurants.name: Cutty Sark Hotel – Rats Bar & Bistro
restaurants.description: The lakeside bistro and Rats Bar at the historic Cutty Sark, a Kariba landmark dating back to the 1960s and since renovated as a lodge. The bistro serves breakfast, lunch and dinner made fresh daily, while the bar overlooks Lake Kariba and has a new cocktail menu.

restaurants.name: CYNDO'S Kitchen
restaurants.description: CYNDO'S Kitchen in Bulawayo built a following on home-style cooking, with reviewers between 2017 and 2020 consistently praising the food and service. Eric (November 2020) called it home to the “Best burgers in town”, and Mengezi (September 2018) said “I love eating the cultural food from cyndo.”

restaurants.name: Da Guido
addresses: 100 Golden Stairs Road, Mount Pleasant, HarareOpen 7 days
restaurants.description: Da Guido in Mount Pleasant is run by Paula and Francesco, and reviewers describe a family restaurant rather than a formal one. Clive (September 2022) said the family “welcome you with such open arms it feels liking dining with best friends in their own home”. Anna (October 2023), an Italian visitor, ate ravioli with bolognese ragú “like I would have eaten in Italy”.

restaurants.name: Dee & Noe Butchery/Tshisanyama
restaurants.description: Dee & Noe is a butchery and tshisanyama in Bulawayo's CBD: buy the meat from the butcher counter, then have it grilled to order. Kaan (May 2025) described it as a “crazy place” where “a guy is cooking it for you on a wood braai” alongside “very delicious fries.” Thandiwe (March 2023) asked for less seasoning and got meat that was “so delicious and tender,” “not burnt or with too much salt or paprika.”

restaurants.name: Dee & Noe Deli and Grill
restaurants.description: Dee & Noe Deli and Grill in Luveve pairs a butchery with a braai and grill menu, and that format is the draw. Mandla (July 2025) said “The butcheries in the area led by Dee and Noe sell some of the best meats in town”, and Prince (March 2024) liked the process of “choosing the meat to go get the meat prepared for us”. Thulani (June 2023) liked “the concept of bringing pizza to ekasi” at the Luveve branch.

restaurants.name: Déjà vu
restaurants.description: The best coffee in town and scrumptious menu with unparalleled friendly service “One of Bulawayo’s best kept secrets!!” Our emphasis is on quality, consistency and freshly food made daily on site. We have on site, guarded parking; indoor or garden seating, informal, children’s playground. We offer all-day breakfast and lunch alongside coffee and cakes. restaurants.description: Deli-cious Fine Food Emporium at Sam Levy's Village is a regular breakfast and brunch stop. Craig, in 2023, called it “a brilliant meal as always” and noted “the portions are large so we often share”. Zim, in 2022, returns for “the smoothies and choc and carrot cake” and finds the food “always v fresh and filling”.

restaurants.name: Diamond Chicken
restaurants.description: Diamond chicken is a casual restaurant found in Gweru. It has 5 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Dickies Restaurant
restaurants.description: Dickies, on Josiah Tongogara Street in Bulawayo, serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes without a printed menu: staff describe what's available that day. C Ray (July 2026) noted meals mostly run $3 to $5, but found the lack of vegetarian options limiting and confirmed the restaurant doesn't take cards.

restaurants.name: Dripping Well & Grill
restaurants.description: Dripping Well & Grill is a sports bar and grill built around its bar and TV screens. Debbie (2024) described it as “Always lots of customers either supporting the nice long bar, or having food or watching the latest TV sport,” and noted it also hosts “private functions like birthdays or corporate lunches.” Mark (2023) runs a “men's lunch club every Wednesday” there and rates the “Sunday lunches are epic,” thanking staff Gavin and Tracy.

restaurants.name: Dusty Road Township Experience
restaurants.description: Dusty Road runs a fixed-price set menu built around a tour of Chinotimba township and an introduction to Zimbabwean ingredients before the meal. Cat (October 2025) described a “Platter/selection of starters served to table then a buffet of mains that you help yourself and go back back as often as you like”. restaurants.name: Dutch Oven

Rumbi (2025) grew up going there and now brings children who say no other donut “come close to what they got from Dutch Oven”. Di (2023) found it “Just as good as in years past” with “the same doughnut recipe”, calling it “A Gweru icon”. restaurants.name: Dzimbahwe Lodge & Conference Centre
restaurants.description: Dzimbahwe Lodge is an urban lodge and conference centre at the 28km peg on the Harare–Mutare road in Ruwa, with a restaurant and full bar on site.

restaurants.name: Earth Cafe
addresses: Cnr Oak Avenue & 12th Avenue Extension, River Estate, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Earth Café sits off 12th Avenue in Bulawayo's River Estate, leaning into its name with earthy decor and dish names to match. Ryan (2021) found the food “very tasty”, with salads described as “awesome”, though wished for time to try the eclairs and carrot cake too. Slibaziso (2020) appreciated the sanitising stations and the broad sushi-and-breakfast menu, though found the food “nothing mind blowing” for the price.

restaurants.name: Earth Cafe
restaurants.description: Earth Cafe overlooks a small houseboat dock on Impala Drive in Kariba, and reviewers treat it as the best coffee stop in town. Esta (May 2026) called it “The best coffee in Kariba by far”, and Neil (December 2025) described the coffee milkshakes as “perfectly blended, rich, and creamy” with “a robust coffee flavor that wasn't overpowered by sweetness”.

restaurants.name: East 68 Pub & Grill
restaurants.description: East 68 (E68) is a braai place and pub on Esigodini Road known for flame-grilled meats and ribs, with indoor and outdoor seating. It draws a mature crowd, with a DJ and affordable drinks, and appears on Wanderlog's list of Bulawayo's most-mentioned eateries.

restaurants.description: Eland on Justicia Road in Beitbridge draws confident praise from regulars. Thabani (June 2026) called it “the greatest food outlet in Beitbridge,” and Sevias (2022) singled out the kitchen, saying “The one who prepared the meat is a food chef” after finding “The breakfast was wonderful.” Anthony (June 2026), rating it 3 stars, kept it brief: “Can't complain.”

restaurants.name: Elevation Café

restaurants.description: A family café at the Celebration Centre campus on Swan Drive serving breakfasts, burgers, coffee, mocktails and desserts, with indoor and outdoor seating.

restaurants.name: Emagumeni Airport Rd
addresses: Airport Rd, & St Patricks Rd, Harare
restaurants.description: Emagumeni on Airport Road has a vintage theme, with old cars parked around a family-friendly play area. Yemurai (2025) waited a long while for food that turned out “absolutely delicious” and “well worth the wait,” and Itai (November 2025) loved the “Monkey Nuts mocktail” on a first visit for the “vintage vibe” and “lively crowd.” WM (2025) enjoyed the art and welcome but found the wine “not chilled,” writing “the glasses should never have been filled to the top.”

restaurants.name: Epic Restaurant
addresses: Cnr 12th Avenue & Jason Moyo Street, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Epic Restaurant on the corner of 12th Avenue and Jason Moyo Street draws people in for breakfast, pizza and its ice cream. Andile (February 2024) called it the “Best ice cream I've ever had!”, and Tererai (April 2026) singled out the “All-star pizza”. Zembe (July 2025) found the portions generous and the menu wide enough to include a kids menu.

restaurants.name: Exchange Restaurant
restaurants.description: Exchange Restaurant is a restaurant found in Bulawayo. It has 5 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Explorers bar
restaurants.description: Explorers Bar in Harare gets short, positive notes rather than detailed reviews. Vongai (June 2019) called it “Great food, beautiful environment”, and Timmad (June 2018) found it a “great place, fairly crowded”. Luntha (May 2018) summed it up as a “Nice chillout joint. Affordable tooo”.

restaurants.name: Family Choice Restaurant
restaurants.description: Family Choice Restaurant is a restaurant found in Bulawayo. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Fatso Food
restaurants.description: Fatso Food in Mutare's CBD serves home-style Zimbabwean dishes at lunchtime prices. Nathanel (June 2022) called it “One of the few places in Zimbabwe that still do proper Zimbabwean meals”, and Takudzwa (November 2022) liked that “They cook without spices just good well prepared food”.

restaurants.name: Firepit
restaurants.description: Firepit Bar and Grill on Salhouse Avenue draws mixed reviews, with the atmosphere praised more consistently than the kitchen. restaurants.description: Located in Mutare, Flavourtown barbeque is a lively restaurant. It has 9 reviews on Google Maps so far.

addresses: 128 Robert Mugabe Way, between 13th & 14th Avenue, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Fresh Traditional Restaurant on Robert Mugabe Way serves Zimbabwean dishes eaten by hand, with a waitress bringing soap and warm water before and after the meal. restaurants.description: Garden City Restaurant on the corner of Fifth Street and Jason Moyo Avenue in Gweru draws diners for sadza and grilled bones in a relaxed, garden-style setting. Sal (August 2025) liked the “great sadza and meaty bones”, and Afful (October 2023) called the sadza amazing in a lovely setting. Debrah (January 2025) rated the food top notch and the space good for picnics as well as sit-down meals.

restaurants.name: Garfunkels on Rolfe
restaurants.description: The family restaurant run by Garfunkels, the Zimbabwean butchery and smallgoods brand, on Fisher Avenue in Rolf Valley. Open since March 2021, it's known for wood-fired pizzas and slow-cooked glazed ribs, with fresh salads, lighter meals and weekend breakfasts. Reviewers mention pork chops, fish and schnitzels, and a weekday lunch special. You can sit inside or out on the verandah. restaurants.name: Garwe Restaurant
addresses: Donald McDonald Road, next to Chapman Golf Course, Eastlea, Harare
restaurants.description: Garwe Restaurant in Eastlea serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes, from sadza remhunga to peanut butter rice and rabbit. Reviewers across the years call it authentic and homely. Sindisiwe (July 2025) wrote that the traditional food “has that mothers touch and a homely feeling”, and Gigi (April 2022) ordered “mpunga unedovi, tsuro and munyeve” and called it very well prepared.

restaurants.name: Gavas
addresses: Belgravia Sports Club, 2nd Street Extension, Harare
restaurants.description: Sadza with stew or grilled meat is the standing order at Gavas, inside Belgravia Sports Club, and reviewers keep coming back for the portions. Penelope (October 2021) wrote “Amazing generous food portions we even left with leftovers” after trying the Mutongi Gava platter, and Lara (March 2026) praised “the best fried potatoes I’ve had in a long time” alongside the traditional sides.

restaurants.name: GI – The Island of Joy
restaurants.description: GI – The Island of Joy in Mbare West is a braai and butchery spot open around the clock. Ezra (2019) described “a good butchery and kitchen so you can buy your meat and salads and enjoy”, with a play area that makes it “a good place to come with your family”. Travelling lady (April 2026) liked that it “Wasnt crowded and had plenty of space”, with “private braai areas” for groups, and Blessing (March 2026) found “Friendly staff, excellent service, beautiful place”.

restaurants.name: Ginge's Takeaway
restaurants.description: Ginge's Takeaway in Bulawayo has built a reputation on its burgers, made to order in front of customers. Thandi (September 2022) called them the “Best burgers in town”, listing “The bun fresh ✔️ The patty fresh✔️” down to a fresh slice of tomato, and Zembe (August 2025) agreed they are “simply crunchy and taste very fresh” with fresh meat patties, buns, onions and cucumber. Vumelwano (November 2020) remembered a beef burger with extra egg fondly, alongside “fresh fries”.

restaurants.name: Ginge’s Kitchen
addresses: River Estate, cnr Oak Avenue & 12th Avenue, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Located in Bulawayo, Ginge’s Kitchen is a modern restaurant. It has 5 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: GOAT at Mama Africa
restaurants.description: GOAT, formerly Mama Africa, sits in the Landela Complex and reviewers describe a relaxed, decorated space with live music most nights. Craig (July 2026) called it “Amazing local food in the most relaxed atmosphere”, and Sladja (August 2025) rated it “an excellent restaurant with warm, attentive staff and the best coffee in town”.

restaurants.name: Gobelo Amakhosi Restaurant
addresses: Gobelo Lodge, 5 Hoopoe Hollow Road, Burnside, BulawayoDaily:
restaurants.description: Amakhosi is the restaurant at Gobelo lodge in Burnside, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner daily to lodge guests and outside diners. The menu mixes familiar favourites with subtle Zimbabwean influences, with open-air lunches beside a duck pond and footbridge and a well-stocked bar indoors.

restaurants.name: Gobelo Mtoa Restaurant at Gwango
addresses: Gwango Heritage Resort, off the main road before the Hwange NP entrance
restaurants.description: An open-air restaurant at Gwango Heritage Resort overlooking an elephant waterhole, open daily all year. The menu includes battered croc tail, chicken satay and farm-grown pulled pork, and some evenings there are traditional dinners with dancing.

restaurants.name: Golden Acres Guest Lodge
restaurants.description: Golden Acres Guest Lodge Restaurant sits in landscaped gardens outside Kwekwe, and reviewers describe it as a place to relax rather than rush. Blessed (May 2026) enjoyed “a natural environment because of the landscaping expertise covering the place”, and Gregory (January 2026) called it “a home away from home” with “excellent service”. Kumbulanim2025, staying in December 2025, found the rooms “excellent, with the utmost comfort and convenience” and the staff “all smiles”.

restaurants.name: Golden Peacock Villa Hotel
addresses: Stand 11177, Cnr Feruka & Jeff Road, Mutare
restaurants.description: Large Chinese-owned hotel in Mutare, open since 2012, whose restaurant serves buffet and à la carte menus mixing Zimbabwean, Western and Chinese-influenced dishes. The hotel's Glo Bar is popular with locals and travellers.

restaurants.name: Goneway Investments (PaJasper)
restaurants.description: Goneway Investments, known locally as PaJasper, is a relaxed spot in Dangamvura for drinks and simple food. Jasper (September 2024) lists what's on offer as fresh chips, quality meat, cold beer and affordable groceries, calling it one of the best places to unwind in the area.

restaurants.name: Gotcha Chicken & Grill
restaurants.description: Gotcha Chicken & Grill in Norton serves grilled chicken and pap, and Credit (2025) still finds “The chicken is so delicious can't get enough.” Longer-time customers see a decline, though: Tendai (2019) remembered when “This outlet used to make the best chicken grill and pap but as of late standards have really gone down!” Tawanda (2021) liked the “spacious parking space and good security” outside.

restaurants.name: Gotcha Nyama
restaurants.description: Gotcha Nyama in Harare specialises in braaied meat, with the steak the dish reviewers name most. Michael (August 2019) recommended it for a steak “braaied to perfection” the African way, and Philani (August 2019) liked the “Nicely prepared tbone steak” in a spot for chilling and hanging out. Sam (February 2019) praised the “great grilled meats and good service”.

restaurants.name: Gouveia's Garden Restaurant
restaurants.description: Gouveia's Garden Restaurant sits in Harare's Msasa industrial area, and long-time reviewers describe it as a local institution for Portuguese food. Phillip (2020) called the crowd “the who's and who's of the Msasa Industial Area” and said “The restaurant offers a superb Portuguese menu,” recommending the seafood. Phil (2018) rated it “Best Portuguese chicken this side of Portugal.”

restaurants.name: Gouveia’s
restaurants.description: A family recipe that is unbeatable. Your demand for our traditional Portuguese Chickens has pushed us to go that step further and open a spot where you will always find us during the week. Making your working breakfasts and lunches that much more enjoyable. We are well aware of lunch hour, time constraints and request that you call in to make your order in the morning and you can either collect or we can deliver within Msasa.
