restaurants.name: Governors' Restaurant at The Bulawayo Club
addresses: The Bulawayo Club, Cnr 8th Avenue & Fort Street, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: The Bulawayo Club, founded in 1895 as a gentlemen's club and now a boutique hotel, has a grand second-floor dining room known as the Governors' Restaurant, serving classic dishes with a modern African twist. The historic building also has two bars and lounges and a library, and it caters for private functions and conferences.

restaurants.name: Grand Acade Centre
restaurants.description: Grand Acade Centre earns praise for its food but plenty of criticism for its upkeep. Tanaka (August 2026) found the food quality excellent after two visits but said bluntly that “the place needs a revamp”, pointing to dust, scruffy waiters and rundown bathrooms. Pattie (December 2025) agreed that “Food depends on the day sometimes it's good”, though Pattie loved the breakfast.

restaurants.name: Granez African Cuisines Restaurant
restaurants.description: Granez African Cuisines in Masvingo serves home-style stews and grills, and reviewers single out the pork shoulder. Chiedza (September 2024) tried “their pork shoulder with chips” and called it “quite the culinary delight.” Dorothy (May 2024) found the food great in a place that “was clean,” and Tariro (January 2024) agreed on “good food and portions for good price,” though found the menu “basic.”

restaurants.name: Great Enclosure Restaurant (Great Zimbabwe Hotel)
addresses: Great Zimbabwe Hotel, Great Zimbabwe Road, Masvingo
restaurants.description: The main restaurant of the Great Zimbabwe Hotel, about 700m from the Great Zimbabwe National Monument, with décor inspired by the monument's stonework. It serves à la carte and buffet menus of African and international dishes and seats up to 150. The hotel's Mutapa Cocktail Bar offers a full snack menu and a signature 'Great Zimbabwe rocks' drink.

restaurants.name: Great Wall
restaurants.description: Great Wall on East Road is a long-running Chinese restaurant that regulars treat as a standing dinner plan. Sarathiel (February 2026) enjoys the meals “each time I come”, and Anotida praised food that has been “consistently delicious” for years in a 2025 review.

restaurants.name: Gulez Gardens
restaurants.description: Gulez Gardens in Kwekwe hosts events alongside its restaurant and lounge, and Desmond (2025) called it “phenomenal venue for special events like weddings etc etc”. David (November 2025) was “blown away by the amazing food and variety of products” on offer, and Obert (2025) described it simply as a “Well organised lounge...it's food, drinks”. Jeremiah (January 2026) enjoys the quiet atmosphere but suggests avoiding weekends, when it gets noisier.

restaurants.name: H-Town Gelato
addresses: Greenfields Shopping Centre, cnr ED Mnangagwa & Arcturus Roads, Harare (also Highland Park and Arundel Village)
restaurants.description: A Zimbabwean artisan gelato maker producing small-batch gelato and sorbet from local ingredients, with parlours at Greenfields, Highland Park and Arundel Village. Flavours include Biscoff, Greek yoghurt and honey, Turkish delight and malva pudding.

restaurants.name: Haefelis
addresses: Fife Street Complex, cnr 10th Avenue & Fife Street, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Haefelis in Bulawayo's Fife Street Complex is a bakery and restaurant reviewers return to for breakfast, pastries and pizza. Lin (October 2025) called the chicken “tender and juicy” and said “The pastries are to die for”, singling out the milktarts, while Ruvarashe (March 2026) rates it “Probably best pizza around”.

restaurants.name: Hala Select Kimberley Hotel
restaurants.description: The Kimberley is a central Bindura hotel run by the Hotels and Leisure Africa (HALA) group, with a restaurant, bar and a large garden. Braais are held in the garden, and the hotel is a regular venue for conferences.

restaurants.name: Halal House
restaurants.description: Halal House on Herbert Chitepo Street in Mutare runs an all-day breakfast and grill menu. Taurai (December 2025) enjoyed the “Chicken Schnitzel and Hake” with a sauce that “was great”, and Keith (October 2025) called the menu “splendid” in a beautiful setting. Catherine (March 2024) found a T-bone “was not tender” but liked the atmosphere, calling it “perfect and very relaxing”.

restaurants.name: Halisi Grill & Takeaway
addresses: Shop 15c, Imbali Mall, 88 Robert Mugabe Way, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Portions are the headline at Halisi Grill in Imbali Mall. Tapiwa (August 2023) called them “the most generous portions”, and Nokuthula (September 2024) agreed the food came with “generous portions but service could be better”.

restaurants.name: Hamburger Hut
restaurants.description: Hamburger Hut, despite the name, is best known for its pies. Tinashe (July 2025) drove across town for them, calling them “the best pies in the country,” and Andy (July 2025) credits the cook, Charisse, as “such a kind helpfull lady who cooks orgasmic food.” Joyce (September 2022) said “The meaty steak pie never disappoints, everything in the right proportions,” and Keith (June 2018) called it home to the best chicken pie “I've ever tasted”, after trying plenty of others.

restaurants.name: Hanzu Bar
restaurants.description: Hanzu Bar in Mutare is a spot for cold beer and braai. Trey (August 2023) called it the “best bar to be” for “Ice cold beer”, and Costa (November 2025) described it simply as “A place to be ice cold beer and braai”. Siphosami (June 2025) rated the food “Premium delicious” with a favourite atmosphere, and Kudzanai (December 2023) called it “The best bar in Hob House”.

restaurants.name: Haochi Chinese Bistro
restaurants.description: Haochi, near the entrance to the falls in Victoria Falls, serves home-style Chinese food and bubble tea. Langelihle (August 2026) ordered the bubble tea and “really enjoyed every meal”, and Mpho (August 2026) “really loved the way the bubble tasted”. Tiffany (February 2026) was glad to “finally eat some stir fried cabbage” and noted the tofu is made in house.

restaurants.name: Harare Beer Engine
addresses: Park Street, cnr Samora Machel Avenue (below the Jameson Hotel), Harare
restaurants.description: Zimbabwe's pioneering English-style brewpub, brewing on site since 1997 with its fermentation tanks at the heart of a nautical-themed bar. House beers include Lighthouse blonde ale and Navigator dark ale, with pub platters, burgers and Nigerian and Zimbabwean dishes from an in-house kitchen.

restaurants.name: Harry's Coffee Shop
addresses: Gate 3, Borrowdale Race Course, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: A garden-style café beside Harry's fine-food store at Gate 3 of Borrowdale Race Course, serving coffee, breakfasts and a seasonal menu that includes Mediterranean and burrito bowls.

restaurants.name: Hartsfield Tshisa Nyama
restaurants.description: Hartsfield Tshisa Nyama is a large open-air braai venue at the Hartsfield rugby grounds, grilling pork, steak, chicken and fish over wood fires. It is a long-running weekend entertainment hub that hosts live music and concerts. It was named Best Braai Spot at the 2025 Bulawayo Eats Awards.

restaurants.name: Harvest Garden Restaurant
addresses: The Rainbow Towers Hotel, 1 Pennefather Avenue, HarareWeekend brunch buffet
restaurants.description: The buffet restaurant at the Rainbow Towers Hotel, an African-themed room looking onto the pool and gardens. It serves breakfast, lunch and dinner buffets and, every Saturday and Sunday, a $25 brunch buffet from 10am to 2pm.

restaurants.name: Hellenic Club
addresses: Cnr B Avenue & First Street, Mutare
restaurants.description: Hellenic Club in downtown Mutare is run by the local Greek community, and reviewers treat it as the best lunch option in the CBD. Peter (April 2025) called it “Best place to eat in downtown Mutare”, noting free parking and both indoor and outdoor seating, though Peter added it has “seen better days”, a nod to the building's age. Mbuya Rose (June 2023) rated the food superb and the service “excellent professional”.

restaurants.name: hideout cafe
addresses: National Gallery, 75 Joshua Nkomo Street (cnr Leopold Takawira Avenue), Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Hideout Cafe sits inside the National Gallery in Bulawayo's CBD, and reviewers treat it as a stop after touring the art. Sibongile (February 2025) called it “a great spot to sit down for a bite after a tour of the art or city”, and Lerato (March 2026) liked how affordable it is, enjoying the “3 meat sandwich”.

restaurants.name: Highlander Pub & Restaurant
restaurants.description: Highlander Pub & Restaurant operates out of Highlands Sports Club, and the tomahawk steak and pizza get named most often. Anotida (August 2024) called the tomahawk “my go to order for lunch”, especially “paired with their garlic sauce”, and Tapfuma (October 2023) said the pizza, particularly the zimbo, keeps drawing them back from Canada.

restaurants.name: Hillside Sports Club
restaurants.description: Hillside Sports Club in Mutare is a golf club dating to the 1920s, with a restaurant and bar open to non-members. Tafadzwa (October 2025) found the “food to die for” and said “service is fantastic”, while Nori (October 2025) camped on site and called the owner “very kind”.

restaurants.name: Hillside Walk
restaurants.description: Hillside Walk is a grill and seafood restaurant in a mixed-use complex in Bulawayo that also has go-karting and other shops. Kelvin (July 2026) praised the “pork ribs are great” and said “seafood boils are wonderful,” while Marry (January 2025) called a sushi order “an outstanding sushi take away,” adding “the food was superb and of high quality.”

restaurants.name: HipHipSip
addresses: Shop No. 16 Western Wing Belvedere Square 6649 Burton Road, Cnr Princes Rd, Harare
restaurants.description: HipHipSip in Belvedere gets mixed marks on service that vary sharply by which staff member serves the table. Aletah (August 2026) was “served by Lyn,good customer care” and found the food delicious, while Lorraine (June 2026) said staff should be hired “with Leona’s energy and service” after a different server tried to move them off a two-person table. Zibusiso (August 2026) waited more than 40 minutes for food in an empty restaurant, and Tafadzwa (May 2026) found one waitres

restaurants.name: Hippopula Pub and Grill
addresses: Mpopoma, near the railway station, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Hippopula is a pub and grill in Mpopoma that opened around late 2024 and quickly became one of the city's busier entertainment spots. It runs weekly Game Nights, Ladies Nights and karaoke evenings, and hosts an annual HippoFest to mark its anniversary, first held in December 2025.

restaurants.name: Hivu hive
restaurants.description: Hivu Hive in Mutare doubles as a garden nursery and deli, and reviewers describe eating among the plants. Tinka (April 2026) liked the “very nice atmosphere, within a nursery” and singled out the juices as “out of the world.” Marie-Louise (June 2025) mentioned the same nursery and deli, which also sells “excellent grass fed beef.”

restaurants.name: HOFF'S
addresses: Stand 454, Redan Service Station, Harare Drive, Pomona Business Pk, Harare
restaurants.description: HOFF'S is a small cafe attached to a service station in Pomona Business Park, and bagels are what reviewers order. Rosemond (2025) called them “delicious” with a “lovely” outdoor seating area, and Ruvarashe (2024) said “the flavors in the bagels are top tier.” Ryan (2024) treats it as a stop “whilst getting your Isuzu Serviced,” open to the public for “a lunch break bagel and coffee.” Caroline (2025) found the staff and owner “quite friendly and welcoming.”

restaurants.name: Home Ground Gango
addresses: Albury Road (behind the Engen service station), Sunridge, HarareDaily from 10:00 till late
restaurants.description: Home Ground Gango in Sunridge works differently than newcomers expect: buy the meat you want from the on-site butchery, then it gets grilled to order with a portion of sadza that, despite being priced for one, “feeds to adults”, per Tavashe (2023), who also warned the place “gets packed, very packed” at busy times. Tanaka (December 2025) called it “The best place to get authentic Zimbabwean dishes”, though Tanaka (2025) found the food “top-notch ,very delicious” but the space

restaurants.name: Honeybear Restaurant
restaurants.description: Honeybear Restaurant is available for Private Events, Lunches, and Dinners. We have Catering and Bar available and can quote to the specific needs of your event. We are open to the public for Sunday Lunches and for Special Events. Bookings Essential. restaurants.name: Honeypot Restaurant
restaurants.description: Honeypot Restaurant on Warwick Street in Kadoma serves ribs, steaks and breakfast in a family-friendly outdoor setting, and most reviewers rate it among the best in town. Richard (2025) called it “arguably the best outdoor eatery place in kadoma” with “delicious mouth watering dishes”, and Kundai (2022) said “Their food is absolutely divine” at prices Kundai found surprisingly low.

restaurants.name: Hungry Panda
addresses: Hungry Panda & Grill Shack, King George Road, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: A cutting edge restaurant in the heart of Harare offering a predominantly meaty menu of grills pizza, burgers and your favorite Chinese cuisine. restaurants.name: Hwange Safari Lodge – Dingani Restaurant
addresses: Hwange Safari Lodge, off Main Camp road, Hwange National ParkDingani 06:30–22:00; King Bean 08:00–18:30; Tusker Bar 11:00–22:30
restaurants.description: An African Sun lodge just outside the park boundary. The Dingani Restaurant serves à la carte, buffet and all-day menus, and the poolside King Bean coffee shop offers burgers, speciality coffee and snacks. A travel guide notes it's open to all and a good brunch stop for self-drivers, with a view over a waterhole.

restaurants.name: Ilala Lodge Hotel
restaurants.description: Ilala Lodge's restaurant sits on the edge of the Victoria Falls National Park, and reviewers regularly describe animals wandering past the tables while they eat. John (April 2026) had a ground-floor spot near the gardens where “we had hippos, elephants, and warthogs wandering right past us” within hours of arriving, and Diane (April 2026) called the food “exceptional & 5*” with birds, elephants, hippos and warthogs visible from the grounds during meals.

restaurants.name: Indaba Book Cafe
restaurants.description: Indaba Book Cafe on Josiah Tongogara Street pairs breakfast and coffee with a library corner reviewers use for reading, meetings or getting work done. Themba (March 2025) described the mood as “a relaxed family-run, European village restaurant” and called the cappuccino “EXCELLENT!!”. SplendidMite (January 2025) went further, naming it “the best Cafe in Bulawayo” and crediting beans “roasted & blended by the owner”.

restaurants.name: Inn on the Vumba
restaurants.description: Inn on the Vumba serves table d'hôte dinners from a mountaintop dining room facing towards Mozambique, and reviews split on the food itself. The traveller (March 2026) found the setting and service “top notch” but rated the food weak. Racheljennifers (2016) praised “Good food, excellent breakfast”, and a 2016 stay found the fish course good though the meat and chicken dishes fell short. SeanMK55 (2016) called the food “of a good standard and reasonably priced”. The dining roo

restaurants.name: Ja'Dijo Restaurant
restaurants.description: Ja'Dijo on Robert Mugabe Way is Bulawayo's paint-and-play restaurant, where diners can grill their own meat at the table, play board games or paint a canvas while food is prepared. Oxtail is the dish reviewers keep coming back for. Tsungie (December 2024) called it “the best I have had this year”. Zembe (August 2025) agreed the oxtail “was so well cooked that the meat literally fell off the bones”.

restaurants.name: Jade Garden
restaurants.description: Located in Mutare, Jade Garden is a restaurant. It has 18 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Japanese Cuisine Catering
restaurants.description: We serve Japanese Cuisine prepared by Japanese chef!! We are the first Japanese Catering company now established in Zimbabwe, comprising a team of skilled, experienced Japanese chefs serving genuine Japanese cuisine. Our services range from takeaways, sit ins, lunch boxes (for company workers) to dinner or catering services for any special occasions upon request. restaurants.name: Johnnies Pub
restaurants.description: Located in Harare, Johnnies Pub is a lively restaurant. It has 12 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Jojo's
restaurants.description: Jojo's Greendale on Arcturus Road is a small fast-food spot that reviewers describe as easy to miss but worth finding. Mongi (January 2026) called it a “Neat little spot to grab a good bite”, tucked away enough to feel quiet and pleasant rather than crowded. Justice (November 2025) said the food and service run at “the degree of excellence”, and Maemaria (December 2025) found the food “very nice n tasty”.

restaurants.name: Jongwe Corner
restaurants.description: Jongwe Corner is Chinhoyi's go-to spot for sadza, braai and a live band, especially once the weekend hits. Rufaro (May 2026) described a simple outdoor place that “usually comes alive on Friday nights and over weekends when they host live shows and artists”, quiet during the day, with sadza and relish on offer and braai options later. Fortune (August 2026) caught a Thursday live band that “mesmerized all of us and kept us on our feet”.

restaurants.name: Jungle Junction Restaurant
addresses: The Victoria Falls Hotel, 1 Mallet Drive, Victoria FallsDaily
restaurants.description: Jungle Junction is the buffet restaurant at the Victoria Falls Hotel, and dinner comes with game meats and a dance show. Elsa (October 2025) was told by the waiter Thulani that “the crocodile meat is better than chicken,” and Charlotte (August 2019) had “Elan steaks and crocodile tail” followed by “45mins of African dancing.” Doug (June 2017) listed a spread that ran to “sushi, game meats, Indian, cakes and ice cream.”

restaurants.name: Ka Mandazi
restaurants.description: Ka Mandazi serves traditional Zimbabwean food in Bulawayo, and the dish reviewers name is gango. Kudzai (June 2023) enjoyed it “well prepared, serve on good portions” in a room with an artsy feel and plenty of seating, and Coleen (April 2022) wrote “I love their gango” before mentioning the alcohol specials.

restaurants.name: Kadoma Hotel & Conference Centre
restaurants.description: Rainbow Tourism Group hotel whose Tigashire and Batanai restaurants serve à la carte and buffet meals, while Dandaro serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes with mbira and marimba performances. The Executive Bar is open daily from 10am to 10pm.

restaurants.name: Kadoma Ranch Motel
addresses: A5 (Harare–Bulawayo Road), cnr Eiffel Flats Road, Kadoma
restaurants.description: Kadoma Ranch Motel draws complaints about food and repairs more than praise lately. Amanda (December 2025) was “Greatly disappointed with the food”, with cold fries and pork chops Amanda found “hard not delicious at all”, plus an overpriced, poorly made long island. Sasha (2025) found “Most of the stuff on the menu is unavailable and has been for months according to the waiter”, a surprise after enjoying food at other Rainbow branches.

restaurants.name: Kapoto
restaurants.description: Enjoy our traditional dishes at Kapoto that includes sadza mhunga, zviyo mupunga unedovi( rice & peanut butter) served with zvinyenza, mabhonzo, chimukuyu. restaurants.name: Kapoto
restaurants.description: Kapoto in Mutare's Darlington suburb serves Zimbabwean traditional dishes alongside Kariba bream, in an outdoor space with lawns and a covered dining pavilion. Everjoy (May 2025) found the food “absolutely delicious” and the staff “very friendly and attentive”, and Sheba (November 2023) was “caught off guard by the large portion sizes”.

restaurants.name: Kariba Country Club
restaurants.description: Kariba Country Club sits above Lake Kariba, and reviewers come mostly for the view rather than any one dish. Know Zimbabwe (January 2025) described “Amazing scenery with a lake view”, and Jairos (March 2018) recommended “nice scenic views as you also enjoy the cool breeze from Lake Kariba”. Tendayi (August 2017) added that “the place is so good and the staff members are so friendly”. One visitor found the heat tough going in summer, but most reviews focus on the setting.

restaurants.name: Kariba Safari Lodge
restaurants.description: Kariba Safari Lodge sits at Mica Point overlooking the lake, and most reviews start with the view before anything else. G (June 2024) called the place “exquisite, overlooking the lake”, an escape from the drive in that “makes you forget the potholes”. Gulnara (March 2025) listed “clean rooms, helpful and kind staff, best views” and “very tasty food” among the reasons to recommend it.

restaurants.name: Kasmat
restaurants.description: Kasmat on Pine Street in Marondera is a quick-lunch and catering spot. Marlon (July 2026) called the meals “superb” and named it “my first choice restaurant”. Ska (2024) sent “Kudos to the chef” and praised service from Tanaka, but hoped for changes to the seating area since “The smoke and smells from the kitchen should be managed”. Other reviewers mention the shawarma and quick service.

restaurants.name: Kelly's Kuttings
addresses: Mac's Flower Farm, Crowhill Road (3.1km past Borrowdale Brooke), Domboshawa
restaurants.description: A countryside café on a working flower farm a short drive past Borrowdale Brooke, serving breakfasts, seasonal lunches, cakes and a Thursday high tea from a veranda over the flower fields. After eating you can pick your own flowers, which are trimmed and wrapped for you.

restaurants.name: Khaya Nyama Wombles
restaurants.description: Khaya Nyama Wombles in Highlands is an upscale steakhouse built around aged steaks and a landscaped garden setting. Don, in 2025, called it “a true fine dining experience” where “the steak was cooked to perfection”. Ruvarashe, in 2023, celebrated a birthday there with a fillet mignon that was “nice and tender”, followed by a complimentary dessert “presented with wonderful singing”.

restaurants.name: King Bean Coffee Shop – Elephant Hills
addresses: Elephant Hills Resort, 328 Parkway Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: A garden coffee shop at the Elephant Hills pool area serving speciality coffees, mocktails and cocktails with a snack menu, including the signature King Bean burger. Seats about 50.

restaurants.name: King Restaurant & Sweets
restaurants.description: King Restaurant & Sweets serves Pakistani food in Harare, and reviewers keep pointing to the tandoori oven. Zermeen (July 2026) said the “Tandoori naan was excellent” and found the karahi's meat “tender and spiced very well”.

restaurants.name: King's Courtyard Boutique Hotel & Suites Vumba
restaurants.description: King's Courtyard sits in the Vumba highlands outside Mutare, and reviewers keep coming back to the breakfast and the views. Young (April 2024) rated the breakfast “10/10”, and Munatsi (May 2024) enjoyed “the Kings breakfast” served with friendly staff. Sussanah (December 2021) called the food “first class”.

restaurants.name: King's Kraal
addresses: Zonkizizwe Shopping Complex, Hillside Road, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Located in Bulawayo, King's Kraal is a casual restaurant. It holds a 4.3/5 rating from 119 Google Maps reviews. Priced budget-friendly.

restaurants.name: KINGS' PIZZA (IPK Kamfinsa)
restaurants.description: Kings' Pizza inside IPK Kamfinsa keeps prices low, most pizzas between $2 and $3.50. Anesu (August 2026) called it “absolutely crazy” value, “getting a whole, delicious pizza for just $2”. Sonnet (June 2026) tried the Paradise Chicken and found the chicken “tender + juicy” with a base that had “that perfect crisp-to-chew ratio”.

restaurants.name: Kombahari at Rainbow Towers
addresses: Rainbow Towers Hotel, 1 Pennefather Avenue, Harare
restaurants.description: A 32-seat live-cooking restaurant inside the Rainbow Towers Hotel, where chefs cook at teppanyaki griddles set into the tables. The name means 'eating around the cooking pot' in Shona, and the menu mixes Asian stir-fries with an Afro-fusion 'Amai's Choice' menu of Zimbabwean dishes.

restaurants.name: Kori Studio Cafe
restaurants.description: Kōri Studio Café in Bulawayo built a kids' play area that keeps families around, with someone on hand to watch the children. Shayne (September 2026) said “the nieces and nephews practically refused to leave” and loved “the breakfast bagel.” 10 on Pauling (July 2026) recommended the “coconut matcha” and a “well-designed play ground with the cute play houses.” Lerato (June 2026) was looked after by a waitress named Angel, who “really made me feel at home.”

restaurants.name: Kream Koffee
addresses: 2 Shuvai Mahofa St (cnr Simon Mazorodze Ave), Masvingo
restaurants.description: Kream Koffee Zimbabwe is a budget-friendly cafe in Masvingo's CBD, and reviewers keep coming back for the ribs. Jane (August 2024) said “can't spend a week without going there” for the pork ribs and chips, and Melissa (September 2024) agreed the ribs were the highlight even while finding other prices too high.

restaurants.name: Krunch Steakhouse
addresses: 2418 Lot 2 Clipsham Views, next to Redan City, Masvingo
restaurants.description: Krunch SteakHouse in Masvingo serves T-bone, rump and half chicken at reasonable prices, and reviewers keep mentioning value. Tafadzwa (October 2025), a self-described regular, praised “reasonable prices and great atmosphere.” Gilford (May 2025) singled out the “great bbq chicken” and “very generous portions.” Rita (July 2025) called lunch “a delicious meal with warm friendly service.”

restaurants.name: Kuimba Shiri Bird Sanctuary
restaurants.description: Kuimba Shiri on the shore of Lake Chivero pairs a bird sanctuary with lunch and sundowners, and reviewers treat the food as part of a bigger day out rather than the main event. Ajay (July 2026) noted “Food and drinks are available on order” alongside the bird show, boat rides and horse riding. Brian (2025) said “chicken was tasty” and Brian's wife “said the chicken livers were good,” while the kids enjoyed their hot dogs.

restaurants.name: KwaFatso kusadza
restaurants.description: KwaFatso kusadza in Mutare's CBD serves traditional Zimbabwean meals from a shaded outdoor eating area. Peter (March 2025) praised “tasty cheap Zimbabwean meals” and said the “outside eating area is shaded clean and comfortable”, better than other budget eateries. Kevin (July 2018) recommended trying “the oxtail and local Gango”, and Star (April 2019) listed “Sadza, mazondo ne braai” among everything liked in a clean setting.

restaurants.name: KwaGogo Traditional Food Restaurant
addresses: Kendy Close Off, Arundel School Rd, Harare
restaurants.description: KwaGogo Traditional Food Restaurant is a restaurant in Harare. It holds a 4.6/5 rating from 11 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: KwaNandi Traditional Restaurant
restaurants.description: KwaNandi in Harare's Eastlea suburb serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes with seating grouped by family and tribe, and portions come up as generous across the board. Charles (September 2026) “Loved the different local family tribe based seating options” and called portions generous, and Matilda (April 2026) also found “very generous” meat portions served with muriwo and beans.

restaurants.name: KwaTerry Traditional Restaurant
restaurants.description: A rural-tourism restaurant in Turf village near Zimplats, founded by farmer Terrence Maphosa. It serves traditional dishes such as roadrunner chicken, maguru, goat, sadza and mufushwa une dovi, much of it from his own farm, and added 'kwaTerry Village' accommodation in late 2025.

restaurants.name: Kwesintu
addresses: 7 Exhibition Court, cnr 3rd Avenue & Samuel Parirenyatwa Street, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Kwesintu in Bulawayo's CBD is rated for its traditional food more than its takeaway. Ryan (December 2025) called it the “Best traditional food I've ever had”, with tasty, well-done dishes and great service. Wellington (September 2026) agreed, naming it the “Best traditional food in Bulawayo”. Jessica (April 2026) warns it “can get packed during pick hours”, meaning a wait for your meal, and Donald (June 2026) found takeaway orders disappointing compared with eating in.

restaurants.name: Kyle Shell Takeaway
restaurants.description: Kyle Shell Takeaway on the A4 near Masvingo serves quick meals for travellers passing through rather than a sit-down experience. Ivon (April 2019) called it “great fast meals for people on the go” at what is “just a convinience shop”, and Aarley (October 2013) found the food “so international” after a visit years back. Nevenka and Brandon both mention friendly, pleasant staff and cold drinks on hand.

restaurants.name: La Gondola
restaurants.description: La Gondola on Robert Mugabe Way runs late, open daily until midnight, and works as both a restaurant and a night spot with a DJ. Panashe (April 2025) had “a going -back-to- the-roots experience” eating the traditional meal, and Piaget (July 2024) agreed “the traditional meals are nice and hot though the noise is kinda too much in the lounge” for a late dinner.

restaurants.name: La Kreme Restaurant
restaurants.description: La Kreme in Bulawayo runs as an appointment dining experience, often a set multi-course dinner in a garden setting under the stars. Lungile (October 2023) called it “hands down the best service I've ever had”, with the chef, barman and waitress all checking in between courses. Several reviewers mention Chef Sbue by name for the care Chef Sbue puts into each booking.

restaurants.name: La Ola Nest
restaurants.description: Located in Mutare, La Ola Nest is a casual restaurant. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: La Parada
addresses: Bay Noakes Road, off ED Mnangagwa Road, Rolf Valley/Chisipite, Harare
restaurants.description: La Parada Bay Noakes in Chisipite draws people in for the setting more than the plates. Jules (May 2026) found the food, wine and service “decent but lackluster” but called the ambiance and interior design “the real gem”, with live music “usually spectacular”. Tanaka (December 2025) agreed the food menu is “wonderful, not the most outstanding but delicious enough”, next to an extensive cocktail list.

restaurants.name: La Piazza
restaurants.description: La Piazza on Parkway Drive combines a restaurant, sushi kitchen and butcher's shop under one open-air roof, and reviewers treat it as their go-to for repeat visits. James (April 2026) praised the pizza and meat “supplied by the on-site butcher's shop” and came back the next night. Shelley (June 2026) had sushi that was “fantastically fresh and tasty” alongside a breakfast omelette with homemade jam.

restaurants.name: La Pizzeria
restaurants.description: La Pizzeria in Harare gets recommended for the Margarite and Smoked BBQ chicken pizzas. Trudy (February 2026) called Trudy's Margarite “Best pizza ever!!”, thanking staff Keith and Patience by name, and Abdul (April 2021) urged others to “try the Smoked BBQ chicken pizza”, calling it “REALLY GOOOOOD”. Leroy (May 2021) said the pizza is “to die for”.

restaurants.name: La Rouge
restaurants.description: We have a variety of meals which consist grills, quick breakfast, sea foods and tradition foods. The pub menu is irresistible which consist of platters. We love kids and La Rouge is a family friendly environment. To all Jazz lovers, La Rouge offers patrons the opportunity to experience jazz music every Friday. Jazz vibes rock while chit chatting with friends sipping wine and consuming mouth-watering victuals. Showtime is 9 pm and this atmosphere is what many people look forwa

restaurants.name: Lake Harvest Shop, Bar and Grill
restaurants.description: Lake Harvest Shop, Bar and Grill in Kariba is run by the Lake Harvest fishing company and built around flame-grilled bream. Sifelani (May 2024) said to “try their bream it beats the best”, and Vimbai Mukwekwezeke (April 2024) called it simply “the best fish I've ever had”.

restaurants.name: Latitude 18 Prime Restaurant
restaurants.description: Latitude 18 is a casual Marondera restaurant serving grills, breakfasts and traditional Zimbabwean plates. The menu runs from T-bone, pork chops and spare ribs with chips to sadza with beef or pork bones, road-runner chicken stew and rabbit. Table reservations are taken through its website.

restaurants.name: Latte Lounge
addresses: 8083 6th Avenue, RG Mugabe Way (Bluetech Petrol), Kwekwe
restaurants.description: Latte Lounge sits behind a fuel station in Kwekwe and keeps a “strictly halaal menu,” per Khadija (2025), who called it “friendly and efficient staff, delicious food, gorgeous setup.” Stabile (2025), stopping during a layover, found the atmosphere “excellent, so refreshing.” Preachmore (2025) called both the food and the service “Excellent food, excellent service.”

restaurants.name: Lava Lounge
restaurants.description: Lava Lounge in Beitbridge is as much a bar as a restaurant, open 24 hours opposite the passport offices. Kundisai (2024) called it the “best lounge ever”, adding “the food is amazing, the service is out of this world”. Lee-anna (2024) specifically recommends asking for Angie, who they say “takes the service to another brilliant level”. Santana (2023) admitted “It’s bar!! That’s pretty much it,” but praised the air conditioning in Beitbridge's heat and the night lights. Jethro

restaurants.name: Legends of Kebab Premier
restaurants.description: Legends of Kebab Premier is an African restaurant in Harare. It holds a 4.4/5 rating from 16 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: Leisure Centre
restaurants.description: Leisure Centre in Gweru is valued for its setting more than any single dish. McDean (March 2026) said “The panoramic views, the pool, the food and general service is top tier”, and Rumbidzaii (January 2025) visited on a quiet Monday and found “The staff is amazing and the service is spot on!” Several other reviewers come simply to watch the sunset over drinks.

restaurants.name: Leopard Rock Hotel
addresses: Bvumba Road, Bvumba (approx. 30 km from Mutare)
restaurants.description: Leopard Rock Hotel sits high in the Bvumba mountains outside Mutare, and reviewers who dine here tend to praise the setting and staff ahead of the food itself. Bastian (January 2019) found “The food is excellent and the staff is extremely friendly,” and FlameLily (January 2019) called the breakfast “to die for” after a quiet, near-empty stay. Bridget (March 2025) described a family weekend where the food was “so delicious and also affordable”, alongside giraffe and ostrich si

restaurants.name: Leovilla
restaurants.description: Leovilla is a Mexican spot in Belgravia, and reviewers name the tacos more than anything else on the menu. Randolph (September 2024) described “their tacos being the star of the show,” and Steve (April 2026) recommends the “Great crispy ground-beef tacos” with a side of Carolina Reaper spice for those who want heat. Blessing (December 2025) found the nachos crunchy and the tacos well seasoned, adding that “the spices were chosen thoughtfully.”

restaurants.name: LesVigo
restaurants.description: An exclusive Lounge restaurant which offers fine dinning experience to the very best. restaurants.description: The Unit N branch of the Ligi chain is a sports bar and grill at Zvido Shops, serving grilled food with live sport. It becomes a busy nightspot at weekends.

restaurants.name: Lion & Elephant Motel (Bubye Grill)
addresses: Harare–Beitbridge Road, about 75km north of BeitbridgeCafé
restaurants.description: A long-standing roadside motel on the banks of the Bubye River, about 75km north of Beitbridge on the Harare road. The Bubye Grill serves breakfast and dinner. The Bubye Café is open from 6am to 10pm for dine-in or takeaway pies, bush burgers, steak sandwiches and chips.

restaurants.name: Little Eataly
addresses: Queen of Hearts complex, 1 Hurworth Road, Highlands, Harare
restaurants.description: Little Eataly is a family-owned restaurant, dishing up classic Italian cuisine using only the finest and freshest ingredients. Open from Tuesday to Sunday, and conveniently located at One Hurworth Road, you can dine for lunch or dinner at our own seating area, order from the Queen of Hearts menu or order a takeaway when you need pasta…pronto! restaurants.name: Little Fontana
restaurants.description: We offer the best of Ethiopian & Italian dishes. Little Fontana prides itself in its rich Ethiopian tradition. The traditional dish of Injera is our main highlight and not forgetting the coffee making ceremony. We also have a fully equipped bar serving local and imported wines and beers. There is also plenty of parking space together with play area for kids. If you are looking for a quiet and peaceful place to enjoy your meal with family and friends, definately Little Fontana

restaurants.name: Loco Cafe
restaurants.description: Loco Cafe Hwange is a roadside coffee stop marked by a large steam engine near a highway roundabout between Bulawayo and Victoria Falls. Von (October 2025) said the staff's “service was absolutely fantastic and very friendly” over fresh iced coffee, and Lindsay (October 2025) found the coffee “made to perfection” by knowledgeable baristas.

restaurants.name: Lodge at the Ancient City
restaurants.description: A thatched lodge built on a granite outcrop overlooking the Great Enclosure, a short drive from the Great Zimbabwe Monuments. Its 40-seat restaurant serves set menus, braai meals, traditional Zimbabwean dishes, buffets and full English breakfasts, with a curated wine list and a fully stocked bar. The restaurant is open to drop-in visitors as well as lodge guests.

restaurants.name: Lomagundi Lakeside
restaurants.description: Lomagundi Lakeside sits on Lake Kariba, and the wildlife wandering through the grounds is what most reviewers mention first: zebra, hippo, elephant and bushbuck turn up between the chalets and the pool. Ruth (August 2018) described “Abundant birdlife with hippos zebras bushbuck sometimes right in the complex”.

restaurants.name: Loretta's Cafe and Smoothie Caravan
restaurants.description: Loretta's is a family-run coffee caravan in Victoria Falls, roasting Zimbabwean beans on site under a garden tree. Daphne (July 2026) called it “a truly independently owned café” after a coffee and smoothie following the Victoria Falls Marathon. Ron (July 2026) found the Americano had “great flavor” and discovered the barista was Loretta's husband, then bought bags of the fresh-roasted beans to take home. Takunda walks visitors through the roasting and cupping process, and Si

restaurants.name: Lugar de Pollo
addresses: Shop 2 and 3, Chisipite Food Court, Chisipite Shopping Centre, Harare
restaurants.description: Lugar de Pollo, in the Chisipite Food Court, gets recommended as a reliable stop for chicken with unusual sauce options. Farai (2021) pointed diners toward “their Galantinas and Thier unique mild and garlic flavour”, and found the team “friendly and approachable” on delivery orders, though walk-in service can run slower than other fast food outlets. Maxwell (2025) called the vibe amazing with food that was “on point”, and The Phantom (2025) had an experience where the food wa

restaurants.name: Luna's Restaurant
addresses: Hunters Moon Estate, 3 Ridgeway North, Chisipite, Harare
restaurants.description: Luna's in Chisipite pairs garden seating with an all-day breakfast and Italian menu, and the tagliatelle alfredo draws specific praise. Noma (January 2026) called it “exquisite”, with a mocha that “achieved a perfect balance of richness and sweetness, requiring no addition.”

restaurants.name: Lush Restaurant
addresses: The Country Club, 1 Brompton Road, Newlands, Harare
restaurants.description: Lush Restaurant sits inside The Country Club in Newlands, overlooking the golf course, and reviewers keep weighing the setting against the bill. Hillary (July 2022) called it “one of the best restaurants in town”, though prices are “bit pricier though in comparison with other restaurants”. Mitchelle (January 2026) agreed the food was amazing but “a little pricy for me personally”.

restaurants.name: M-eat grillhouse
restaurants.description: M-eat Grillhouse on Falcon Street pairs a butchery counter with a grill, and reviewers say the meat backs up the name. Zembe (August 2025) called it “one of the best restaurants in BULAWAYO”, with “high grade and tender meat” and praised “the fillet and a good price”. Mark (May 2021) came for a quick meal at a good price and rates the prego rolls “a must to try”.

restaurants.name: Machikichori Gardens
restaurants.description: Machikichori Gardens is an Interactive Entertainment Hub that will bring people together around food! Soul Food at its best specializing in Traditional! restaurants.name: Madamara
restaurants.description: Madamara is a busy township shisanyama in Mzilikazi, with graffiti-covered walls and a lively local atmosphere. You pick your cuts and the braai masters grill them in about ten minutes, served with sauces, chillies, sadza and salad. It gets especially busy on Fridays.

restaurants.name: Madziro Stopover
restaurants.description: Madziro Stopover is a casual restaurant found in Mutare. It has 12 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Maize & Mingle Cafe
restaurants.description: Maize & Mingle on Arcturus Road draws families and small groups for its open, plant-filled space and playground. George (July 2025) called it a great place for eating with kids, with “great bathrooms for changing diapers”, and Talent (July 2026) said the kids enjoyed the playground while the food held up. Debbie described a large partitioned function area strung with twinkle lights in a 2025 review.

restaurants.name: Majuru Bar and Restaurant
restaurants.description: Majuru Bar and Restaurant, near Goromonzi outside Ruwa, gets modest, mixed reviews rather than strong praise for any one thing. Marshaal (2025) called it “the best in that area”, while Narboth (2021) found it a “cool place though still improving”. Best (2020) said “The service is fairly reliable” despite pandemic-era disruption, and Farai (2020) mentioned it as a stopover for people working on farming projects nearby.

restaurants.name: Maki Sushi
restaurants.description: Maki Sushi on Quorn Avenue has built a following on fresh salmon despite Zimbabwe being landlocked. Anotida, in 2024, called it “my favorite sushi place in Harare hands down”, surprised the salmon stays “very fresh”, and named the Volcano, Shrimp Rock and Rock and Roll as favourites. Ruvarashe, in 2023, went for the 12-piece platter and “thoroughly loved the maki, California rolls and crunchy maki”.

restaurants.name: MaKuwa-Kuwa Restaurant
addresses: Victoria Falls Safari Lodge, 471 Squire Cummings Road, Victoria FallsDaily
restaurants.description: The award-winning MaKuwa-Kuwa Restaurant at the Victoria Falls Safari Lodge, is widely-known for its unrivalled views overlooking a wildlife-rich waterhole. restaurants.name: Malonga Cafe
addresses: 1 Mosi-oa-Tunya Way, Railway Reserve (next to the Rainforest car park), Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Malonga Cafe sits right by the Rainforest car park entrance to Victoria Falls, and reviewers stop in on the walk to or from the falls. Kal (June 2026) had “Very good Zambezi bream” with “Excellent and polite service”, and Clay (July 2025) split a burger with their son that was “so big” and “made to order and ready in 15 minutes”.

restaurants.name: Malwatte Restaurant & Lodges
restaurants.description: Malwatte is a longstanding roadside stop on the Harare–Mutare highway near Marondera, with a restaurant, lodges and craft shops. The garden draws consistent praise, Arnaud (2025) called it “Amazing garden and nice food”, but service and upkeep have drawn repeated complaints over several years. Stefan (2025) called a simple sandwich and tea “A total ripoff for very poor quality”, and Mathew (2023) found the service “decidedly below par”, with stale bread and broken plates. Tre

restaurants.name: Mambo’s
restaurants.description: Mambo’s Chicken, the new kid on the block brings a whole new meaning to excellence in take-out and customer service in the Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) industry. Specializing in freshly prepared chicken meals, Mambo’s Chicken brings a fusion of both pressure fried and grilled chicken options; something that has not yet been attempted in the Zimbabwean QSR industry successfully. The QSR industry has had its fair share of pioneers in the past but Mambo’s chicken comes in as t

restaurants.name: Mana Mana Uthokoze Restaurant
restaurants.description: Mana Mana Uthokoze Restaurant is a restaurant found in Bulawayo. It has 14 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Manica Skyview Hotel
addresses: Cnr Second Street & Seventh Avenue, Mutare
restaurants.description: Manica Skyview Hotel in Mutare's CBD serves guests on business trips and conferences, and reviewers mention the dining room alongside the rooms. Fortune (December 2019) said the hotel “serve the best Ramp Steak in the province”, and Tsungirai (December 2024) enjoyed “delicious food especially the braai”.

restaurants.name: Mara Mara
restaurants.description: Mara Mara Restaurant and Cocktail Bar on the corner of 2nd Street and Maasdorp Avenue has built its newer menu around wood-fired pizza. Tamuka (October 2025) ordered one at a Sofar Sounds event and found it “a delicious, wood-fire oven, thin crust, meaty pizza” for $18. Veronica (2025) found the Pulled Pork and Pineapple pizza “dry” but preferred the waiter-recommended Giovanni, a beef brisket pizza that turned out “juicy.”

restaurants.name: Marula Cafe
addresses: Shop 1 Centre, corner of Livingstone Way and Parkway Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Marula Cafe at the corner of Livingstone Way and Parkway Drive is a regular stop for coffee before or after the falls, and the Grande Cappuccino served with a shot of Amarula liqueur gets singled out. Ruan (July 2026) called it “a unique touch that turns a simple cup of coffee into a memorable experience”, and Debra (January 2026) credited Nonhlanhla, who “greeted us with the brightest smile and was incredibly friendly.”

restaurants.name: Masala Mosi Restaurant
addresses: N1 Hotel, 266 Adam Stander Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Masala Mosi Restaurant, tucked into the N1 Hotel, serves Indian food that reviewers rate among the best in Victoria Falls. Keerthi (July 2026) called it “One of the best restaurants in the area” and said the food was worth the price, and Nazar (June 2026) praised naan that was “Freshly prepared with great aroma and tastes to perfection.”

restaurants.name: Masvingo Food Court
restaurants.description: Masvingo Food Court on Leopold Takawira Avenue is a busy quick-meal stop in the city centre, and queues build at peak times. Edmore (January 2024) found service “not as quick” on a crowded visit but still called it “the BEST pizza ever from that place”. Francis (May 2023) said crowding has grown since InnBucks service arrived nearby, though “the food and service is not too bad”.

restaurants.name: Mayfair Lodges and Restaurant
restaurants.description: Mayfair, a lodge and restaurant on the Mt Darwin Road in Bindura, gets mixed reviews on both accommodation and food. Andrasz (2025) called the restaurant “simple but tasty and well prepared”, listing “usual choice of t-bone, pork chops, chicken or fish”. Marvellous (March 2026) loved “everything about this place”, from food to rooms.

restaurants.name: Mbumez Wabantu
restaurants.description: Mbumez Wabantu is a local braai spot that reopened under new management about a month before Hugo (October 2024) called it a “Great local brai (BBQ) place”, informal and good value, with beef, pork and chicken grilled over open fires and a “delicious spicy sausage”, cash only. Edward (March 2026) described it as a “Chilled clean spot with high potential”, good for family gatherings and winding down on weekends. Eugene (September 2023) called it simply “Very good and impressiv

restaurants.name: Mbuva Restaurant and Bar
restaurants.description: Mbuva Restaurant and Bar on Harrow Road serves a menu that spans burgers and salads to traditional dishes like mazondo, oxtail and trotters. Margaret (August 2024) called it “Great hearty traditional food, great service, fab experience all round”, and Nashe (March 2023) said “Real traditional food, the food was amazing”.

restaurants.name: Meat Grill
restaurants.description: Meat Grill Bindura serves grilled meat, chops and burgers out of Simwani Complex, and slow service is the main recurring theme in reviews. Anesu (March 2026) said the food “was taking forever”, and Vanrose (January 2026) also reported “very slow service” on one visit. Queen (March 2026) found delivery “a bit on the slow side” and suggested adding another delivery bike.

restaurants.name: Meat Grill
restaurants.description: Meat Grill on Chinhoyi Street is a small, budget-friendly grill spot with a short but consistently positive record. Anthony (February 2023) called the service “Exceptional” and recommended it to anyone “looking for budget friendly meals”, while Beverley (June 2025) found the food good but the kitchen slow to get it out. Nyasha (July 2022) simply said the food was “very nice”. It opens daily from 8am, closing at 9pm on weekdays and Sunday and 10pm on Friday and Saturday.

restaurants.name: Melfort Meat & Grill
restaurants.description: Melfort Meat & Grill is a roadside stopover on the Harare-Mutare highway. Macdonald (April 2025) said “The meat is always fresh and well-grilled, with generous portions and rich flavour,” and recommends the braai plates, “especially the pork chops and boerewors.” Tailone (September 2025) had the “t bone medium rare” with a decent chips portion, though “The mushroom sauce was a bit flat.”

restaurants.name: Mi Casa
restaurants.description: Mi Casa on Fourth Street serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes, and sadza is what regulars mention most. Hillary (January 2023) wrote “Sadza randakadya apa rainaka zvekuti I went back for more the next day”, praising the friendly staff and neat bar area. George (June 2019) called it “the home of traditional dishes”, with a menu suited to healthy eating and cheerful service. Anesu (July 2019) has been enjoying the fish, served with high-fibre sadza. A couple of reviewers mentio

restaurants.name: Middy's Coffee Shop
restaurants.description: Middy's Coffee Shop has been a fixture on Josiah Tongogara Street for years, and long-time visitors describe it as a routine rather than an occasion. Geoffrey, who called it “a serene oasis in a busy city” in April 2023, wrote that Middy's Jacaranda Smoothies “provide a taste sensation” in that same April 2023 review, and that Geoffrey goes there every day when in Bulawayo. Gillian (May 2026) named the shop's carrot cake “the best carrot cake in town”.

restaurants.name: Midlands Hotel
restaurants.description: Historic hotel on Main Street in central Gweru, built in 1927, with an on-site restaurant serving Zimbabwean and international dishes and a bar.

restaurants.name: Milan at Gweru Golf Club
addresses: Gweru Golf Club, 2595 Troon Road, Gweru
restaurants.description: Milan at Gweru Golf Club is a lively restaurant found in Gweru. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Milan Restaurant
addresses: Corner J. Tongogara Ave & Seventh St, Gweru
restaurants.description: Milan Restaurant on the corner of J. Tongogara Avenue and Seventh Street in Gweru gets picked for family platters and working lunches, and the family platter comes up more than once. Claris (October 2025) said the family platter shared with a group “was very good” and planned a return visit from Chiredzi, and Kumbirai Chaya described the fried rice and chicken as worth writing home about in a February 2024 review.

restaurants.name: Mimach Restaurant
restaurants.description: Mimach on Second Street in Mutare has built its name on one item: the shawarma wrap. Gerald (November 2022) said Mimach “may possibly have the best shawarma in Mutare, very fair prices too”, and George (October 2022) called it “phenomenal” alongside excellent chicken and chips. Mama rasta (May 2023) is “so much in love” with the wrap, calling it one of the best in Mutare, though Mama rasta felt customer service could improve.

restaurants.name: Mimie’s Fast Food Court & Restaurant
restaurants.description: Mimie's Fast Food Court in Chitungwiza's St Mary's area keeps reviewers coming back for burgers and fries. Blessed (June 2026) said the “fries very crispy and hot” and the “burger is on point”, and JK (May 2026) agreed the food is “on point” and the place very clean. Tapiwa (November 2025) added that there is free WiFi for customers, and Amos called it “Beautiful place, authentic Zimbabwean feel”. Mimie's is open daily from 08:30 to 22:00.

restaurants.name: Miombo Mountain Lodge & Spa Christon Bank
Mittigrinni
restaurants.description: Located in Mutare, Mittigrinni is a casual restaurant. It has 7 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Moira Jane's Blue Bird Cafe
restaurants.description: Moira Jane's Blue Bird Cafe on Robertson Street is a breakfast and lunch spot that regulars return to on every trip through Masvingo. Hamish (May 2025) has travelled from Scotland two or three times a year for over a decade and calls it “best place to eat in Masvingo by a mile”, with owner Moira and staff “always spot on , real and friendly”. Jochen (October 2022) was surprised to find a proper sit-down restaurant in town at all, since it only serves breakfast and no dinner.

restaurants.name: Mojo's
restaurants.description: A Churrascaria is a Brazilian Steakhouse. Churrasco is a modern celebration of food where Gauchos serve by parading succulent cuts o meat and slicing them fresh & hot in an authentic traditional service style called Rodizio. restaurants.name: Monos Restaurant At Crowne Plaza
restaurants.description: Monos, the restaurant at the Crowne Plaza in Harare's CBD, is used as much for business meetings as for dining. Mrs C. (November 2022) called it a cool place to eat and have professional breakfast meetings, and Chiedza (May 2019) praised “an excellent dining experience in an air-conditioned room” with staff who were “polite and helpful”.

restaurants.name: Moo Ka Thai
restaurants.description: Moo Ka Thai in Borrowdale West serves authentic Thai dishes in a garden setting. Josh (March 2026) had “the duck Bao Buns” and “the green curry,” both “flavorful and well prepared,” while Mazvita (2025) recommended “the wings” and “the tempura fried prawn” dipped “in the wing sauce,” though found the deep fried ice cream “a little more melted than I would have liked.” Vimbai (February 2026) was helped by the waiter Tino, described as “very very informative.”

restaurants.name: Moody Cow Coffee Co Rolfe Valley
restaurants.description: Moody Cow Coffee Co Rolfe Valley is a cafe in Harare. It holds a 4.8/5 rating from 10 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: Moongate
restaurants.description: Moongate is a Chinese restaurant in Belgravia built around a garden entrance, and reviewers linger on the design before the food. Girmay (February 2025) described “a majestic walkway into the garden under moon arches” leading to a glass-walled dining room, and Clotilda (October 2025) relaxed in the cabanas and wrote “you actually forget you're near the bustles of the city.”

restaurants.name: Mosi Grill
restaurants.description: Mosi Grill outside Victoria Falls pairs a grill menu with quad bike village tours, and reviewers treat it as a stop for both food and activities. Marleen (July 2023) called it “one of our fav restaurants” with “the best pizza and sizzling bones in Victoria Falls”, and Tanatswa (January 2022) said the burger and loaded fries were “just to die for”.

restaurants.name: Moto Moto
restaurants.description: Moto Moto on Central Avenue serves a small but well-liked menu of pizza, ribs and grilled meat. Mr K. (October 2024) recommended “nice Pizza, Short ribs and Kebab”, and Chido (August 2024) called the moto moto pizza a reason the restaurant is “underrated”. Kelvin (March 2025) found the place clean and secure with “lots of variety on the food to offer” at moderate pricing, a contrast to Charmaine and Vanrose, who each still enjoyed the food despite calling the options limited.

restaurants.name: Mozambik
addresses: Shop number 17&18, Harare Westgate Shopping Centre, A1, Harare
restaurants.description: Mozambik in Chisipite is built for families: reviewers describe a full-scale pirate ship playground with a child minder, plus indoor and outdoor seating. Ajay (December 2025) called the atmosphere “fantastic”, and SimbaRashe (September 2025) said it has “the biggest play area I have seen for a restaurant including a child minder”. Mozambik Honeybear in Greystone Park is a seafood spot reviewers describe with a beach feel, sand underfoot and a play area for kids. Ajay (March 2

restaurants.name: Mozambik
restaurants.description: Mozambik Bulawayo on Livingstone Road runs largely on its waitstaff, and reviewers name them constantly: Percy, Khosi, Allan, Brian, Prosper and Rejoice all get individual thanks. Nqoblie (June 2026) said Percy “was so friendly, sweet, and always had a warm smile” while serving the quarter chicken with chips, and Liz (January 2026) singled out Prosper, who “took his time to explain the menu clearly, gave excellent recommendations.”

restaurants.name: Mpumalanga Lodge
restaurants.description: Mpumalanga Lodge in Gweru's Clonsilla suburb pairs a small lodge with a cozy dining room close to the main Bulawayo highway. Rachel (October 2019) praised the “good breakfast, oats porridge like my grandma used to make” alongside newly renovated rooms, and Ephraim (June 2023) rated the food “5 star quality” though Ephraim wanted “improvement on the WiFi and towels for bathing and drying.”

restaurants.name: MR Chips Gweru CBD
restaurants.description: Mr Chips on Robert Mugabe Way in Gweru's CBD is known simply for its chips. Shawn (November 2024) called them “the best quality chips in town absolutely exquisite”, and Nyasha (October 2021) agreed, rating them “the best and fairly priced chips in town” alongside soft drinks, chicken portions, Russians and sadza.

restaurants.name: Mr Sadza
restaurants.description: Mr Sadza on Robson Manyika serves grilled meats and traditional dishes, and reviewers keep coming back for specific plates. Tanaka (February 2024) singled out the fried rice and juicy chicken, and Keith (September 2024) called the beef stroganoff the best on offer. Daniel (May 2023) priced the rice and chicken at $4 with “a very very big big piece of chicken”, spiced rice and potato salad included.

restaurants.name: Msasa Café
restaurants.description: Village bar and café near the village green, where locals come for a drink, pool and football on TV. A small kitchen serves a daily dish such as sadza with gravy.

restaurants.name: Mtotwe
restaurants.description: Mtotwe on The Chase in Harare gets recommended for its pizza, though service complaints come up often enough to matter. Kundai (2025) called the pizza “one of the best pizzas I've had in Harare” and found the Hungry Huku salad “fresh, vibrant, and packed with a variety of ingredients”.

restaurants.name: Mulberry Restaurant & Cafe
addresses: Borrowdale Brooke Club house Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Mulberry is located in Borrowdale Brooke golf course at the clubhouse. We have a beautiful deck overlooking the dam. Our food is all made fresh to order and uses the best possible ingredients. addresses: Shop 44b & c, 13th Avenue (between Lobengula & Basch Streets, opposite the power station), Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Mumsie's Kitchen is a family-run traditional-food restaurant that began as a caravan and grew to several outlets in Bulawayo. It serves home-style African dishes and was nominated in the 2021 Service Excellence Awards (Southern Region).

restaurants.name: Musangano Lodge
addresses: Champion Mine Road, Odzi (approx. 28 km from Mutare)
restaurants.description: Musangano Lodge, set in the hills outside Mutare, gets most of its praise for the setting rather than any one dish, but reviewers who eat at the in-house restaurant come away satisfied. Tanya (August 2025) rated the food “a 9/10” after mashed potatoes and beef rolled with bacon, while a partner had brown sadza and oxtail.

restaurants.name: Mutangaz Hideout
restaurants.description: Mutangaz Hideout in Ruwa is an outdoor braai and drinks spot with its own abattoir selling cheap beef, plus a pool and DJ. Trevor (January 2026) noted the abattoir sells “very cheap beef” alongside the music and braai facilities. Tarisai (2024), returning after more than a decade, was impressed by a “total revamp and addition of landscaped garden leisure area”, plus affordable fast food for kids and adults alike.

restaurants.name: Mutirikwi Lakeshore Lodges Restaurant
restaurants.description: The restaurant and bar at Mutirikwi Lakeshore Lodges, on the shore of Lake Mutirikwi about 36.5km from Masvingo and 10km from the Great Zimbabwe Monuments. The lodge promotes fresh, natural food, and its restaurant caters for a range of dietary needs.

restaurants.name: Mwana Africa Take Aways
restaurants.description: Mwana Africa Take Aways in Victoria Falls is a small stop reviewers recommend for a quick bite. Niklas (April 2026) praised the “Top steak sandwich and friendly service”. Joyce (December 2023) found the food “Delicious” in a welcoming environment. A German-speaking visitor in 2024 rated it highly and called it good value for money.

restaurants.name: Nam Took
addresses: 1st Floor, Elephant's Walk, 273 Adam Stander Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Nam Took is a Thai restaurant tucked upstairs at Elephant's Walk, and reviewers frequently mention how easy it is to walk past. Emily (July 2016) called it “good thai food above a small market” reached by finding the market stairs, and Calum (May 2018) described it as “suprisingly good Thai food tucked away in Vic Falls”.

restaurants.name: Nandi's Burger Bar
restaurants.description: Nandi's Burger Bar in Mutare serves burgers in a garden setting, and diners agree on the food even when they disagree on the wait. Chipo (May 2017) called it “Sumptuous burgers and hearty fresh meals”, and Mavhiza (February 2025) said “This place is heaven, good food, good atmosphere and welcoming staff”.

restaurants.name: Nandipha's Table
addresses: 989 Sheffield Road, Light Industrial Site, Gweru
restaurants.description: Lunchtime restaurant in Gweru's Light Industrial Site serving Zimbabwean dishes, from stews to salads, Monday to Saturday.

restaurants.name: Nando's
addresses: Avondale Shopping Centre, King George Road, Harare
restaurants.description: A long-established sit-down Nando's in Avondale Shopping Centre serving flame-grilled peri-peri chicken, with semi-outdoor seating and Afrocentric décor.

restaurants.name: Nando's
addresses: Esigodini Road, opposite Fazak Home & Hyper, Woodlands, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Nando's flagship sit-down branch in central Bulawayo was renovated at a reported cost of $510,000, raising seating from 102 to 132. It serves the chain's flame-grilled peri-peri chicken, wraps and bowls in a spacious dining room with booths, alongside RocoMamas and KFC on the same street. Nando's Woodlands branch on Esigodini Road, opposite Fazak Home & Hyper, added a drive-thru in December 2025 while keeping its sit-down section. It serves the usual flame-grilled peri-peri c

restaurants.name: Nando's
restaurants.description: Nando's Gweru's flame-grilled chicken and wide sauce selection draw praise, but recent reviews raise concerns about consistency. Masimba (May 2026) found the chips “a bit raw” despite good service and a calm environment. Patience (May 2026) said the chips were “stuffed in fat” and the food arrived cold after a 30-minute wait. Emily (May 2026) received a wrap with undisclosed coleslaw and said a staff member ignored questions about table service. Elvis (May 2026) is the except

restaurants.name: Nando's
restaurants.description: Sit-down branch of the peri-peri chicken chain in Mutare's city centre, with a spacious dining room and on-site parking. Reviewers single out the flame-grilled chicken, rice and garlic rolls.

restaurants.name: Nando's
addresses: Sawanga Mall, Pioneer Road, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Sit-down branch of the flame-grilled peri-peri chicken chain at Sawanga Mall, operated by Simbisa Brands. Popular with locals and with visitors crossing from Livingstone.

restaurants.name: Nando's Kwekwe
restaurants.description: This Nando's on the Harare–Bulawayo highway in Kwekwe works well as a stop for travellers, and Joseph (2022) said the service felt as good as “a proper sitting down restaurant” despite being a highway stop, with “fanatic flavor as always when you are at Nandos”. Dumisa (February 2026) dines there regularly with family and still finds the food great, though noted in an update that the prices are steep and the waiters now too few.

restaurants.name: Natalias Cuisine
addresses: Long Cheng Plaza Bulawayo Road/ Mutley Bend, Harare, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Continental Restaurant and Takeaway. addresses: 7 St Kildas Building, cnr Fort Street & 5th Avenue, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Ndwangu Restaurant is a small fast-food style restaurant and takeaway in St Kildas Building on the corner of Fort Street and 5th Avenue in central Bulawayo. It does dine-in, takeaway and delivery, and customer photos show flame-grilled whole chicken with salad.

restaurants.name: Nelly’s Plate
restaurants.description: Nelia is a service industry professional with loads of education and years under her belt. Nelia has worked in the Hospitality & Tourism industry having served, catered, managed, and cooked in resorts, hotels and restaurants. restaurants.name: New Orleans Restaurant
addresses: Banff Lodge Hotel, 35 Banff Road, Hillside, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: New Orleans sits in the grounds of Banff Lodge Hotel in Hillside, and pizza is the dish most reviewers name first. Zembe called it “one of the best pizzas in this country” in a 2025 review, and Josefin (April 2025) agreed the pizzas were “best we'vd had in Zim” after trying many other places in the country. restaurants.name: Nexus Roof Top
restaurants.description: Nexus Roof Top is a restaurant in Bulawayo. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far. Priced budget-friendly.

restaurants.name: Ngezi Restaurant
restaurants.description: Ngezi Restaurant Avondale is a restaurant in Harare. It holds a 3.9/5 rating from 152 Google Maps reviews. Ngezi Restaurant Belgravia serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes alongside grilled steaks and burgers, on Lanark Road in Belgravia. Sithabiso (March 2024) called it the “go to place for a nice and quick traditional food experience” and said the kitchen is “generous with their meat portions”. Mysoul (November 2025) got “a complimentary cup of maheu on the house” with an am

restaurants.description: We serve fine African cuisine. Restaurant in Harare, Zimbabwe. restaurants.name: Nitos Chill & Grill
restaurants.description: Nitos Chill & Grill on Arcturus Road works as a low-key grill by day and a busier spot after dark. Tafadzwa (2023) rated the grilled chicken “top notch” but found service a bit slow and the place generally crowded on weekends. Vimbai (2022) described it as “quite fun at night” while still “conducive for kids” during the day, and KSM (2022) suggested arriving before 6pm for those who prefer to avoid the evening crowds.

restaurants.name: Nomilo's Cafe
restaurants.description: Nomilo's Cafe is a cafe restaurant in Gweru. It has 7 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: NoodleBox
addresses: Paddington Square, Shop 21, 178 ED Mnangagwa Rd, Harare
restaurants.description: NoodleBox Harare at Paddington Square gets called some of the best Asian food in the city. Tanaka (December 2025) named it “The best Asian food in Harare” and loved the Nasi Goreng, and Julie (2024) called the Phad Thai “a litmus test for any self-proclaimed noodle aficionado” that impressed from the first bite.

restaurants.name: Nyota Zimbabwean Cuisine
restaurants.description: Nyota is a family-run backyard restaurant in Victoria Falls that serves a home-cooked buffet rather than a printed menu. Guests typically pay around $25 for a set spread that includes drinks, and Wylie (May 2024) counted “nine dishes served for dinner in family style”, from pap to beer and wine. Jehan (August 2024) named “Ox tail, peanut butter rice and Okra” as personal favourites among the dishes cooked to order.

restaurants.name: Oak Tree Restaurant
addresses: 216 Rolf Valley Avenue, Rolf Valley, Harare
restaurants.description: Oak Tree, a garden restaurant in Rolf Valley, draws praise for its pastas and its setting in equal measure. Dr M. (2025) found the food “especially the pastas, which are rich, fresh, and full of flavor”, surrounded by green trees and a peaceful outdoor setting. Anotida (2025) added that pasta, steak, burgers and kids' meals all arrive “hot and treating fresh and full of flavor”.

restaurants.name: Obu Bite Restaurant
restaurants.description: Obu Bite Restaurant is a restaurant found in Bulawayo. It has 8 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Occasions Restaurant
restaurants.description: Occasions in Chinhoyi has a good location, but reviewers repeatedly flag the service. Jonathan (2023) called it “a wonderful joint but the service is awful”, noting “The fridges are always naked, the beer not so cold”. Nyasha (2017) agreed there is poor service and found “the food isn't prepared well at times”.

restaurants.name: Ocean Basket
addresses: Highland Park Mall, 2 Ridgeway South, Harare
restaurants.description: Ocean Basket at Highland Park Mall is a seafood outlet where the service gets named almost review by review. Nothando is mentioned again and again, and Erika (February 2026) said Nothando was “so kind, professional, & helpful”. Pauline, Mary, Tanaka and Eve turn up just as often, each credited with quick, cheerful service. Ocean Basket Cork Corner gets the same kind of review again and again: a named server who made the visit. Tafadzwa (August 2026) said the seafood was “fres

restaurants.name: Oh So Scrumptious
restaurants.description: Oh So Scrumptious Café on Montgomery Avenue is known for its crepes as much as its coffee. Anita (November 2025) called a Lotus Biscoff crepe the star of the visit, thin and golden and folded around “rich caramelized cookie butter goodness”, and Lorraine (August 2026) recommends the chicken tacos in a cozy room with excellent service.

restaurants.name: Oh So Sushi
addresses: Queen of Hearts, 1 Hurworth Road, Highlands, Harare
restaurants.description: A counter-service sushi bar inside the Queen of Hearts complex serving sushi, poke bowls, stir-fries and platters, eaten in the Queen of Hearts garden or taken away.

restaurants.name: Old Rock Cafe
restaurants.description: Old Rock Café on Ridgeway North pairs food with live entertainment through the week. Malcolm (May 2026) called it “Fantastic food, reasonably priced” with “draft beer on tap” and live music on Saturdays, plus three screens for sport. PK (2024) celebrated a birthday there and rated it “Great food, service and live comedy!”

restaurants.name: Open House Café
addresses: 21 Angel King Avenue, Mzari Road, Chinhoyi
restaurants.description: Open House Cafe in Chinhoyi is a small stop for coffee and light meals, often mentioned as a break on the road to Harare. Hope (August 2026) had “the best butter chicken curry” and homemade lemonade during a family stop, and Shingai (2025) enjoyed “coffee to go” plus “homemade granadilla juice” that was “delicious – a burst of fresh, tropical flavor”. Antoine (November 2025) called the coffee “excellent, one of the best in the area”.

restaurants.name: Orange Grove Motel – Flamingo Restaurant
addresses: 1 Orange Grove Drive, off Harare–Chirundu Highway, Chinhoyi
restaurants.description: The CUT Hotels motel off the Chirundu highway. Its Flamingo Restaurant serves local and international dishes at breakfast, lunch and dinner. The Fishermen's Bar has a rustic feel and holds free-entry jazz nights with food.

restaurants.name: Organikks
restaurants.description: Organikks Patio in Borrowdale draws a crowd for its Jazz Nights, and the setting gets mentioned as often as the food. Keir (March 2025) wrote “Great ambience. Friendly staff and the service is great”, recommending the Organic Jazz Quartet and the mushroom soup on the side. Organikks Ndizvo in Chisipite pairs steaks and sushi in one Afro-chic space, and reviewers rate the sushi and steaks highest. Hillary (2023) called it “definitely the best in town” for sushi, and Noxy (2023

restaurants.name: Oscar's Restaurant & Bar
restaurants.description: Oscar's on Quorn Ave draws families for its play area, with a mixed record on food and service. Yananiso (February 2026) liked “the poke bowl,” calling it “fresh, vibrant and flavorful,” and said “the s'mores brownie was to die for.” Marcin (July 2026) praised a steak that “was very good, and the sides were also great.” Farai (April 2026) had a rougher visit, ordering battered fish that “left a lot to be desired,” and felt “understaffed” and “neglected by the servers.” Joseph

restaurants.name: PaCar Wash Restaurant
restaurants.description: PaCar Wash Restaurant in Chinhoyi pairs a family restaurant with a car wash, and most reviewers rate the food highly. Michael (June 2026) found “friendly staff, inviting atmosphere, fast service, excellent prices!” and came back three more times after that first visit. Munashe (January 2026) recommends the fish n chips and a mocktail called Blue Tail, calling the food “2nd best in my palette”. Felix (December 2025) said “the food is really really nice” in a beautifully arrang

restaurants.name: Pachedu Restaurant
restaurants.description: Pachedu Restaurant in Harare's Avenues area is a straightforward, affordable stop. Thulani (September 2022) called it a “Great place to eat at in Harare” that also “serve cold beer”, and Dioleen, that same month, found “the owner is friendly and delicious food”. Paradzai (July 2022) rated it “Affordable meals in Avenues area”, and Brighton (September 2023) simply put it as “Nice food and sitting space”.

restaurants.name: Padanda Restaurant
restaurants.description: A traditional Zimbabwean kitchen on Cork Road in Avondale, and the Harare outpost of Padanda Resort in Nyanga. The menu is built almost entirely around sadza — with oxtail, road runner, pork bones, tsuro, chimukuyu, mazondo, guru nematumbu and musoro we mbudzi — alongside hodzeko and mupunga une dovi. Food delivery is available.

restaurants.name: Padandaro Restaurant
restaurants.description: Padandaro on Fourth Street in Mutare's CBD serves traditional meals and braai alongside a chilled beer, and reviewers describe it as a reliable neighbourhood spot. Trust (October 2019) called it a place for “a chilled beer and a mouth watering type of traditional meals and take aways”, and Tapuwa (August 2018) put it simply: eat sadza and braai here.

restaurants.name: PADANGA
restaurants.description: Padanga on Bickford Road in Gweru is a family chill spot more than a food destination. Tendekayi (February 2026) described a “Serene environment with good outdoor sitting area and a selection of food and drinks”, and Rumbidzaii (November 2024) found the place “nice, well maintained” with decent service, though added “The food is just ok. Could do a little better.” Most reviewers come back for the relaxed setting rather than any one dish.

restaurants.name: Pagomba PaMakasva
restaurants.description: A sports bar and grill with a butchery pub in Nemanwa Township, close to the Great Zimbabwe Monument. It opened in late 2025 and hosts DJs and live artists.

restaurants.name: Pagomo Pub & Grill
addresses: Clipsham Views, behind Puma service station (Wimpy), Masvingo
restaurants.description: Pagomo Pub & Grill operates behind the Puma service station in Masvingo's Clipsham Views, and reviewers treat it as the neighbourhood's grill and pool hall of choice. David (June 2025) described it as “a secret chill hide out with cold beverages not to mention juicy grills”, and Kudzai (March 2025) said the atmosphere is chilled and singled out “the best pool tables”.

restaurants.name: PaHuku
addresses: Hillside Shopping Centre, Southey Road, Hillside, Harare
restaurants.description: An open-air braai spot at Hillside Shopping Centre whose name means 'the chicken place' in Shona. You choose a whole bird, it is roasted over the fire while you watch and served with sadza; Saturday afternoons are the busiest, with crowds socialising around their cars.

restaurants.name: Palm River Hotel
restaurants.description: Palm River Hotel sits on the banks of the Zambezi outside Victoria Falls, and its restaurant gets rated well above typical hotel food. Thomas (June 2026) found that “every time we ate somewhere else in the falls, it didn't come close to the Palm's food.” CC (December 2025) said the “Restaurant food is excellent and exudes an old world charm,” and Robyn (May 2024) described meals as “fresh and well presented with generous serves,” with a wide selection at breakfast.

restaurants.name: Palm Tree Place
restaurants.description: Palm Tree Place in Chiredzi is a boutique hotel with an on-site restaurant, gardens and a sports bar, and dining gets folded into most stay reviews. Helio (August 2026) found the “Service at the restaurant is good, but a bit slow”, while praising gardens that “are amazing for this area”.

restaurants.name: Palmview Guest Lodge
restaurants.description: Palmview Guest Lodge in Masvingo draws reviewers back for the staff as much as the rooms. Blessing (June 2021) described the team as “very attentive, professional and friendly”, and Lynam (May 2025) stayed a week and had the car washed while sleeping, on top of laundry service each day.

restaurants.name: Pamugoti
restaurants.description: Come and enjoy traditional meals in Harare, Zimbabwe. restaurants.name: Pamujinga
restaurants.description: Pamujinga sits in the Bvumba mountains outside Mutare, and until early 2026 reviews describe relaxed afternoons among gardens and mountain views. Sabrina (January 2025) called it set in “the beautiful vumba mountains” with “Gorgeous view” and “Delicious food”. Kate (November 2024) said the pasta was “as good as you would be served in Italy” and the lasagne “exceptional” at a very reasonable price. Paul (September 2024) rated the T-bone “cooked to perfection”.

restaurants.name: Pamusoja
restaurants.description: Pamusoja sits at the edge of Chegutu's CBD, and reviewers come mostly for the food rather than the setting. Apostle (2023) called the ambiance superb and praised the “delicious food (especially the Stroganoff and rice and sadza )”, while Tanaka (2023) found the cooking good but hoped for a proper kitchen and paving to cut down on dust in windy season.
