restaurants.description: The main dining room at Elephant Hills Resort, seating around 180 and serving buffet and à la carte meals, with live entertainment at dinner. The resort also has the Kasibi Terrace overlooking the Zambezi, a pool deck known for barbecues and the Mapopoma bar with views of the spray.

restaurants.name: San Siro Sports Bar & Grill
restaurants.description: San Siro Sports Bar & Grill opened in Hillside Extension in December 2024 and has become a busy Masvingo nightlife spot. Liberty (May 2026) found it “nicely lit — warm and inviting without being too dark”, with food that came out hot and quick, friendly service. Santana (April 2026) said “I was genuinely shocked” by the quality, adding “Didn't expect this in the heart of Masvingo.”

restaurants.name: Sango Restaurant – Cresta Sprayview
restaurants.description: The restaurant at Cresta Sprayview, 1.4 km from the Rainforest entrance, offering al fresco dining by the pool and a breakfast buffet. The hotel also has the Railway cocktail bar and the Rain Forest bar.

restaurants.name: Sanja On The Deck
restaurants.description: Sanja on the Deck, a Chinese restaurant on Mvuma Road in Kwekwe, gets strong marks for its food when eaten in. Gideon (July 2026) found the food “absolutely amazing” with generous portions and recommended sitting in “to get the absolute best experience”. Rutendo (May 2026) agreed the food was “on point”, and Dumisa (January 2026) called it “top notch” for both personal and professional occasions.

restaurants.name: 四季私房菜 Seasons Restaurant
restaurants.description: Seasons Restaurant in Groombridge serves Chinese food that reviewers keep calling some of the best in Harare. Mongo (April 2025) named it “The best Chinese food in Harare”, and Sharmaine (November 2025) found it “Very authentic China Chinese food” after coming back twice. Complimentary tea before the meal gets a mention from Sibusiso (July 2026), who called it “a lovely touch”.

restaurants.name: Selborne Cafe
addresses: Selborne Hotel, 134 Leopold Takawira Avenue (opposite City Hall), Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Selborne Cafe, inside the Selborne Hotel in central Bulawayo, serves a wider menu than its name suggests, including pizza and burgers alongside soups. John (January 2019) had “the double beef party burger and mince pizzas” and found the food “well priced and filling if somewhat bland”, while Tinotenda (March 2023) thought the menu “is to die for” though “pricy but worth the money”. Josephine (February 2021) praised the soups in particular.

restaurants.name: Shakespoon
restaurants.description: Shakespoon in Mutare is known for shawarmas and burgers, served in house or delivered. Nyasha (July 2024) called it home to “the best Shawarmas ever” in Mutare, and Tinashe (February 2023) liked that “they do deliveries too” with food “well cooked.” Swavenikah (March 2025) travelled from Harare and came away with “a nice service and delicious food.”

restaurants.name: Shangri-La
restaurants.description: Shangri La on Leopold Takawira Avenue is a Chinese restaurant that reviewers say rewards ordering the right dishes. Malcolm (May 2026) argued people who order shrimp and then complain are missing the point, recommending instead “dumplings, sweet & sour chicken, chicken chao mein”. Ruvarashe found the sizzling beef and garlic rice “an absolute must” in a 2024 review, and Charlene (February 2024) singled out the tofu, fried mushroom and fish fillet.

restaurants.name: Shangri-La
addresses: A2, 155 Enterprise (ED Mnangagwa) Road, Chisipite, Harare
restaurants.description: We are the leading Restaurant in Zimbabwe for Chinese cuisine. We also can host Weddings, Conferences & any sort of parties or events Chinese style. restaurants.name: Shoestrings Bar & Restaurant
addresses: Shoestrings Backpackers, 12 West Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: The bar and restaurant at Shoestrings Backpackers, open to non-residents for all meals. Known for home-fired pizza, rotisserie chicken and vegetarian-friendly options, with live music and events on weekends.

restaurants.name: Shongwe Lookout
restaurants.description: Shongwe Lookout on Mopane Street pairs its dining room with a tower over the Zambezi, and reviewers treat sundowners there as part of the meal. Danielle (February 2026) called “happy hour at the rooftop lookout was a great way to unwind”, and Ben (October 2025) called the tower view “the perfect spot for a sundowner”. Todd (July 2026) rated watching sunrise and sunset from the lookout “a perfect way to end and start the day”.

restaurants.name: SHOZ Grill n Chill
restaurants.description: A casual grill in Chinhoyi's Christos area known for grilled meats. It serves from breakfast time into the evening.

restaurants.name: Shumba Village
restaurants.description: Shumba Village is a newer restaurant on Kenilworth Road built around music and a lively atmosphere. Gerald (2024) described walking in as a “Wow” moment thanks to “a beautiful ambiance,” and Obvious (June 2026) called it “best traditional food in town.” Tino (2024) agreed the food was great in “a peaceful chilling place with great music.”

restaurants.name: Signatures
restaurants.description: Signatures Borrowdale opened to good early reviews, but recent visits describe a kitchen and service team struggling to keep up. Divine (June 2026) said the restaurant “started out very well” with great atmosphere, but grilled meat arrived cold on one visit and a takeaway order came up half the portion Divine had paid for. Able (January 2026) had a similarly rough time, describing a waitress who could not answer basic questions about steak weights, ageing or pizza quality, an

restaurants.name: Simba's Artisan Bakery
addresses: Shop 9, Bata Complex, corner Livingstone Way & Park Way, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: A small craft bakery in the town centre run by Chef Simba, offering sourdough, laminated pastries, tarts, mini cakes, meat pies and Neapolitan-style pizza. There is a small street-side seating area.

restaurants.name: Simply Delicious
addresses: White Star Farm, Whitestones Way, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Pop in at Simply Delicious for coffee and cake, and whilst you wait can do a little grocery shopping too. Drummond chicken, Ascot butchery meat, Sedgemoor dairy. And maybe a little present for your home! restaurants.name: Simujinga Restaurant – Victoria Falls Rainbow Hotel
addresses: Victoria Falls Rainbow Hotel, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: The Rainbow Hotel's restaurant ('simujinga' means rainbow), serving a blend of African and Western dishes. Dinner can extend to the hotel's Kraal, with Zimbabwean food and traditional dance and marimba entertainment; the hotel also has a swim-up pool bar and a rooftop deck with views of the spray.

restaurants.name: Sip 'n' Stay
restaurants.description: Sip 'n' Stay is a casual restaurant found in Mutare. It has 6 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Sis Bee's Kitchen
restaurants.description: Sis Bee's Kitchen on the corner of 8th Avenue and Fort Street focuses on traditional dishes, with Kudakwashe (March 2026) describing it as a place that “mainly serves delicious traditional dishes”. Thobile (2021) enjoyed the food in a quiet, peaceful room, writing that the kitchen knows “how to satisfy a tummy”, and Noel (November 2025) called a lunch there one with “cultural touch”.

restaurants.name: Sis Phathi's Kitchen
restaurants.description: Sis Phathi's is a traditional-food kitchen in the city centre run by Siphatisiwe Ncube, cooking over open fires in an alley kitchen that has been running for about 15 years. Dishes include boiled village-reared chicken, ox-head stew, tripe, okra and small-grain sadza made from sorghum or millet, with meals around $5. It was featured in AFP's June 2026 report on Bulawayo's traditional-food revival.

restaurants.name: Sizzlers
restaurants.description: Sizzlers on Second Avenue in Mutare's CBD is a quick-bite spot built around shawarma and wraps. Wadzanai (May 2019) called the food amazing, “especially their shawarma mmm yummy”, and Arnold (June 2022) agreed “the shawarma was delicious”. Carl picked out the samoosas and chicken wraps, and Ashi (October 2018) described it as the place to go for a quick bite that will still “satify the lion in you”.

restaurants.name: Sizzlers fast foods
restaurants.description: Sizzlers on Herbert Chitepo Street in Mutare is known for firewood-fired pizza and samoosas. Martin (May 2024) “Loved the pizza they make from firewood and nice samoosas,” and Wellington (February 2022) said “Great spicey food served here, I love their Samoosas.” ZambeZi (January 2019) recommends the “Good shawarma,braai” alongside “nice customer service.”

restaurants.name: Skyview City Restaurant
restaurants.description: Skyview City Restaurant on Herbert Chitepo Street serves grills, sadza dishes and traditional plates such as mazondo and madora alongside burgers. Junior (January 2020) called the pork chops “freaking amazing” and was pleasantly surprised by the Mushroom Burger. Keeganm (November 2025) enjoyed the pork ribs, though joked there's “no sky to view” despite the name.

restaurants.name: Skyview Conference Centre Park Restaurant
restaurants.description: Skyview in Mutare serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes, from sadza and gango to mazondo and oxtail. Jonathan (November 2020) called the food “to die for”, giving “Bigs ups to the kitchen always”. Ryan (October 2020) agreed the place was “immaculate and conveniently located”, with meals meant to “satiate your Zimbabwean traditional meal cravings”, and mentioned a welcoming staff member by the entrance.

restaurants.name: Smoke & Vine
restaurants.description: Smoke & Vine is a braai-style grill in Bulawayo, and beef ribs are the dish reviewers name most. Robert (March 2025) “LOVED the BEEF RIBS,” and Wellington (November 2024) picked out “great food especially the beef ribs.” Kudzai (November 2025) said simply “the beef ribs are on point.”

restaurants.name: Smokey Beatz
addresses: Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale Rd, HarareMon Closed
restaurants.description: Smokey Beatz is a barbecue spot at Sam Levy's Village with a small but enthusiastic run of reviews. Melisa (August 2026) described “Amazing atmosphere” and courteous staff, noting it “gets a bit busy during the late hours of the evening but the vibe is unmatched”. Tashinga (August 2026) praised the food alongside “amazing service”. It runs Tuesday to Saturday from midday to 11:30pm and Sunday to 10:30pm, closed Mondays.

restaurants.name: SnackWorld Restaurant
restaurants.description: SnackWorld Restaurant is a restaurant in Harare. It has 5 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Solomon's Café
addresses: King Solomon Hotel – Golden Mile, 89 Cardinal Close, Chicago, Kwekwe
restaurants.description: Solomon's Café at the King Solomon Hotel on Kwekwe's Golden Mile serves an all-day menu alongside a poolside bar. Mary (2019) had “an excellent T-bone and sadza” at a price not matched “in a long time”, and Nkululeko (2019) had a full Bush breakfast “on our table in less than 10 minutes” despite the size of the order.

restaurants.name: Solomons Lifestyle Cafe
restaurants.description: Solomons Lifestyle Cafe is a high-class high life cafe, offering high profile entertainment, food, and liquor all the time. restaurants.name: Sorrel Restaurant and Lounge
addresses: Bath Road, behind Avondale Shopping Centre (opposite the flea market), HarareDaily from 12:00
restaurants.description: Sorrel sits behind Avondale Shopping Centre and serves Jamaican food from a husband-and-wife team, one from Jamaica and one from Zimbabwe, who bring in ingredients and rum from home. James (December 2025) called it “excellent representation of a Jamaican experience” after the oxtail and curry goat, and Evester (March 2024) was glad to learn “the chef and spices are actually from Jamaica”, naming the oxtail with rice and peas as a favourite.

restaurants.name: Spice Lounge
addresses: 63 Churchill Avenue, Alexandra Park, HarareDaily from 12:00 for lunch and dinner
restaurants.description: Spice Lounge in Alexandra Park serves North Indian food with a round of complimentary nibbles and sauces before the meal starts. Anotida (2025) said the nibbles “gets the taste buds going” and named the fish curries and butter chicken as favourites. Ajay (2024) called it “the best vegetarian food experience in Harare”, with spices handled the way they are in Northern India, and did not mind that prices run a little higher than average. Mutale (2025) liked the warm, cozy atmos

restaurants.name: Spring Fever
restaurants.description: Since 1993 Springfever has been blessing the people of Zimbabwe with delicious, hearty meals. Springfever started as a little roadside stall halfway between Harare and Kariba. Little did they know popular demand would force them to become a thriving hotspot beloved by many. Springfever’s success can be accredited to their passion for people and their love of good food. The quality of Springfever’s service has not been overlooked. Springfever boasts with multiple coveted Zimba

restaurants.name: Springroll Centre
restaurants.description: Spring Roll Centre has been a family owned business since the 60’s. Change of ownership to a local family has come with a variety of changes. Renovations, additions to the menu. We offer a diverse range of products. We specialize in our own unique take on Chinese food as well as other additions such as burgers and local foods. Our specialty and how we made a name for ourselves are of course our unique Spring Rolls. We can guarantee you won’t find spring rolls like ours anywhe

restaurants.name: Spur
addresses: Shop 55, Greenfields Shopping Centre, Hampden Street, Belvedere, Harare
restaurants.description: Spur Greenfields draws a steady stream of praise for its waiters, with one name, Darlington, appearing in review after review. Jonathan (May 2026) called the atmosphere fantastic but said Darlington's “exceptional service and incredible patience with the kids were unmatched”, and Primerose (February 2026) said Darlington Nheta made sure the table “ate until we were full and satisfied”. Melinda (June 2026) praised quick service and an attitude that showed pride in the work, wi

restaurants.name: Spurwing Island
restaurants.description: An island lodge on Lake Kariba, running since 1980, known for its food: a daily lunch buffet with pickled bream, three- or four-course dinners and big breakfasts. Day visitors can book lunch, and on Saturdays it holds a braai or potjie open to houseboat and other lake guests.

restaurants.name: St.Aubrey's
restaurants.description: St. Aubrey's built its reputation on seafood. Sandra (2025) said the food was “fresh ans flavourful particularly the prawns”, with prices reasonable for the quality and portion size, and Tinashe (2025) called the seafood boil “LIFE CHANGING”, with flavours that keep popping.

restaurants.name: St Elmo's
restaurants.description: St Elmo's on East Road in Belgravia is built for families with children rather than a quiet dinner out. Talfan (September 2025) called kids eating free on Wednesday “such a blessing,” and Yeukai (July 2025) said birthdays there come with “the play area, the singing and free ice cream for the birthday boy/girl.”

restaurants.name: St Elmo’s
restaurants.description: Welcome to St Elmo’s restaurant and take away! We are a premier restaurant with two restaurants, located in Borrowdale and Avondale, Harare, where you can find the best pasta, grills and pizza! At St Elmo’s we strive to provide a high level of customer satisfaction and take pride in the renowned quality of our food and friendly atmosphere of our restaurant. Our menu is available throughout the week, with a wide array of choices, so that there is something to suit all tastes!

restaurants.name: Stanley's Terrace
addresses: The Victoria Falls Hotel, 1 Mallet Drive, Victoria FallsDaily; beverages 10:00–22:00, all-day menu 11:00–22:00, high tea 15:00–17:00 (non-residents pre-book)
restaurants.description: Stanley's Terrace, on the grounds of the Victoria Falls Hotel, trades on its view of the historic bridge and the falls' mist rather than an adventurous menu. Natalia (January 2026) had chilled avocado soup, carrot soup, chicken curry and sea bass, all “exquisitely cooked”, and credited server Beatrice as “lovely, softly spoken and very professional”. Simon (May 2025) found the high tea, at $50 per couple, worth it for “good sandwich selection, lovely carrot cake and scones”.

restaurants.name: Steak and Chips
restaurants.description: Central Gweru eatery in the Meikles Building on Fifth Street, known for steaks served with chips alongside other grilled meats.

restaurants.name: Stimela Trackside Dining
addresses: Restored heritage train on the railway siding, Victoria Falls town centreDinner Mon, Thu & Sat (reservations recommended)
restaurants.description: A dining concept launched by Bushtracks Africa in November 2025, serving a three-course dinner of locally inspired dishes aboard a restored heritage train parked on the siding in the centre of Victoria Falls. It runs on nights when the Bushtracks Express is not travelling to the bridge.

restaurants.name: Stonez Place
restaurants.description: Located in Gweru, Stonez Place is a casual restaurant. It holds a 3.1/5 rating from 20 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: Stop over Bar and Restaurant
restaurants.description: Stop Over on George Silundika Street in the CBD is a drinking spot first, and reviewers describe cold beer and a lively crowd more than any dish. Panashe (April 2025) liked the “cheap cold beers friendly atmosphere” and noted there are no hawkers, while Tadiwanashe (March 2026) said the meat “is cheap and it cooks very fast”. Melyn (June 2025), a returning regular, called it a “second home” with staff who are super friendly.

restaurants.name: Stopover Gardens
restaurants.description: Stopover Gardens in Masvingo is an outdoor grill spot reviewers recommend for families. Comfort (October 2025) praised the “Great outdoor, good grills and ice cold drinks”, calling it a recommended family-friendly place, and Allan (October 2025) called it a “fantastic chilled atmosphere”. Cynthia (October 2025) said the courtesy on offer makes visitors feel at home.

restaurants.name: Suneast Sports Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.description: Suneast Sports Bar & Restaurant on Robertson Street in Masvingo's CBD splits opinion mainly over its music. Dennis (February 2026) liked the “nice tunes and clean” space, and Askmore (June 2026) rated it “One of the best in Masvingo.” Allan (July 2026), rating it 1 star, disagreed, calling the volume “Too much noise” and describing it as “more of a tarven,shabeen kinda” rather than a restaurant.

restaurants.name: Super Pies
restaurants.description: The Super Pies Division produces a range of high-quality pies, pastries, and sausage rolls. restaurants.name: Sushi Shack
restaurants.description: Sushi Shack Groombridge serves sushi and grill dishes, and the food gets praised even when service does not. Takudzwa (2025) recommended the crunch platter, calling the food “amazing” though service was “a bit slow”. Tanyaradzwa (2025) had “Good food, but TERRIBLE SERVICE”, describing a wait to be seated, a wrong order, and a mix-up over the bill that cut the visit short. Hemali (August 2026) had a dispute over whether the tempura avo maki, listed on the menu as containing no

restaurants.name: SushiBox
addresses: Shop 21, Paddington Square, 178 ED Mnangagwa Road, Harare
restaurants.description: SushiBox Harare in Paddington Square draws consistent praise for freshness and presentation. Bongi (May 2026) said the food was “fresh, beautifully presented” with “genuinely happy and polite staff”, thanking Theresa for making the visit “exquisite and so welcoming”. Ruvarashe, in 2024, called it the “Best California roll I've had so far” and enjoyed the freshly squeezed orange juice alongside it.

restaurants.name: Sushimania Zw
restaurants.description: Sushimania Zw, tucked into Golf Estate on Fairway Drive, is a small sushi spot with reviewers split on consistency. Vanessa (2024) called the sushi “very delicious” and “freshly prepared”, and MissLetitia agreed it stays “always fresh” with “reasonable portions”. John had a memorable experience overall. Junior (2025), by contrast, found a plate dry on one visit. Sushimania is closed Monday and Tuesday, and open Wednesday to Friday 11:00 to 20:00, weekends 11:00 to 21:00.

restaurants.name: Suskwe Lodge, Boterekwa Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.description: Suskwe Lodge, Boterekwa Bar & Restaurant is a cozy restaurant found in Gweru. It has 5 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Taj
restaurants.description: A Finest Indian Fusion Culinery experience from remarkable Indian Chefs all the way from India to Tantalize your taste buds, come and engulf yourself! restaurants.description: Taj Mahal. is a restaurant in Masvingo. It has 16 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Taj Restaurant
restaurants.description: Taj on Borrowdale Road serves a long Indian menu across a rooftop terrace, veranda and dining room. Lucius (June 2026) called the chicken tikka skewers “perfectly charred, smoky and insane tender”, for a dinner Lucius found flawless. Other 2026 visits were rougher: Ahsan (March 2026) said the butter chicken “tasted like straight tomato paste”, and Tsai (May 2026) was charged $8 for four cocktail-sized samosas, calling it “plain robbery”. Precious (2023) had a smoother visit,

restaurants.name: Tamarind Holiday & Conference Resort
restaurants.description: A large family and conference resort near the lake with an in-house restaurant and a poolside bar. The restaurant serves local and international dishes at breakfast, lunch and dinner, and English breakfast is served from 7:00 to 10:30.

restaurants.name: Tarsha’s
restaurants.description: Tarsha's occupies a converted house on Seagrave Road, and reviewers describe an intimate setting with both indoor and outdoor seating. Sarah (April 2026) enjoyed a late lunch, finding the environment great and the waiters attentive, and Rumbidzaii (September 2025) called the atmosphere calm and not crowded.

restaurants.name: Taso’s Restaurant
restaurants.description: Taso's Restaurant in Beitbridge draws steady praise for good, affordable food, though the building itself gets mixed marks. Pious (2020) called it “soo good and affordable”, and Praise (2025) simply said it was the “Best food” after a night out with siblings.

restaurants.name: Tea Cosy Snack Bar
restaurants.description: Tea Cosy Snack Bar is a restaurant in Masvingo. It has 19 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Tembisa Shisa-nyama
restaurants.description: Tembisa Shisa-nyama is a restaurant in Bulawayo. It holds a 3.8/5 rating from 11 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: Ten On Brooke
restaurants.description: Guests at this Bulawayo boutique hotel often praise the kitchen alongside the rooms. Nyasha (February 2026) gave a “Hats of to the chef” for “exceptional cooking skills”, and Charmaine (July 2023) found the food “served very hot and well cooked”, adding it never tasted like it had been cooked in bulk.

restaurants.name: Teta
restaurants.description: Teta is often referred to as “the hidden gem” of Harare. Being a relatively new cafe and restaurant (est. 2016), we find that we are still being discovered everyday by locals and tourists alike. We like to think that we come as a pleasant surprise to those who are experiencing Teta for the first time. Our serene & cosy corner of the world is a place for anyone and everyone who enjoys good food. We are a family here, and our aim is to make you feel welcome and comfortable, as

restaurants.name: The Alibi Bar & Grill
addresses: Paddington Square, 178 ED Mnangagwa Road, Lewisam, Harare
restaurants.description: A café, grill and cocktail bar at Paddington Square that opened in late 2025, serving from breakfast through to late evening. The menu covers wood-fired pizzas, charcoal-grilled chicken, ribs and steaks, pasta, weekday lunch specials and a Sunday roast; the rib and chicken combo is the signature.

restaurants.name: The Backspace Lounge Grill & Bar
restaurants.description: The Backspace Lounge Grill & Bar sits just behind Newlands shopping centre, recently renamed from an earlier name that still confuses the gate guards. Noma (April 2026) ordered “sadza with roadrunner chicken and mazondo” and found the service “generally ok, no long waiting times.” Itai (May 2026), on a repeat visit, said “The food was tasty, well-prepared,” with DJ sets moving from amapiano to a Bob Marley set later in the evening.

restaurants.name: The Balcony
addresses: Stand 7518, Mnethi Shopping Centre, 4 Ndaba Rd, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: The Balcony is a restaurant in Bulawayo. It holds a 3.6/5 rating from 38 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: The Bishop's Mistress
restaurants.description: The Bishop's Mistress, a gastropub in a converted house on Ridgeway North, wins reviewers over first with its look. Ruvarashe (2024) was “obsessed with the vintage decor and colours” and chose it for a graduation dinner because of the aesthetics and “beautiful outdoor seating”. Grace (2025) loved the “Warm ambiance, excellent decor and use of space”, and Ashley (August 2026) called it “a awesome find in harare”.

restaurants.name: The Bistro
restaurants.description: The Bistro Restaurant serves delicious gourmet meals in a beautiful setting- with an extensive wine list. Our friendly staff are waiting to welcome you! restaurants.name: The Black Pearl Cafe' Zw
restaurants.description: The Black Pearl Cafe in Gweru works more as a nightlife spot than a daytime cafe, with jazz on Thursdays and a resident DJ for parties. Ngoni (December 2022) said “their food is to die for and the DJ is just on point”, and Leona (January 2023), celebrating a birthday there, praised “beautiful decor, delicious platter and ice cold beer”.

restaurants.name: The Boma – Dinner & Drum Show
addresses: Victoria Falls Safari Lodge estate, 471 Squire Cummings Road, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: The Boma at Victoria Falls Safari Lodge is built around a themed buffet and a drum show that closes the night, and reviewers describe a full immersive evening rather than a quiet dinner. Christopher (February 2026) called it “festive, interactive, and surprisingly accommodating for plant-based travelers”, describing how the chef personally walked Christopher through the vegan options.

restaurants.name: The Bottom Drawer
restaurants.description: The Bottom Drawer in Belgravia is a garden cafe built around flowerbeds, old cars and a trampoline that keeps children busy while parents eat. The smoked chicken salad is the dish reviewers name most: Hazel (July 2025) was “blown away” and asked for “10 of those please”, and Debbie (October 2022) called it “totally out of this world”.

restaurants.name: The Bowery Cafe
addresses: 10 Pauling Road, cnr 8th Avenue, Suburbs, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: The Bowery Café in Bulawayo's Suburbs draws people back for the setting as much as the food: a blue pool, green grass and shaded outdoor seating around 10 Pauling Road. Thulani (April 2026) said the coffee was “perfect; Donald really knows his craft”, and Ngqabutho (February 2026) picked out the Grilled Fish, “cooked to perfection, served with two excellent sauces and a flavorful side of rice”. Rosina (May 2025) called the Brekkie Platter “the best deal for breakfast in the c

restaurants.name: The Bradley Experience
addresses: 11 Bradley Plots, Gweru (at Bradley Gardens Lodge)
restaurants.description: The Bradley Experience, at Bradley Gardens Lodge outside Gweru, runs a large grill menu of burgers, skewers and platters. Catherine (January 2026) said the food is “good quality and portions are massive”, and Donald (January 2024) called it “DEFINITELY the best restaurant in Gweru” with food that is “top shelf”. Howard (January 2025) especially liked the burger, though a dining companion felt the rump steak “didn't taste African and have a room of improvement”.

restaurants.name: The Brahman Gastro Pub
addresses: 1 & 2 M Block, Virginia Lane, Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: The Brahman at Sam Levy's Village runs on a British gastropub menu, and the beef Wellington gets the strongest praise. Kyle (May 2026) called it “the best meal of my week in Harare” and “the best Beef Wellington I have ever had”, enough to book two visits in one trip. Ruvarashe (April 2026) found a rump steak “cooked perfectly, juicy, tender and full of flavour”, though a sirloin ordered medium well “came well done” instead.

restaurants.name: The Bread Co.
restaurants.description: The Bread Co. on Quorn Ave is a small artisanal bakery with a loyal following. Gayle (2019) called it “A great spot for foodies looking for locally made artisanal food” and would “strongly recommend the ciabatta bread”. Mary (2022) orders “your baguettes that I order through Go Veggies”, and Thula (2022) calls it “My favourite shop in all of Harare”.

restaurants.name: The Bridge Fast Foods
restaurants.description: The Bridge Fast Foods in Beitbridge served up mostly quick, decent burgers in earlier reviews: Vhofholowani (2023) said “service was fast and their burger was nice,” though wanted “more range on the products they offer.” Passion (2024) called it “delicious food and perfect service.”

restaurants.name: The Brooke
restaurants.description: Ten-suite hotel and conference centre in Rusape whose kitchen cooks with locally sourced ingredients and tailors menus to dietary requirements, with flexible meal times and private tables.

restaurants.name: The Brush And Bean
restaurants.description: The Brush And Bean pairs a café with an art studio, and painting your own canvas alongside coffee is the draw. Kururama (February 2026) called it “a very cute set up”, adding it's “very affordable” with “fun canvases to choose from if you choose to paint”. Nomsa (2024) had the caprese sandwich and said painting sessions start “for as little as $5”.

restaurants.name: The Buffalo Lodge
restaurants.description: A lodge established in 2024 on the Harare–Beitbridge highway, about 12km from the border town. Its restaurant and bar serves meals from breakfast through to dinner, plus cocktails, and has backup power and Starlink internet.

restaurants.name: The Carvery
restaurants.description: Located in Harare, The Carvery is a casual restaurant. It has 11 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: The Cassia Restaurant
addresses: Ilala Lodge Hotel, 411 Livingstone Way, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: The Cassia sits inside Ilala Lodge in Victoria Falls, close enough to hear the falls from the terrace, and reviewers often mention wildlife wandering past during dinner. Ashley (March 2026) spotted “an elephant having a little snack” mid-meal, and Daniel (May 2025) had both elephants and warthogs stop by at lunch. A pianist, named as Miles by Sai in September 2025, plays most evenings and gets its own mentions across many reviews.

restaurants.name: The Cattleman
addresses: Cnr 12th Ave/J. Tongogara St Bulawayo, Zimbabwe
restaurants.description: Mr Francis McGovern is hands on when it comes to overseeing the finest meals coming out the kitchen, wonderful host and his motto is Our Reputation is at Steak. restaurants.name: The Courtyard Restaurant And Bar
restaurants.description: The Courtyard on Grosvenor Road gets booked for birthdays, ladies' lunches and casual family dinners, helped by the play area and affordable platters. Hannah (June 2026) held a birthday there and said “Chef Anderson was a huge help throughout the entire process”.

restaurants.name: The Departure Lounge
restaurants.description: The Departure Lounge is a garden restaurant in Mutare's Florida suburb, and portion size is the running theme in its reviews. Calma, in 2023, wrote that “the food comes in bigger portions for a really affordable price” and found the chef's warning about serving sizes was no exaggeration. Will (October 2023) agreed, calling the portions “extremely generous” and admitting “couldn't finish my food”.

restaurants.name: The Dock Restaurant
restaurants.description: The Dock Restaurant on Third Street pulls reviewers in for its burgers and steaks. Tomomi (June 2026) called the burger “pretty big and delicious”, and Calma (April 2024) had the sirloin steak done “just the way I like it” during a quiet Tuesday evening solo date.

restaurants.name: The Dome
restaurants.description: The Dome sits on the lakeside at Lomagundi in Kariba, and reviewers go mainly for the setting, watching hippos and the water from the deck. Carly (July 2026) called it “so special to watch the hippos from the deck”, and Jon (February 2026) named it “the number one place to go in Kariba for great food and hospitality”.

restaurants.name: The dragon eats pub and grill
restaurants.description: The Dragon Eats Pub and Grill on Ann Page Avenue mixes Chinese food, sushi and grill on one menu. Leanne (July 2026) said “If you like privacy,good food and good service then this is your go to place”. Sakhile (September 2024) liked the garden setting and found “the food was prepared fast and cooked very well”, though wished they would add alcohol to the menu.
types: Sushi, Fish, Seafood, Chinese, Grill, Bar & Drinks

restaurants.name: The Duncan's
restaurants.description: The Duncan's in Milton Park is known as much for its loaded fries as for its chicken grill. Veronica (January 2026), Natasha (September 2025) and Gamuchirai (July 2025) all call the loaded fries the highlight, and Victoria (October 2023) ordered “the boss box which caught us off guard”, a platter of ribs, pork chops, wings, burgers and corn dogs meant for more than two people.

restaurants.name: The Eatery
restaurants.description: The Eatery sits on the Zambezi River at Pure Africa Waterfront and usually pairs dinner with a sunset cruise. Susan (February 2025) found “the food was excellent”, with an ostrich dish “absolutely delicious similar in taste and tenderness to a filet mignon”. Raina (September 2023) called it a “Delicious dinner service following a Pure Africa sunset cruise” and “Loved their malva pudding!”. A German visitor, in 2025, described the setting right on the river as a dream location

restaurants.name: The Fig & Olive
addresses: Borrowdale Brooke Golf Club, 1 Fairway Drive, Borrowdale Brooke, Harare
restaurants.description: The Fig & Olive sits on the terrace at Borrowdale Brooke Golf Club, and reviewers come for the wood-fired pizzas and the view over the fairways. Dr M. (2025) called it “A hidden gem for food and views” with pizzas that are “deliciously crisp”, and Mercy (2025) had the cumin lamb pappardelle, saying it “was worth every bite”.

restaurants.name: The Flame Grill House
restaurants.description: The Flame Grill House is a Local Grill house that offers flame grilled meats Flame grilled food, sunset bar, tea room serving high tea, multiple table pool bar, conferencing facilities, karaoke Fridays. restaurants.description: The Food Company, off a busy stretch of ED Mnangagwa Road, is a small venue that's easy to miss from the street. Taz (2025) recommends the mushroom truffle dish as “absolutely divine”, made on-site with produce from the restaurant's own herb garden. Diana (April 2026) called it “Fantastic food. Very good quality!”, and Rae (February 2026) found it “ideal for a light meal” such as sandwiches with tea or coffee, on a menu that changes regularly.

restaurants.name: The Fridge
restaurants.description: A Harare cafe serving freshly frozen food, barista coffee, harvest table lunch, food to go, healthy snacks & drinks, freshly baked treats. restaurants.name: The Goose Bar and Grill (Wild Geese Lodge)
addresses: Wild Geese Lodge, 2 Buckland Lane (off Alpes Road), Teviotdale, Harare
restaurants.description: The Goose Bar and Grill at Wild Geese Lodge overlooks a private game sanctuary in Teviotdale. Askmore (October 2025) found “Mouth watering tasty food,” and Sean (November 2025) called it “ok place good vibes perfect for meetings out of office.” Charles (2024) described it as “What a peaceful place to spend your money,” and Kudzanai (2025) rates it mainly for “beverages and snooker for recreation.”

restaurants.name: The GRUB
restaurants.description: The GRUB on Glenara Avenue serves traditional dishes like madora, mazondo and beef bones in a sit-down setting. Fortune (March 2026) had “some good sadza and beef bones,” and Astrix (November 2023) found “the bones were tender, and the sadza was fresh and hot.” Julian (September 2024) said “The food is great and they have quite big portions too.”

restaurants.name: The Homely House Restaurant
restaurants.description: The Homely House Restaurant serves informal Zimbabwean dishes, with staff announcing what's available on the day. Vouchline (September 2025) had a beef stew that was “flavorful, hearty, and filling” and an oxtail “Sweet, tender, and perfectly cooked”, with food arriving “within 10 minutes” of ordering. Tatenda (December 2024) praised the “amazing traditional African taste” and called the staff amazing too. Farai (July 2026) simply called it the “Best traditional meal ever”.

restaurants.name: The Indian Restaurant
restaurants.description: A taste of indian cuisine straight from the heart of india. Located in the heart of Ridgeview Harare, The Indian Kitchen brings you the finest Indian cuisine. restaurants.name: The Ivory Café
addresses: 4290E Gerald Heasman Road, Westview Industrial, Masvingo
restaurants.description: The Ivory Café in Masvingo's Westview Industrial area draws people back mostly for breakfast. Nicholas (December 2025) called it “Breakfast was top tier,” with generous portions and prompt service, and Chimbi (October 2023) found the waiters “fast and efficient” though thought “the food is more costly, not equipment to the quality.”

restaurants.name: The Jam Tree
addresses: Mount Pleasant Sports Club, 40 Bargate Road, Mount Pleasant, Harare
restaurants.description: The Jam Tree at Mount Pleasant Sports Club runs as a family spot by day and a nightlife venue after dark. Rachel (2025) called the drinks “the star of the show”, though warned the service “can be on the slow side”. Miss B. (July 2026) praised the chicken strips and found staff, including Mike, quick to help track down a lost item. Mr C. restaurants.name: The Kitchen
addresses: Hyatt Regency Harare The Meikles, cnr Jason Moyo Avenue & 3rd Street, HarareAll-day dining; breakfast buffet 06:30–10:30
restaurants.description: The Kitchen is the main restaurant at the Hyatt Regency Harare, and one waiter's name comes up more than any dish: Misheck is thanked repeatedly, described by Joyce (April 2026) as someone who served food in a way that was “friendly and he was smart”, and by Primrose (March 2026) as a waiter who “just knew what to do and when to do it.”

addresses: Busters Sports Club (Combined Old Boys), 54 Fairbridge Way, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: The Kraal, run out of Busters Sports Club in Ilanda, is known for its pizza and grilled meat. Lizzie (February 2019) called it “the best pizza in town”, and Anthony (August 2018) went further, calling it “Definitely the best restaurant in Bulawayo” and recommending the pizzas. restaurants.name: The Little Monkey Takeaway
restaurants.description: The Little Monkey Takeaway on Park Way is a small counter in central Victoria Falls known for The President, a wrap built around tempura crocodile. Red Stripe (October 2024) called it “excellent” and planned to come back for something else, and Sumi (October 2023) described it as “basically a crocodile wrap with generous portions coupled with veggies and sauces” that is “very filling”.

restaurants.name: The Livingstone Room
addresses: The Victoria Falls Hotel, 1 Mallet Drive, Victoria FallsDinner
restaurants.description: The Victoria Falls Hotel's Edwardian-style fine-dining room, seating 120 and open for dinner only. It offers à la carte and table d'hôte menus, including a seven-course degustation, with an award-winning wine list and live piano; smart casual dress is required.

restaurants.name: The Lookout Cafe - Wild Horizons
addresses: Batoka Gorge, Victoria Falls Bridge Road, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: The Lookout Cafe perches on the edge of the Batoka Gorge, and reviewers agree the view outranks the food, though the food usually holds up too. Ruan (July 2026) called it a place “where the view is the main attraction and the food is simply a welcome bonus”, and James (February 2026) put it plainly: “the view is the headline act.”

restaurants.name: The Mattle Grills
addresses: Legends Gardens, behind Adriel School, Beitbridge
restaurants.description: A grill restaurant opened on 25 July 2026 by Beitbridge musicians Edgar Tumbare and Hermish Cheya of The Fugeez Band. It is at Legends Gardens, behind Adriel School.

restaurants.name: The Meat Shop
restaurants.description: The Meat Shop in Mutare CBD is a butchery and deli that also turns out burgers, pizza and takeaways. Florence (December 2025) called the beef burger “a 10over10”, with a “beef pattie well done, succulent” and a bun “fresh from the oven”. Nicky (May 2026) agreed, calling it “the best burger ever”.

restaurants.name: The Monalisa Family Restaurant
addresses: 11 Eden Street, off Kopje Rd, Gweru
restaurants.description: The Monalisa Family Restaurant in Gweru's Kopje suburb opened as a family-friendly spot for weekend and midweek meals. Comfort (March 2024) welcomed it as a “new great joint to be with family over the weekend and great mid week meals”, and Andre (July 2024) praised “Attentive staff with a personal touch.” Stewart (May 2024) called it “A very nice chillspot, cool and private”.

restaurants.name: The Mustard Seed

restaurants.name: The Nest
restaurants.description: The Nest in Harare runs a buffet of traditional Zimbabwean meats, with pots kept bubbling by the entrance. Julie (2023) described a buffet that lets diners choose one to three meats with sadza or zviyo, including “maguru, road runner, goat meat, and oxtail”, in what Julie called a rustic setting good for a traditional vibe. Ntulwa (2025) tried a four-meat plate and enjoyed the rabbit meat, though found the goat meat very fatty and the biltong a bit too salty, with beef the mo

restaurants.name: The Odyssey
restaurants.description: Lodge and entertainment venue on the Harare–Bulawayo highway, next to Kadoma Golf Course, with a restaurant serving what it calls fusion cuisine, a mix of Zimbabwean and international dishes. There is also a bar and nightclub, and it regularly hosts live music and weddings.

restaurants.name: The Packshed
restaurants.description: The Packshed on the A14 is a weekends-only converted shed known for its half chicken and chips. Joseph (November 2025) called it “absolutely delicious” with flavours that were “spot on” and a generous portion, and Rob (2022) rated it “the best chicken and chips that side of Juliasdale”, recommending Paul's chilli sauce on the side.

restaurants.name: The Pallet Garden Cafe
restaurants.description: The Pallet Garden Cafe in Gweru serves breakfasts, wraps and burgers, and Catherine (January 2026) was glad to find seafood on the menu without travelling to Bulawayo or Harare, calling the food “tasty and fresh”. Bruce (February 2024) agreed the food was “Very nice” with great service.

restaurants.name: The Pantry
restaurants.description: The Pantry on Jason Moyo Street is known as much for its bakery counter as its menu. Chidziya (August 2024) called the Deluxe Salad “rich and mazing”, and said the bakery section stocks stuffed doughnuts, cinnamon rolls, muffins and cheesecake tubs. Michael (May 2021) tried the half chicken and chips, bream, buffalo wings and chicken salad and said “All of it was sooo goood”, with the chicken salad Michael's favourite.

restaurants.name: The Phoenix Shisanyama ( McInn Complex)
restaurants.description: The Phoenix Shisanyama ( McInn Complex) is a restaurant in Gwanda. It holds a 3.5/5 rating from 26 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: The Place
restaurants.description: Our mission is to give our customers a place to celebrate life’s special moments by offering the best food, service, and ambiance in Zimbabwe. restaurants.name: The Place Bar , Restaurant & Garden
restaurants.description: The Place Bar, Restaurant & Garden at the McDonald Club is best known for Sunday nights, when a live jazz band plays. Kudakwashe (January 2024) called it “The best place to be on a Sunday night as there will be a Live Jazz band”, with a happy hour on selected beers and ciders from 6 to 8, and Zembe (August 2025) described Sundays as the busiest day with a “festive atmosphere.”

restaurants.name: The Poke Co
addresses: Shop 21, Paddington Square, 178 ED Mnangagwa Rd, Harare
restaurants.description: The Poke Co. inside Paddington Square serves build-your-own poke bowls with a loyal following for freshness. Alice (March 2026) called the food “absolutely wonderful fresh, flavorful, and always satisfying”, and Tanisha (July 2026) tried the tiger bowl and thanked “our waitress Theresa very friendly and patient”.

restaurants.name: The Puttery Barn
restaurants.description: The Puttery Barn on Enterprise Road is built around mini-golf, arcade games and VR rather than the kitchen. Prince (August 2026) recommends trying the VR games, calling them “Fascinating immersive stuff”, and Kuzivakwashe (January 2026) described “a strong arcade vibe, complete with games and putt-putt holes”, alongside a big outdoor screen and a 5-a-side court.

restaurants.name: The Q Bar
addresses: Fife Avenue and, Leopold Takawira St, Harare
restaurants.description: The Q Bar, on the corner of Fife Avenue and Leopold Takawira Street, is a no-frills sports bar known for sadza with pork or knuckle bones. Homesystem (2025) called it “the best and cheapest you could ever get of that quality in the whole city”, and Kudzai (2025) enjoyed “Sadza and pork bones!!!” while watching football on TV.

restaurants.name: The Rabbit Hole
addresses: Golden Quarry Road, Samora Machel Ave West, HarareMon Closed
restaurants.description: The Rabbit Hole PaGomo in Dzivarasekwa is a barbecue spot known for its namesake dish. Elisha (July 2026) enjoyed “Rice with penut butter & full Rabbit” at affordable prices, and Joseph (2024) rated it “Very good rabbit meat and quality French fries.” Stanley (2025) liked the quiet setting outside the CBD, where the food was “well cooked and organic.”

restaurants.name: The Rainforest Cafe
addresses: Visitors Centre, Livingstone Way, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: The Rainforest Cafe sits at the Visitors Centre, right where the Victoria Falls walk lets out, and reviewers treat it as the natural stop for food or a drink afterwards. Maria (September 2026) had the berry smoothie bowl and called it “the best i’ve ever had”, while David (July 2026) found “good food and drink options at a very reasonable price”.

restaurants.name: The River
restaurants.description: The River in Chinhoyi earns praise for its food but a consistent knock on service. Josephine (2025) said the “food is tiptop” but staff “mixed up orders multiple times in one visit,” with a meal promised in “20monute” arriving after “an hour.” Kudzai (2024) rated the food “10/10” but called it “Poor service,” and Veegee (2025) agreed, giving “kudos to the chef” while finding service “rather poor.” Paddy (2024) had a better visit, calling it “delicious food.”

restaurants.name: The Roasted Bean
restaurants.description: The Roasted Bean on 10th Avenue in Bulawayo is known for its coffee and baked goods. Tomomi (June 2026) said “Coffee was good and the donut was delicious”, and Ruvarashe (2025) found the pancakes “extra fluffy and warm, very delightful”, though the wrap's tortilla was “a bit tough”. Thabisile (2024) said a pizza was “slightly burnt on the edges” with a crust “peeling of when you picked it up”, but the flavour was still good.

restaurants.name: The Rose Cafe
restaurants.description: The cafe is located in a beautiful serene garden. Perfect for intimate meals and catch-ups with friends. restaurants.name: The Second Story
restaurants.description: The Second Story on Bedford Road roasts its own coffee, and reviewers treat it as a specialist stop rather than a quick coffee shop. Backd00rher0 (January 2026) called the espresso “well balanced with good acidity and bright fruit notes” and said the barista was “skilled, friendly and knowledgeable”. Mazri (November 2025) agreed the in-house roast was “smooth, rich, and full of character”.

restaurants.name: The Sedge Bar and Restaurant
addresses: Intemba Road, and Khami Road, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: The Sedge Bar and Restaurant sits in an open-air setting popular for weekend braais with friends and family. Ngqwele (2025) called it “quality meat” but found the “radio is just too loud”. Sibonginkosi (2025) loved the photo backdrop and said “The meat was succulent and the music was good vibe”, dancing and eating all night. Methembe (January 2026) found it a nice place to chill with good customer care, and Surveyor-Jr (July 2026) called the service and location great.

restaurants.name: The Sitar
restaurants.description: One of Harare's longest-running Indian restaurants, in a house on Cecil Rhodes Drive in Newlands. It was started by members of the city's Indian community and has been a Newlands fixture for well over a decade. The menu is North Indian: tandoori dishes, curries, prawns, basmati rice and naan, with plenty for vegetarians. A 2011 visit by the Harare blog Dinner Club found the curries properly spicy, the service slow but personal, and the dining room dim and hung with Indian pai

restaurants.name: the smokehouse
addresses: Busters Sports Club, Fairbridge Way, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: The Smokehouse sits at Busters Sports Club in Ilanda and reads as Bulawayo's steakhouse for family outings and weekend nights out. Reviewers mention a playground for kids at lunchtime and live music in the evenings. Agata (April 2026) described an “Awesome party vibe on weekends” alongside a family-friendly lunchtime, and Sampa (November 2024) found live music that “added a vibrant energy to the evening without being overwhelming.”

restaurants.name: the smokehouse
addresses: Greenfields Shopping Centre, cnr Samora Machel Avenue & Hampden Street, Harare
restaurants.description: The Smokehouse in Harare's Belvedere serves grills and platters, and pork ribs come up as the standout. Robson (April 2026) called “the pork ribs are a must-try dish,” “perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor.” Rumbidzai (January 2026) ordered “the platter for two,” finding the meat “perfectly seasoned,” and praised the strawberry daiquiri as “one of the best I've had in Harare in a long time.”

restaurants.name: the smokehouse
restaurants.description: The Smokehouse at River Brewery pairs its own craft beer with a grill menu that runs from smash burgers to game meat. Jeff (July 2026) had the Trio of Game delivered to a hotel room and picked out crocodile alongside what seemed to be ostrich and antelope, calling it “a great choice for those wanting to try meats that aren't the norm”. Tiffany (February 2026) named beef, chicken, crocodile and kudu among the grilled options, with the baked potato a standout side.

restaurants.name: The Social Kitchen
addresses: 659 Manyika Road, corner Manyika and Reynard Road, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Vegan and vegetarian travellers repeatedly call Social Kitchen a rare find in Victoria Falls. Donald (February 2026) recommended it for “solid, vegan friendly food at less-than-inflated prices”, and Patricia (July 2026) was glad the kitchen actually stocked the vegan items other spots in town had listed but run out of. Alison (December 2025) called the veggie burger “definitely homemade and outstanding”.

restaurants.name: The Spark Restaurant & Grill
restaurants.description: City-centre restaurant and grill on Second Street serving Zimbabwean meals and grills from breakfast through to early evening.

restaurants.name: The Spot Restaurant
addresses: Driptech Complex, 31–33 Douglas Road, Workington, Harare
restaurants.description: A big, bright cafe and restaurant in the Driptech Complex on Douglas Road, Workington, built around the lunch trade in Harare's industrial south-west, with a mural of the city skyline down one wall. Breakfast runs from egg and bacon rolls and smashed avo to a full or farmhouse fry-up. At lunch there are open baguettes, folded naans, burgers, tramezzinis, pastas and salads, plus grills: half chickens in peri peri, BBQ or lemon and herb, 300g rump or sirloin, ribs, pork chops,
types: Breakfast, Grill, Burgers, Bar & Drinks, Casual dining
restaurants.category: Breakfast, Grill, Burgers, Bar & Drinks, Casual dining

restaurants.name: The Suburban Village
restaurants.description: The Suburban Village outside Gweru pairs a restaurant with rooms, a conference centre and a pool, and reviewers treat it as a stop for both a meal and a stay. The kitchen runs a Chinese-Zimbabwean menu, from sizzling beef to Peking duck alongside more traditional dishes, and Tomla (August 2025) “really enjoyed the food, especially the traditional dishes”. Fred (April 2023) drove in just for breakfast and found it “fresh and hot”.

restaurants.name: The Three Monkeys
addresses: Honeydew Lifestyle Centre, 16 Greendale Avenue, Harare
restaurants.description: The garden setting is what most reviewers describe first. Troy (April 2026) liked how “there was a very green lawn right beside it”, and other reviewers describe the same lush grounds, the Pizza Garden and a play area for children as reasons to spend a Sunday there.
types: Italian, Fish, Seafood, Grill, Burgers, Pizza
restaurants.category: Italian, Fish, Seafood, Grill, Burgers, Pizza

restaurants.name: The Three Monkeys
addresses: Corner Livingstone Way & Adam Stander Drive, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: The Three Monkeys opened in late 2016, spearheaded by Chef & General Manager Greg Paymans and quickly established itself as the top restaurant & bar in Victoria Falls. A favourite for locals & tourists alike, the restaurant has fast become a hub for the town. We are open 7 days a week from 12 pm until late, and pride ourselves on serving good, honest food at great prices. restaurants.name: The Vanilla Moon
addresses: 64 Sam Nujoma Street (2nd Street Extension), Ashbrittle, Harare
restaurants.description: The Vanilla Moon's move to 2nd Street Extension has kept the garden feel reviewers loved at the old Avondale site, now with a play area and secure parking. Grace (2025) said Grace loves “how they made it similar to the last location”, calling the food “Well prepared food, so fresh and hearty”, though Grace found the waiter “on the slow side and not so cheerful”.

restaurants.name: The Victoria Falls Hotel
restaurants.description: The Victoria Falls Hotel's Livingstone Room is the fine-dining draw, a four-course menu reviewers rate as good value for the setting. Buddy (July 2026) paid “$60 per person for the four-course menu exclusive of drinks” and had “ostrich tartare, springbok shank, and chocolate tart”, calling the price “reasonable” given the view over the gorge and bridge. Colin (June 2026) called dinner there “the most elegant dining experience of our lives”, with maitre d' Simba's team gliding

The Village Greek
addresses: Shop 3, Phase 3, Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: The Village Greek has all your favourite Mediterranean dishes cooked with quality ingredients which embody authentic flavours and tastes from Greece. restaurants.name: The Village Library (Fortunesgate Lodge)
addresses: Fortunesgate Lodge, 1b Rue des Fleurs, Fortunesgate, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: The Village Library is the restaurant at Fortunesgate Lodge, specialising in spit-roast meats served in a formal dining room or outdoors around a firepit. There is a bar and a winery, and the lodge recommends booking early.

restaurants.name: The Village Lodge
addresses: Lot 1 Bon Brae Farm, Christmas Gift, Harare Road (A5), GweruBar & restaurant
restaurants.description: The Village Lodge outside Gweru pairs a hotel and conference centre with a restaurant known locally for its Chinese menu. Cat (February 2023) said “The Chinese food is superb” and singled out the vegetable spring rolls that “will have you coming back again and again”. Trevor (February 2022) agreed Chinese dishes were a favourite among “a wide range of awesome food”.

restaurants.name: The Village Zw
restaurants.description: The Village in Masvingo's Industrial site serves traditional Zimbabwean dishes, and reviewers name the sadza nematumbu as the standout. Linford (September 2026) called the food “top notch African food” and named “the sadza nematumbu hands down” as a favourite, while Carrie (March 2026) ordered goat that was “super tender and yummy”, served on wooden plates.

restaurants.name: The Volt
restaurants.description: The Volt is a casual restaurant found in Harare. It holds a 3.5/5 rating from 33 Google Maps reviews.

restaurants.name: The Wine Bar at Victoria 22
restaurants.description: The Wine Bar is the more relaxed sister of Victoria 22, opened in 2020 by the owners' sons Lucas and Matthias. Chef Lucas cooks seasonal small sharing plates mixing European and global flavours, alongside a short cocktail list and a wine and spirits list. Adults only; booking recommended.

restaurants.name: Three By Jo
addresses: Chisi Walk, 15 Shortheath Road, Chisipite, Harare
restaurants.description: Three By Jo opened at the Chisi Walk garden complex in Chisipite in mid-2026 and has drawn quick praise for breakfast. Rakefet (September 2026) had “a big delicious breakfast” in what Rakefet called a beautiful environment with lovely staff, and Kevin (August 2026) rated the food preparation and handling “excellent” and called it “A restaurant to visit”.

restaurants.name: Thymeless Gourmet
restaurants.description: Thymeless Gourmet caters for all your meals, lunches and snack platters for any function or event. We offer delivery service for our meal options. restaurants.name: Tiffany's Restaurant
restaurants.description: Tiffany's is a fixed-menu fine-dining restaurant in Harare with no prices printed, and staff explain what's on offer that evening. Jason (April 2025) praised the “five course menu” and said it's “Always a pleasure to have my steak and banana sundae flambéed at the table.”

restaurants.name: Tiger's Milk
addresses: 2 Selousville Road, off ED Mnangagwa Road, Highlands, Harare
restaurants.description: Tiger's Milk opened on Selousville Road in Highlands in June 2026, bringing wood-fired pizzas, burgers, grills and a full bar to a garden setting. Anotida (July 2026) called it leaning toward “bar food” but found “something for everyone”, enjoying the Caesar salad, honey sriracha wings and nachos, though the crumbed prawns came out heavy with a crust that overpowered the flavour. Tino (September 2026) singled out the steak as the standout of the night.
types: Burgers, Pizza, Grill, Bar & Drinks, Fish, Seafood
restaurants.category: Burgers, Pizza, Grill, Bar & Drinks, Fish, Seafood

restaurants.name: Tin Cup Pub And Grill
restaurants.description: Tin Cup Pub and Grill on Fraser Avenue is Bulawayo's go-to for a night out as much as a meal, with a golf driving range attached to the bar. Ernest (2024) described how visitors can “purchase a bucket of golf balls and drive them to a length of 200metres” before settling in for a drink. Gerald (September 2025) called it a “Top class place for clubbing” that fills up on weekends, with DJs and dancing that keep the place busy into the early hours.

restaurants.name: Tinkabell
addresses: Ballantyne Shopping Centre, Ballantyne Park, Harare
restaurants.description: Breakfast The most important meal of the day, we have a selection of freshly made breakfasts, Or fresh fruit pots, perfect with a hot cup of coffee or freshly squeezed Fruit juice on the side. Or enjoy one of our many homemade baked goods while you read the morning paper. Lunch We are open Monday to Saturday for lunch, our menu is diverse & caters for all tastebuds. From our House specialty “Frango Peri-Peri” to our signature “Moza’s special” grilled prawns. Our menu is Halaa

restaurants.name: Tongfu Restaurant
restaurants.description: Tongfu on Phillips Avenue in Belgravia is built for group dining, with private VIP rooms and a garden patio around a fountain. Tawonga (2025) celebrated a birthday dinner there and enjoyed “the sweet chicken and fried rice”, finding the food “hot and generously served”. Aaron (2025) recommended that “if you are a big group it’s worth booking the VIP rooms”.

restaurants.name: Tony's coffee shop
restaurants.description: Tony's is a cake shop and coffee house set in the Bvumba mountains outside Mutare, and cakes are what people drive out for. Dennis (May 2017) called it “quite simply the best coffee shop in Zimbabwe,” and Yanano (October 2025) named one cake “the best cake I've ever had in my life.” Neil (September 2025) agreed the cakes are “nothing short of exquisite.”

restaurants.name: Tree tops
restaurants.description: Tree tops is a casual restaurant found in Gweru. It has 13 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Troutbeck Resort – The Beck Restaurant
restaurants.description: The Beck Restaurant at Troutbeck Resort serves a lunch buffet with lake views, open to non-residents as well as guests. Dagmer (June 2026) brought 16 family members for a 60th birthday lunch and found “a good range of food items” served by staff who were “friendly and helpful and very kind”, in a room kept clean down to the “clean toilets”. The buffet runs to a set time, but Dagmer (June 2026) said guests are “free to hang around for as long as we wanted after eating”.

restaurants.name: True Elegance Restaurant
addresses: Cnr 1st/2nd Avenue, along Joshua Mqabuko Nkomo Street (opposite Wheels Garage), Bulawayo
restaurants.description: True Elegance in Bulawayo serves both local and western dishes, and Mia (July 2024) called the seasoning on the t-bone “mouth watering,” with a “great menu” and seating “both inside and out.” Splendid (March 2025) said the food “brings you closer to your mothers kitchen,” and Tinotenda (July 2024) agreed the “food is really good” with “good services.”

restaurants.name: Twin Lodges Resort
addresses: Plot 1236 Flamboyant Road, Shashi View, Bindura
restaurants.description: Twin Lodges is a resort in the leafy suburb of Shashi View, about 1.4km from Bindura's CBD along the Mt Darwin road. There is a bar and restaurant alongside a swimming pool and gardens.

restaurants.name: Ujiji Bar
restaurants.description: Ujiji Bar in Masvingo comes across as a quiet, low-key drinking spot rather than a dining destination. Collen (November 2018) described “a very lovely place with not much conjesition, a noise free place”, and Busybee (September 2018) noted darts as the main draw, adding that “There are no reliable restaurants though.”

restaurants.name: Ukama Restaurant
restaurants.description: Ukama Restaurant, attached to Zumbane Lodges near Angler's Rest in Nyanga, serves a wide-ranging menu that reviewers say changes with what's fresh. Aisling (July 2026) tried “a new dish each for the two nights we stayed” and was “blown away by the variety and creativity.” Primrose (November 2025) called it “one of the finest restaurants l have visited in Zimbabwe,” spanning “traditional to a mixture of different flavours.”

restaurants.name: Uncle Praise Foodies
restaurants.description: Located in Victoria Falls, Uncle Praise Foodies is a restaurant. It has 7 reviews on Google Maps so far.

restaurants.name: Uncle's Chicken
restaurants.description: Uncle's Chicken serves flame-grilled chicken and sadza at prices reviewers call unbeatable. Kudzie (November 2023) found it “very well done grilled chickens at a very low price”, and Jacob (June 2024) said the kitchen “have the flame down very well”, alongside a t-bone that was tender.

restaurants.name: Unit O Cafe and Grill
addresses: Taita Shopping Centre, Unit O, Chitungwiza
restaurants.description: Unit O Cafe and Grill is a café-restaurant and grill at Taita Shopping Centre in Chitungwiza, which also caters for events.

restaurants.name: Upstate
addresses: Highland Park Shopping Centre, ED Mnangagwa Road, HarareDaily about 12:30–23:30; Denga lounge next door from 15:00
restaurants.description: Upstate, in Highland Park Shopping Centre, is a steak-focused restaurant with a view over the surrounding suburbs. Kondwani (May 2026) ordered the T-bone and is “still thinking about it and licking my lips”, and Max (June 2024) called the sirloin with garlic butter “the best steak I've ever had in Harare”.

restaurants.name: Urban Eats Restaurant
restaurants.description: A restaurant in Masvingo opened by entrepreneur Enny Chitongo after the 2024 Women's Business Bootcamp. It uses produce and poultry from her own farm.

restaurants.name: Urban Grill
addresses: Robert Mugabe Way, between 5th & 6th Avenue, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Urban Grill Shisanyama and Bar on Robert Mugabe Way combines a braai, bar and play area for children. Shupani (May 2026) called it “One stop shop, bar, braai, music, play arena for children” with “Friendly men and women who serve clients”, and Lerato (May 2026) “absolutely enjoyed the gango” for being “very tasty and delicious”.

restaurants.name: Utano Cafe & Restaurant

restaurants.name: Valis
restaurants.description: Valis on Kensington Road serves baked goods and breakfast items alongside its restaurant menu, and pastries get consistent praise. Davis (2025) called the “donuts, coffee, croissants, and chicken mayo” fantastic, and Hilary (2021) simply called it “Great food. Amazing menu.”. PSK (2024) liked the chicken, “well done and tasted great”, with a salad that was “so fresh”, though found the beer “not so cold” and missed local brews.

restaurants.name: Verandah Café
restaurants.description: Verandah Café in Malindela draws a loyal following for its all-day menu, from breakfast to coffee and cake. Micah (January 2026) called the Savoury Waffles “the best for me”, and Ruvarashe (February 2025) said the banofee crepe offered “the perfect balance in sweetness”, calling it the best dessert Ruvarashe had had in a long time.

restaurants.name: Victoria 22
restaurants.description: Victoria 22 in Newlands is Harare's upscale seafood and Italian address, and steak and oxtail are the dishes reviewers keep returning for. HreFoodie (June 2026) had the snapper and tomahawk steak, calling both “sublime”, and Denice (October 2023) rated it the “BEST steak I've had in town.” Grace (March 2025) “especially loved the oxtail and the peanut butter ice cream.”

restaurants.name: Victoria Falls Coffee Company
addresses: EL 11 & 12, Landela Complex, Metcalfe Road, Livingstone Way, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Victoria Falls Coffee Company roasts its own beans behind GOAT restaurant, and reviewers leave with a bag to take home as often as a coffee in hand. Stacy (August 2026) tried all three varieties on offer and “loved Ngwenya and GOAT the best”, drinking the beans back home in Ireland and the UK. Isabella (August 2026) called the flat white “best coffee I have had since travelling Africa” and got a tour of the coffee production.

restaurants.name: Victoria Falls Distilling Co
addresses: 256 Adam Stander Drive (corner Livingstone Way), Victoria Falls — entrance via The Three Monkeys
restaurants.description: Craft gin distillery and cocktail bar next to The Three Monkeys, home of Falls Gin. Guests can book gin tastings and distillery tours, and the food menu includes game-meat sushi and charcuterie boards.

restaurants.name: Victoria Falls Safari Club
restaurants.description: Victoria Falls Safari Club's restaurant and lounge overlook a watering hole that draws wildlife into view during meals, and reviewers treat dinner as part of the show. Hannah (March 2025) watched “so many elephants and zebras” during dinner each night, and Monika (June 2025) called it “the best view for sunset from the restaurant”.

restaurants.name: Victoria Falls Tshisa Nyama
restaurants.description: Victoria Falls Tshisa Nyama lets diners choose their braai meat first, beef, pork, chicken or sausage, then has it grilled to order. Mike (April 2026) called the staff “very helpful”, describing it as more a place “to get food and hangout” than a typical restaurant, especially on a Saturday night with football on. Bongie (January 2026) was effusive about the “Amazing Ambiance”, “Tasty Barbecue and Meaty Stews”, cold drinks and a garden bar with pool tables. Giovanni (Septembe

restaurants.name: Villa Restaurant
restaurants.description: Villa Restaurant in Chegutu serves Zimbabwean and international dishes from breakfast into the evening, and slow service is the most common complaint. Master (2024) said the food was good but “it takes some time for an order to be prepared,” and Taurai (2024) agreed reviewers “don't have to wait for food for too long.” Hama (2019) found “level of service a bit lower than expected” despite a “very very nice atmosphere.”

restaurants.name: Village Inn
restaurants.description: Hotel in Nyanga village with an on-site restaurant serving meals made with local ingredients, including vegetarian dishes.

restaurants.name: Village Place Resort
restaurants.description: Village Place Resort outside Harare pairs a restaurant with a game drive and open outdoor space. Hellen (December 2025) visited for a church Christmas celebration and said “the food was to die for”, with a bill that came out “very reasonable”. Nicholas (January 2019) called the food “without doubt the finest, yummiest”.

restaurants.name: Vitagreens
restaurants.description: Vitagreens on Main Street in Gweru gets brief but consistently positive notes from reviewers. Leslie (April 2019) summed it up as “Good food, good place, good staff”, and Wonder (May 2019) called it a one-stop shop “For all ur green groceries”. Abdul (December 2017) had a nice visit with nice views, and Kawagga (August 2022) described it simply as a better place to be and enjoy. Papajoe, writing in Indonesian in October 2018, called it a pleasant, nice place worth recommendin

restaurants.name: Waikiki Restaurant
restaurants.description: Waikiki on Suffolk Road is decorated with sand and thatched umbrellas for a beach theme, and reviewers split sharply on the food. Mrs C. (2023) recommended “their prawns, crab, fish and rice” in the sand-floored dining room, and Hilary (2022) had half chicken, rump steak and hake with chips that came with “no complaints whatsoever” and “quick service”.

restaurants.name: Walkers Pub & Restaurant
restaurants.description: Walkers Pub & Restaurant in Bulawayo's CBD is an old favourite that longtime regulars say has faded. Wilberforce (January 2019) found it “no longer classy” with “a limited choice of drinks,” and Goodwill (March 2020) agreed it “has lost its touch over the years.” Liberty (January 2015) still loved the bar but flagged that “Pilsner lager is over priced.”

restaurants.name: Warthogs Safari Camp
restaurants.description: Warthogs Safari Camp sits on the shore of Lake Kariba, and the wildlife walking through camp is what reviewers talk about first. Succydee (March 2022) described the routine: “Everyday, like clockwork, the Zebras would pass through in the morning, elephants later in the afternoon, and the hippos from early evening”. Others mention crocodiles, waterbuck and an elephant bull wandering along Powerlines Road.

restaurants.name: Waseefa's Quality Confectioners
addresses: SB3 Shop 7, Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: Waseefa's Quality Confectioners at Sam Levy's Village is a small halal cafe reviewers use for breakfast or a coffee to go. Zaib (2025) called it “Lovely for breakfast or coffee dates” and enjoyed the egg, spinach and feta croissant with its side salad, while Rufaro (2021) found the pastries “amazing” and the food affordable. Shingi (2025) liked the heated sitting area with power sockets and a hot ginger shot, and noted it opens very early.

restaurants.name: Waseefa's The Pastry Shop
addresses: Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale Road, Borrowdale, Harare
restaurants.description: A small halal café on the quieter side of Sam Levy's Village, serving coffee, pastries, croissants and light breakfasts and lunches, plus artisan rolled ice cream. Seating is limited but it is heated and has power points, which makes it popular with laptop workers.

restaurants.name: Waterbuck's Head Restaurant (Main Camp)
addresses: Main Camp reception, Hwange National Park
restaurants.description: A basic restaurant and bar at the Main Camp reception inside Hwange National Park. It's open to all visitors for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

restaurants.name: White Horse Inn
restaurants.description: Country hotel in a wooded corner of the Bvumba, about 15 km from Mutare, long known for its food. It offers a large à la carte menu, a three-course table d'hôte dinner and a fairly comprehensive wine list; its Sunday lunch is well known locally.

restaurants.name: Willsgrove Food Market
restaurants.description: The restaurant side of Willsgrove Food Market, a fresh produce and groceries store in Belmont run by Willsgrove Farm Enterprises. The menu covers breakfast, salads, pasta, burgers, wraps, sandwiches, around twenty pizzas, grills, fish and sharing platters for four, most dishes between $6 and $12.
types: Grill, Pizza, Pasta, Cafe & Coffee, Fish
restaurants.category: Grill, Pizza, Pasta, Cafe & Coffee, Fish

restaurants.name: Wonderful
restaurants.description: Wonderful is a busy Chinese restaurant on Churchill Avenue, and reviewers agree more on the food than on how it arrives. Tatenda (2025) had a smooth visit with egg fried rice, sweet and sour chicken and sizzling lamb, and Elton (2022) called the food “Quite delicious and reasonably price”, though flagged the service as “the only setback”.

restaurants.name: Wonderful Fresh
restaurants.description: Wonderful Fresh at Sam Levy Village serves sushi and Chinese dishes in Borrowdale, and staff attentiveness gets consistent praise. Wadzanai (July 2026) said “You are served like a royalty”, loving the seafood soup and sushi that “just melted in your mouth”, though Wadzanai's pork dumplings weren't fresh that visit. Ryan (June 2026) called it “an amazing new sushi joint in Harare”, with the owner and chef both stopping by the table to check in.

restaurants.name: Woody’s Sub and Grill
restaurants.description: Woody’s Sub & Grill Ryan Wood aka “Woody” is taking on a new venture opening up a specialised takeaway spot in Harare. Starting off with a small variety of subs, burgers and the good old ‘chicken & chips’ all at an affordable price. We are located in the complex directly opposite Maarsdorp Market – number 11 Maarsdorp Road. Pop in and come see what we have to offer!
