restaurants.name: Wrup restaurant
restaurants.description: Wrup restaurant gets recommended for lunches and dates, with a small photo booth as an extra. Eaugen (May 2024) called it “Great place to chill” with “Very affordable meals” and enjoyed the steak and cheese sub. Munashe (June 2024) agreed it suits “lunches and dates” but wished for longer hours to cover evening meals.

restaurants.name: XAI XAI AUTHENTIC MOZAMBICAN CUISINE
addresses: Ascot Shopping Centre, 23 Ascot Road, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Diners praise the service at Xai Xai's branches, and reviews repeatedly thank staff by name. Precious comes up most often: Tumisang (July 2026) wrote “Highly appreciate Precious. The best waitress for us”, and Tanaka (July 2026) said Precious's “service and hospitality is the reason why I come there”. Other reviewers single out Vanessa, Princess, Nicole and Mitchell for similarly attentive service.

restaurants.name: Yanaya
restaurants.description: We are a grab and go healthy snack bar located in Joina City 1st Floor Opposite the Food Court. We serve the freshest, yummiest smoothies, subs, wraps, Buddha bowls, and freshly squeezed juices in town. Our mandate is to inspire a healthier and happier generation. All our products are made from locally sourced fruits, vegetables, deli and herbs. We are Zimbabwe’s first biggest healthy food bar. Yanaya aims to share delicious, wholesome, plant-based food that fuels and energis

restaurants.name: Yanaya Lifestyle Joina
addresses: Joina City, 2nd Floor, cnr Julius Nyerere Way & Jason Moyo Avenue, HarareDaily about 07:00–22:00
restaurants.description: Yanaya in Joina City built its name on healthy food and smoothies rather than the usual takeaway menu. Gilbert (September 2021) called it a place where “the food is out of this world”, with a “Fresh look, fresh vibe” at the Joina City branch. Jeffrey (April 2021) recommended the immune booster smoothie and Thai chicken wrap from the smaller Avondale branch, adding that “the pricing is very fair”.

restaurants.name: You Real Restaurant
addresses: Shops 13 & 14, Sam Levy's Village, Borrowdale Road, Harare
restaurants.description: YOU REAL Restaurant warmly welcome you and provide you unforgettable dining experience through a seamless integration of exquisite Japanese as well as Asian food, tempting drinks, friendly service and relaxing atmosphere. YOU REAL also provides a takeaway service and delivery, you can easily place an order on our website or via telephone and enjoy freshest Sushi at home or in the office without any hassle. Share this with the world:- Print (Opens in new window) Print - Email

restaurants.name: Zambezi Dinner Cruise (Wild Horizons)
addresses: Zambezi River jetty upstream of the Falls, Victoria FallsDaily; boarding about 5pm, approx. 3–3.5 hours
restaurants.description: A daily sunset-and-dinner cruise on the upper Zambezi aboard dedicated dining vessels such as the Zambezi Reflections and Ma Robert, serving a four-course dinner with drinks. Hippos, crocodiles and elephants are often seen along the way.

restaurants.name: Zambezi Explorer
restaurants.description: Zambezi Explorer is a sunset cruise on the Zambezi River run by Pure Africa, with food and drinks included in the ticket. Doug (September 2026) described the boat as one that “accommodates up to 150 passengers across three highly stylized, solar-powered decks.” Elsa (October 2025) listed the spread served on board as “potato chips, chicken satay with rolls, sliders with mini quiches” and found it filling, and Chris Chibaduki (January 2026) called the food “absolutely deliciou

restaurants.name: Zambezi House
restaurants.description: Zambezi House sits on the riverbank on Park Way Drive, and the wildlife on the lawn gets mentioned as often as the food. Emma (January 2020) described “gorgeous river views with frequent animal visitors (especially crocs and warthogs)”, and Biljana (November 2019) advised watching the crocodiles while recommending the Zambezi bream “for a bit of local cuisine”.

restaurants.name: Zarah Lounge
addresses: 101a Robert Mugabe Way, cnr 10th Avenue, Bulawayo
restaurants.description: Zarah Lounge, on Robert Mugabe Way in central Bulawayo, is a bar and dining spot Banele (March 2019) dubbed “The beach in the city”. Albert (October 2022) found the “portion sizes are awesome” and noted food is “cooked fresh to order, give or take 20 to 30 mins”. Amy (March 2021) liked the “Lovely music, good food and great vibes” and called the setting beautiful.

restaurants.name: Zaytoon Restaurant
restaurants.description: Zaytoon, a Mediterranean and Turkish spot in Mount Pleasant, opened in 2025 and already has fans of its fish and desserts. HreFoodie (June 2026) had the hake fillet and found it “succulent” with a generous portion, and Itai (March 2026) called the blueberry cheesecake “absolutely delicious and definitely worth ordering” at a birthday lunch in a calm, spacious room.
types: Mediterranean, Grill, Pizza, Breakfast, Fish, Seafood
restaurants.category: Mediterranean, Grill, Pizza, Breakfast, Fish, Seafood

restaurants.name: Zebras Dazzle
addresses: 2 Baobab Ave, Orange Grove, ChinhoyiMon Closed
restaurants.description: Zebras Dazzle B&B Restaurant sits in a garden gazebo in Chinhoyi's Orange Grove, run by hosts Assia and Jimmy. Baud (2024) took “the Butchers steak from the grill” for dinner, “made by the chef from Harare,” and called it “truly fantastic.” Valérie (2025) enjoyed “Breakfast with 3 courses!” and rated the dishes “really of good quality.”

restaurants.name: Zen Cafe
addresses: Jacaranda Walk, Clark Road, Suburbs, Bulawayo09:00–16:00
restaurants.description: Zen Cafe, tucked into Jacaranda Walk in Bulawayo's Suburbs, has built its name on butter chicken. Shantel (August 2023) called it “a must” alongside freshly squeezed orange juice, and Thandi (January 2023) wrote that the Butter Chicken is “the best I've ever tasted...full of flavor, thick and flavors dont overpower each other”. Azraa (June 2024) recommended checking the menu “for the little hearts” marking the favourites, and pairs it with a steak sandwich “filled with cheesy

restaurants.name: Zim Cafe

restaurants.name: Zimbo's Cafe
restaurants.description: Zimbo's Cafe on First Street built its reputation on one thing: the burger. Larry (April 2026) orders one plate of the “tasty Zimbo burger (huge!)” with chips and finds it enough to share between two people, and Peter (March 2025) said the burgers are “double the size of anywhere I have ever been.” Tnash (January 2020) and Anesu (July 2019) both call it the best burger in the country.

restaurants.name: ZimNhaka Restaurant, Bar & Bottle store
restaurants.description: ZimNhaka Restaurant, Bar & Bottle Store in Marondera pairs food with drinks and a lively night scene. Jack (2025), visiting from Belgium and in the area regularly, said the meal “went over my expectations” and was “very good prepared and tasted yammy”, adding staff were friendly. Takudzwa (April 2026) found it “fun” with “an experience worth remembering”, and Filbert (2025) recommended it as “Good place to turn up at night”. restaurants.name: Zindoga
restaurants.description: Zindoga Waterfalls in Mbare West runs on a vendor model rather than a standard menu: diners buy meat from nearby butcheries and pay the grill operators to braai it. Shamiso (2023) explained the setup, noting the “guys by the grill” are fast and will add sadza, salads and sauces at a cheap price, though there is little in the way of toilets or other services, calling it more “vendor type of service”. Elizabeth (2025) called it simply “a good place, especially for braaid chicke

restaurants.name: ZPC SOCIAL CLUB
restaurants.description: ZPC Social Club sits right on Lake Kariba, and the view is the main draw. Rodger (June 2023) said it has “Good view of Boats at Lake and it's 15 metres from the Lake”, and Tadiwa (April 2026) enjoyed a “great menu and lakeside view is a bonus”. Givie (June 2025) added that the pool is “clean and very inviting” for those wanting a swim.

restaurants.name: Zulu Bistro Bar
addresses: Landela Complex, Livingstone Way, Victoria Falls
restaurants.description: Zulu Bistro Bar in the Landela Complex builds its menu around Zimbabwean dishes tourists rarely try elsewhere: crocodile tail, oxtail stew, goat curry, tripe and mopane worms. Aden (May 2025) called the pan-seared crocodile and peanut rice “fantastic”, and Kritsana (January 2026) liked that the menu offers “a mix of authentic Zimbabwean dishes and 'safe zone' standard options” for less adventurous eaters.
